Śrīmad Vṛddhavāgbhaṭaviracitaḥ Aṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahaḥ
                        Induvyākhyāsahitaḥ
Anaṃta Dāmodara Āṭhavale
Śa. He. Gurjara at the Āyurvidyā Mudraṇālaya
Puṇyapattane

This machine-readable file omits the commentary of Indu that is printed in
                        this edition.
This edition has been scanned and made publicly available online at the
Digital Library of India

Anonymous transcription based on the Āṭhavale 1980 edition, omitting the
                    commentary of Indu.

The published edition from which this e-text was transcribed is printed in the
                Devanāgarī script. The electronic text below is in a lossless transliteration using
                the Latin alphabet. The transliteration scheme used is the IAST (
The International Alphabet of Sanskrit Transliteration

). IAST differs in
                small ways from ISO 15919, but is preferred by most working Sanskrit scholars.
                Conversion of this file to ISO 15919 can be achieved by performing the following
                replacements throughout the file:
ṛ -> r̥ and ṃ -> ṁ

The word separation is inconsistent. It mostly is transliterated as Devanāgarī
                ("ityevam" not "ity evam".), but in several occasions orthography follows general
                transliteration principles in roman script.

Vowel merging is inconsistent. Most have not been separated, but there are several
                occasions where separation occurs with "+" or "++" (e.g."na+ācaret", "ca++āme").

athāta āyuṣkāmīyaṃ nāmādhyāyaṃ
                        vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smā+āhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ ||
dadau dakṣāya so 'śvibhyāṃ tau śatakratave tataḥ ||
gṛhītvā te tamāmrāyaṃ prakāśya ca parasparam ||

svaṃ svaṃ tantraṃ tataste 'pi
                        cakrustāni kṛtāni ca |

taiḥ praśastāni tānyeṣāṃ
                        pratiṣṭhāṃ bhuvi lebhire |

vāyuḥ pittaṃ kaphaśceti trayo
                        doṣāḥ samāsataḥ |
vikṛtā 'vikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te varttayanti ca ||
koṣṭhaḥ krūro mṛdurmadhyo madhyaḥ syāttaiḥ samairapi ||
tatra rūkṣo laghu śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaścalo 'nilaḥ ||

pittaṃ sasnehatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu
                        visraṃ saraṃ dravam |
snigdhaḥ śīto gururmandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ ||
indriyārthā vyavāyī ca vikāṣī cāpare guṇāḥ ||

vastirvireko vamanaṃ tathā
                        tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu |
vamau madātyaye 'rśassu viśi dvau dvau ca mūtrite ||

mūrdhni vraṇe tathā dvau dvau
                        sadyobhaṅge bhagandare |

viṣe dvau bhujage kīṭe dvau ca
                        lūtāsu mūṣike |

na brūyāt kevalaṃ nāma nā
                        'sādhvapi vināṭayet |

sa satsu garhāmāpneti vadhaṃ
                        carcchati rājataḥ |

jñānaṃ caturvidhaṃ yasya sa
                        rājārho bhiṣaktamaḥ |
pradīpabhūtaṃ śāstraṃ hi darśanaṃ vipulā matiḥ ||
āhūta eva yo yāti suveṣaḥ sunimittataḥ ||

hrepaṇīyāṃ ca tadvāarttāṃ na
                        prakāśayate bahiḥ |

tābhiśca rahasi sthānaṃ
                        parihāsaṃ ca varjayet |
sādhyo 'sādhya iti vyādhirdvidhā tau tu punardvidhā ||

snātvā bhoktumanā bhuktvā suptvā
                        kṣutvā surārccane |

prāṅmukho vā viviktastho na
                        bahirjānu nānyadṛk |

dantān pūrvamadho gharṣet
                        prātaḥ siñcecca locanaṃ |

mālyaṃ na lambaṃ na bahirna
                        raktaṃ jalajāddate |
pathyaṃ suptotthite bhukte snāte vānte ca mānave ||

dvipatraṃekaṃ pūgaṃ ca
                        sacūrṇakhadiraṃ ca tat |

niśi cātyayike kārye daṇḍī
                        maulī sahāyavān |
na seveta na śarvaryāṃ vṛkṣacaityaṃ na catvaram ||
nipātayenna loṣṭena na phalena phalaṃ drumāt ||
svayaṃ tiṣṭhet paragṛhe yuktaniṃdraṃ na bodhayet ||

na svahastena dantairvā snānaṃ
                        cānu samācaret |
vātapittāmayī bālo vṛddho 'jīrṇī ca taṃ tyajet ||
tṛṣṇā kṣayaḥ pratamako raktapittaṃ śramaḥ klamaḥ ||
nā 'nāplutya śiraḥ snāyānna jale 'lpe na śītale ||

snātvā na mṛjyāt gātrāṇi
                        dhunuyānna śiroruhān |

na tvambaraṃ pūrvadhṛtaṃ na ca
                        tailavase spṛśet |
abhinandya prasannātmā hutvā datvā ca śaktitaḥ ||
notsaṅge bhakṣayet bhakṣyān jalaṃ nāñjalinā pibet ||

dātā pitṛbhyaḥ piṇḍasya yaṣṭā
                        hotā kṛpātmakaḥ |
dharmyamarthyaṃ priyaṃ tathyaṃ mitaṃ pathyaṃ vadedvacaḥ ||

nā 'runtudaḥ syānna krūro na
                        tīkṣṇo no 'patāpavān |
hetāvīrṣyenna tu phale pāpaṃ pāpe 'pi nācaret ||

parasya daṇḍaṃ nodyacchet
                        kruddho nainaṃ nipātayet |

na kāṃsyabhājane tau ca
                        nopaviṣṭaḥ prasādhayet |
nā 'nuvātaṃ na vivṛto na klānto nā 'nyamānasaḥ ||

uparaktaṃ ca bhāsvantaṃ
                        vāsasā vā tirohitam |

striyaṃ stravantīṃ nodakyāṃ
                        na nagnāṃ nā 'nyasaṅgatām |

pāyayantīṃ carantīṃ vā
                        nānyasmai gāṃ nivedayet |
tithiṃ pakṣasya na brūyāt nakṣatrāṇi na nirdiśet ||
sāyaṃ bhuktvā laghu hitaṃ samāhitamanāḥ śuciḥ ||

satvādyavasthā vividhāśca
                        tāstāḥ samyak samīkṣyā+ātmahitaṃ vidadhyāt |
anyo 'pi yaḥ kaścidihā 'sti mārgo hitopadeśeṣu bhajeta taṃ ca ||

iti caritamupetaḥ
                        sarvajīvopajīvyaṃ prathitapṛthuguṇaudho rakṣito devatābhiḥ |

samadhikaśatajīvī nirvṛtaḥ puṇyakarmā vrajati sugatinimno dehabhede 'pi
                        tuṣṭim ||

yadanurodhādādityādayaḥ khādayaśca mahābhūtaviśeṣāstathā tathā vipariṇamanto
                        janmavatāṃ janmamaraṇasyarturasavīryadopadehabalavyāpatsaṃ padāṃ ca
                        kāraṇatvaṃ patyayatāṃ pratipadyante ||

tatrākṣinimeṣo māntrā tāḥ
                        pañcadaśa kāṣṭhā tāstriṃśat kalā tāḥ sadaśabhāgā viṃśatirnāḍikā nāḍikādvayaṃ
                        muhūrtaśca te tulyarātrindive rāśibhāge catvāraḥ pādonā yāmaḥ
                        taiścaturbhiraho rātriśca pañcadaśāhorātrāḥ pakṣaḥ pakṣadvayaṃ māsaḥ sa
                        śuklāntaḥ tairmārgaśīrṣādibhirdvisaṃkhyaiḥ
                        kramāddhemantaśiśiravasantagrīṣmavarṣaśaradākhyāḥ ṣaḍṛtavo bhavanti teṣu
                        śiśirādayastrayo raverudagayanamādānañca śeṣā dakṣiṇāyanaṃ visargaśca
                        tāvādānavisargau varṣam ||

tayorādānamāgneyam tasmin khalu
                        kālasvabhāvamārgaparigṛhīto 'tyarthopṇagabhastijālamaṇḍalo
                        'rkastatsaṃparkādvāyavaśca tīvrarūkṣāḥ somajaṃ guṇamupaśoṣayanto jagataḥ
                        snehamādadānā ṛtukrameṇo pajanitaraukṣyā rūkṣān
                        rasāṃstiktakaṣāyakaṭukānabhiprabalayanto nṛṇāṃ daurbalyamāvahanti ||

vasargastu saumyaḥ tasminnapi
                        kālamārgameghavātavarṣābhihataprabhāve dakṣiṇāyanage 'rke śaśini
                        cāvyāhatabale śiśirābhirbhābhiḥ śaśvadāpyāyamāne māhendrasalila praśānta
                        santāpe jagatyarūkṣā rasāḥ pravardhante 'mlalavaṇamadhurā yathākramaṃ balaṃ
                        copacīyate nṛṇāmiti ||

hemante śiśire cāgryaṃ visargādānayorbalam śaradvasantayormadhyaṃ hīnaṃ
                        varṣānidāghayoḥ ||

raukṣyaṃ ca+ādānajaṃ tasmāt
                        kāryaḥ pūrvo 'dhikaṃ vidhiḥ |

diśo jvalanti bhūmiśca māruto
                        naiṛtaḥ sukhaḥ |

madyaṃ na sevyaṃ svalpaṃ vā
                        sevyaṃ subahuvāri vā |

sarāṃsi vāpiḥ saritaḥ kānanāni
                        himāni ca |

śaradi vyoma śubhrābhraṃ kiñcit
                        paṅkāṅkitā mahī |
taptānāṃ sañcitaṃ pūrvaṃ tadā pittaṃ prakupyati ||

asātmyajā hi rogāḥ syuḥ sahasā
                        tyāgaśīlanāt |

mūtrasya rodhāt pūrve ca prāyo
                        rogāḥ tadauṣadham |
mūtrajeṣu tu pāne ca prāgbhaktaṃ śasyeta ghṛtam ||

pravartayet kṣutiṃ saktāṃ
                        svedābhyaṅgau ca śīlayet |
tatra yojyaṃ laghu snigdhamuṣṇamalpaṃ ca bhojanam ||
śoṣo hidhmā ca kāryo 'tra kāsahā sutarāṃ vidhiḥ ||

sagulmā bāṣpatastatra svapno
                        madyaṃ priyāḥ kathāḥ |
bastiśuddhikaraiḥ siddhaṃ bhajet kṣīraṃ priyāḥ striyaḥ ||
nirdiṣṭaṃ sādhanaṃ tatra bhūyiṣṭhaṃ ye tu tān prati ||

ye tu saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhā na
                        teṣāṃ punarudbhavaḥ |
ghanātyaye vārṣikamāśu samyak prāpnoti rogānṛtujān na jātu ||
dātā samaḥ satyaparaḥ kṣamāvānāptopasevī ca bhavatyarogaḥ ||
jitendriyaṃ nānupatānti rogāstatkālayuktaṃ yadi nāsti daivam ||

kāle 'nukūlo viṣayā manojñā
                        dharmyāḥ kriyāḥ karma sukhānubandhi |
sattvaṃ vidheyaṃ viśadā ca buddhirbhavanti dhīrasya sadā sukhāya ||

śvete kaṣāyaṃ tatsvādu kṛṣṇe
                        tiktaṃ ca pāṇḍure |

sārasaṃ svādu laghu ca tāṭākaṃ
                        guru vātalam |

audbhidaṃ svādu pittaghnaṃ
                        svādu vāpījalaṃ gaghu |
nādeyaṃ vātalaṃ rūkṣaṃ kaṭukaṃ ca tadādiśet ||
anārtavaṃ ca yaddivyamārtavaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat ||

ajīrṇe kvathitaṃ cā++āme pakve
                        jīrṇe 'pi netarat |
śīte vidhirayaṃ tapte tvajīrṇe śiśiraṃ tyajet ||

pānīyaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇā
                        viśvameva ca tanmayam |
na hi toyādvinā vṛttiḥ svasthasya vyādhitasya vā ||

kevalaṃ sauṣadhaṃ
                        pakvamāmamuṣṇaṃ hitaṃ ca tat |

pāke svādu himaṃ vīrye
                        taduṣṇamapi yojitam |
madhye madhyāṅgatāṃ sāmyaṃ dhātūnāṃ jaraṇaṃ sukham ||

nālikerodakaṃ snigdhaṃ svādu
                        vṛṣyaṃ himaṃ laghu |

prāyaḥ payaḥ atra gavyaṃ tu
                        jīvanīyaṃ rasāyanam |

hastinyāḥ sthairyakṛt bāḍhaṃ
                        uṣṇaṃ tvaikaśaphaṃ laghu |
pīnase mūtrakuchre ca rūkṣaṃ tu grahaṇīgade ||

na cānāmalakaṃ nāpi nityaṃ no
                        mandamanyathā |

ikṣoḥ saro guruḥ snigdho
                        vṛṃhaṇaḥ kaphamūtrakṛt ||

kiñcit kālavidhṛtyā ca vikṛtiṃ
                        yāti yāntrikaḥ |

kurvate te svayaṃ yacca saviṣā
                        bhramarādayaḥ |
pracchardane nirūhe ca madhūṣṇaṃ na nivāryate ||

bhrāmaraṃ pauṣpikaṃ kṣaudraṃ
                        mākṣikaṃ ca yathottaram |
varaṃ jīrṇaṃ ca teṣvantye dve eva hyupayojayet ||

tailaṃ svayonivattatra mukhyaṃ
                        tīkṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca |
kākamadgu vasā tadvat kāraṇḍotthā ca ninditā ||
tadguṇā vāruṇī hṛdyā laghustīkṣṇā nihanti ca ||
vraṇe pāṇḍvāmaye kuṣṭhe na cātyarthaṃ virudhyate ||
mārdvikaṃ lekhanaṃ hṛdyaṃ nātyuṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ saram ||

maireyo madhuro hṛṣyaḥ saraḥ
                        santarpaṇo guruḥ |

drākṣāsavo madhusamaḥ paramaṃ
                        sa tu dīpanaḥ |
śāṇḍākī cā 'sutaṃ cānyat kālāmlaṃ rocanaṃ laghu ||
mahāṃstaṃ cānu kalamastaṃ cāpyanu tataḥ pare ||
snigdho grāhī laghuḥ svādustridoṣaghnaḥ sthiro himaḥ ||
koradūṣaḥ paraṃ grāī sparśe śīto viṣāpahaḥ ||

rūkṣaḥ śīto guruḥ svāduḥ saro
                        viḍvātakṛdyavaḥ |
vṛṣyaḥ śīto guruḥ snigdho jīvano vātapittahā ||
pathyā nandīmukhī śītā kaṣāyā madhurā laghuḥ ||
rūkṣā baddhamalāḥ śītā vipāke kaṭukā hitāḥ ||
ghnanti śukrāśmarīṃ śukraṃ dṛṣṭiṃ śophaṃ tathodaram ||
dṛkcchukrahṛt kaṭuḥ pāke tadvat bījaṃ kusumbhajam ||
navaṃ dhānyamabhiṣyandi sekyaṃ kedārajaṃ ca yat ||

vilepī grāhiṇī hṛdyā tṛṣṇāghnī
                        dīpanī hitā |

hṛdyaḥ pathyaḥ paraṃ vṛṣyo
                        bṛṃhaṇaḥ prīṇano rasaḥ |
piśitena rasastatra yūṣo dhānyaiḥ khalaḥ phalaiḥ ||

rasālā bṛṃhaṇī vṛṣyā snigdhā
                        balaya rucipradā |

viṣṭambhi mūtralaṃ hṛdyaṃ
                        yathādravyaguṇaṃ ca tat |

dhāna viṣṭambhinī rūkṣā tarpaṇī
                        lekhanī guruḥ |

saktavo laghavaḥ pānāt sadya
                        eva balapradāḥ |
nicayāt kaṭhinā gurvī proktā piṇḍī mṛdurlaghuḥ ||
na bhuktvā na dvijaiśchitvā saktūnadyānna vā bahūn ||

vartako vartikā ceti tittiriḥ
                        krakaraḥ śikhī |
laghīyān ṣaḍrasaścāsau grāhī rūkṣo himaḥ śaśaḥ ||

tadvacca kukkuṭo vṛṣyo
                        grāmyastu śleṣmalo guruḥ |
caṭakāḥ śleṣmalāḥ snigdhā vātaghnāḥ śukralāḥ param ||
kulīraḥ paramaṃ vṛṣyo bṛṃhaṇaḥ prīṇano guruḥ ||
sadyohataṃ vayasthaṃ ca śuddhaṃ surabhi śasyate ||

eṇaḥ kuraṅgo hariṇaḥ śaśo
                        lāvaḥ kapiñjalaḥ |

hanti doṣatrayaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ
                        vṛṣyā soṣṇā rasāyanī |
tiktaṃ pāke kaṭu grāhi vātalaṃ kaphapittajit ||
snigdhaṃ śītaṃ guru svādu bṛṃhaṇaṃ śukrakṛt param ||

pālakyā pichilā gurvvī
                        śleṣmalā bhedinī himā |
śākānāṃ pravarā nyūnā dvitīyā kiñcideva tu ||

satarūḍhaṃ kadambaṃ ca rūkṣaṃ
                        grāhi himaṃ guru |

ālūpāni ca sarvāṇi tathā
                        sūpyāni lakṣmaṇā |
laghupatrā tu yā cillī sā vāstukasamā matā ||

laghuruṣṇā sarā tiktā
                        sorupūkā ca lāṅgalī |
sakṣāraṃ madhuraṃ snigdhamuṣṇaṃ guru ca sārṣapam ||

rase pāke ca kaṭukaṃ
                        doṣotkleśakaraṃ laghu |

dīpanaḥ sūraṇo rucyaḥ
                        kaphaghno viśado laghuḥ |

patre puṣpe phale kande ca
                        gurutā kramāt |

sarvaṃ hṛdyaṃ laghu snigdhaṃ
                        grāhi rocanadīpanam |
ūrumāṇaṃ priyālaṃ ca bṛṃhaṇaṃ guru śītalam ||

nālikeraṃ guru snigdhaṃ
                        pittaghnaṃ svādu śītalam |

snigdhaṃ svādu kaṣāyaṃ ca
                        rājādanaphalaṃ guru |
phalaṃ tu pittalaṃ tālaṃ saraṃ kāśmaryajaṃ himam ||

pakvaṃ bālaṃ punastīkṣṇaṃ
                        pittalaṃ laghu dīpanam |

satiktaṃ svādu yat pīlu
                        nātyuṣṇaṃ tattridoṣajit |

svādvamlaṃ śītamuṣṇaṃ ca
                        dvidhā pārāvataṃ guru |

pakvamāśu jarāṃ yāti
                        nātyuṣṇaṃ guru doṣalam |

na śakyaṃ vistareṇāpi vaktuṃ
                        sarvaṃ tu sarvathā |
tatastato yato dṛṣṭāste te bhāvāstathā tathā ||
kuṣṭhaṃ tatkāryapi tilo hanti bhallātakaiḥ saha ||

saktavo vātalā rūkṣāḥ pītāste
                        tarpayanti tu |

medhyastilaḥ sparśaśīto
                        medhyaṃ tailaṃ khalo himaḥ |
tasyaiva śleṣmakāritvaṃ na tailasya khalasya vā ||
dehasātmyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ madyaṃ māsaṃ ca kasyacit ||
sātmyaṃ hyāśu balaṃ dhatte nātidoṣaṃ ca bahvapi ||

sraṃsanaṃ sat payo gavyaṃ
                        bhavati grāhi kasyacit |

takramāmaṃ kaphaṃ koṣṭhe
                        hanti kaṇṭhe karoti tu |
dṛṣṭe sparśahimaṃ dravyaṃ śrotrasyoṣṇaṃ tu pūjitam ||

payaḥ svādu saraṃ śītaṃ
                        viparītaṃ tato dadhi |

payo dadhi ca vātaghnamajātaṃ
                        vātalaṃ tu tat |
śīte na tu tadādyante snigdhāmlalavaṇā hitāḥ ||

ṛtuṣvanyo raseṣvanyo raukṣye
                        snehe bale kramaḥ |
jvare peyā kaṣāyāśca sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ virecanam ||

ahitāḥ saktavaḥ śuṣkā hitāste
                        tu pramehiṇaḥ |
tadeva madyaṃ madyasya viṣasya tu viṣāntaram ||
te taireva punardaṣṭāḥ sadyo jahati jīvitam ||
sarvāṅgavyāpi teṣāṃ ca śukravat saṃsṛtaṃ viṣam ||
chardighnī makṣikāviṭ ca makṣikaiva tu vāmayet ||
tulye 'pi deśakālādau laṅghanaṃ na samaṃ matam ||

athāto 'nnarakṣāvidhimadhyāyaṃ
                        vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ ||

īśvarāṇāṃ vasumatāṃ viśeṣeṇa tu
                        bhūbhujāṃ prāyeṇa mitrebhyo 'pyamitrā bhūyāṃso bhavanti |

tasmādrājā kulīnaṃ snigdhamāptamāstikarmāyarmāyaparigrahaṃ dakṣaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ
                        nibhṛtaṃ śucimanuddhatamanalasamavyasaninamanahaṅkṛtamakopanamasāhasikaṃ
                        vākyārthāvabodhakuśalaṃ niṣṇātamaṣṭāṅge yathāmrāyamāryuvede
                        suvihitayogakṣemaṃ sannihitāgadādiyogaṃ sātmyajñaṃ ca prāṇācāryaṃ
                        parigṛhṇīyāt |
tamarthamānābhyāṃ yathākālaṃ gurumiva śiṣayaḥ pitaramiva putraḥ pūjayet |
na hi bhadro 'pi gajapatirniraṅkuśaḥ ślāghanīyo janasya |

te hi pramādaparigatā duḥkhāsahiṣṇavaśca svayamapyapathyarucayaḥ
                        sannihitāhitapriyavacanaprāyaparicārakāśca tasmādbhiṣajo rājā rājagṛhāsanne
                        niveśanaṃ kārayet |

sa samyaksampannamannaṃ
                        suparīkṣitaṃ viśuddhamagnyādiṣu prāgupanītaṃ śikhinā dṛṣṭamabhiprokṣitaṃ
                        prokṣāṇaiḥ puraḥsthito rājānaṃ hastabaddhauṣadhiratnaṃ bhojayet ||
pakvaṃ ca sadyaḥ paryuṣitamiva nirūṣma stabdhaṃ ca jāyate

kvāthaḥ dhyāmatā śyāmatā hīnātiriktavikṛtānāṃ cātracchāyānāṃ
                        darśanamadarśanameva vā
viśeṣeṇa lavaṇolbaṇeṣu phenamālā rasasya madhye nīlā rājiḥ

triphalātrikaṭunāgapuṣpamadhukabarhiṇaparṇībṛhatīdvayacūrṇaṃ
                        siṃhavyāghravṛkatarakṣudvīpimārjārasṛgālamṛgagodhānāmanyatamapittarasasaṃyuktaṃ
                        sakṣaudraṃ pānameṣa jīvano nāmāgadaḥ paraṃ sarvaviṣauṣadham |

tasmin jīrṇe śyāmāvyoṣātiviṣāsiddhena payasā ghṛtena vopastambhitāṃ
                        mudgayūṣeṇa kiṃcillavaṇena sasarpiṣkeṇa mṛdvodanaṃ bhojayet |

tatra nīlinīphalayuktena sarpiṣā virecanaṃ samākṣikaṃ ca dūṣīviṣāriṃ dadhnā
                        pāyayet |

dantakāṣṭhaprayukte tu viṣe kūrcakaviśaraṇamauṣadhagandho rūkṣatā
                        tāludantajihvoṣṭhamāṃsaśophaśca tatra pracchāya
                        dhātakīpuṣpajāmbavāsthiharītakīcūrṇaiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ saptacchadakalkena vā
                        pratisāraṇaṃ kuryāt |

kapitthameṣaśṛṅgībhallātakānāṃ puṣpairvaraṇaniryāsena vāñjanaṃ
                        bṛhatīśirīṣabījaprapauṇḍarīkanāgabalācūrṇaṃ saptakṛtvo madhunā bhāvayet |

tatrātiviṣāśvetākākamācīmadayantikākalke kṣīrasiddhaṃ sarpirnnasye pāne ca
                        vidadhyāt ||

tatra śyāmāpālindītaṇḍulīyakacūrṇa ghṛtarkṣapittaiḥ subhāvitayā kṛṣṇamṛdā
                        pralepaḥ |

tatra bahupatrāsvaraso ghṛtakṣaudrasaṃyuktaḥ pratipūraṇaṃ somavalkaraso vā
                        suśītaḥ |

ghreyāṇi ghrāpayitvā tu spṛśyān
                        saṃspṛśya tānapi |

tato vijñāya śuddhiṃ ca
                        bhājanasyodakasya ca |

prasthānaṃ vā niveśaṃ vā
                        nāvijñāya prayojayet |
chardirmūrchā jvaro mohaḥ śiroduḥkhaṃ ca jāyate ||
sarvagandhaiḥ samaṃ yojya pacetpakve ca nikṣipet ||
cāraṭīṃ trāyamāṇāṃ ca prokṣayettena tāṃ bhuvam ||
bahuśo gālitaṃ tacca pācayettatra ca kṣipet ||

vividhān kurvate yogān kuśalāḥ
                        khalu mānavāḥ |

atha śuklapakṣe puṇye 'hani
                        puṣyapunarvasuhastacitrāmṛgaśiraḥśravaṇarevatīśatabhiṣakprājāpatyottarāṇāmanyatamena
                        nakṣatreṇa yogamupagate bhagavatyauṣadhipatau praśaste muhūrte
                        sindhusrotaḥsamutthaṃsnigdhaṃ saprabhaṃ
                        gandhavarṇacchadairnīlotpalābhamañjanamāharet |

tataścāryāvalokiteśvaramāryatārāṃ
                        brahmadakṣāśvirudrendradityasomavaruṇavaiśvānaravāyuviṣṇujanakabharadvājadhanvantarisuśrutabhavyasukanyāskandaścyavanavainateyānanyāṃśca
                        yathāvidhyuktadevatāḥ sumano
                        'kṣatalājasvastikasaṃyāvanistuṣayavasaṃskṛtaguḍaghṛtamiśrapāyasairarcayitvāvṛddhavaidyabrahmaṇāṃśca
                        śuklavāsaso mahatībhirdakṣiṇābhiḥ pūjayitvā tasminnagnau tadañjanaṃ dhmātaṃ
                        dhmātamāvṛtya pṛthakpṛthaṅniṣecayet |
tataḥ śukle vāsasi badhvā dvādaśarātra māntarikṣe 'mbhāsi vāsayet |

tataśchāyāyāṃ viśoṣya sphaṭikamuktāpravālakālanusāryāpratīvāpaṃ punarapi
                        balimaṅgalapūrvakamahatavāsasā kanyayā dṛṣadi
                        peṣayitvāsuvarṇarajatatāmraśaṅkhaśailadviradaradanagavayaśṛṅgavaiḍūryasphaṭikameṣaśṛṅgyasanasārānyatamaghaṭṭitāyāmañjanikāyāṃ
                        nidhāpayet |

atha pūrvavatpunarapi kṛtasvastyayanaṃ sāvitreṇa karmaṇā sarvavit dvijanmā
                        vidhivattadabhisaṃskuryāt |

tato gajaskandhamāropya pāṇḍuracchatracāmarabālavyajanairanugataṃ tathā
                        śaṅkhadundubhisvanairdvijātivaraprayuktaiśca vedavādamiśraiḥ puṇyāhaghoṣaiḥ
                        kṛtapuṣpopahāraṃ vaidyagṛhānnāyakagṛhamanupraveśayet |

anantaraṃ ca tena videhādhipopadiṣṭena sarvārtheṣu siddhenāñjanena
                        yathoktānāmevāñjanabhājanadravyāṇāmanyatamayā śalākayā
                        gobrāhmaṇapūjāpūrvakaṃ śuciḥ saniyamo bhūtvā dhāraṇīmimāṃ vidyāmadhīyānaḥ
                        pūtaḥ pūrvamakṣi dakṣiṇamañjayet ||

atha mantraḥ
                        namaścakṣuḥpariśodhanarājāya tathāgatāyarhate samyaksambuddhāya tadyathā auṃ
                        cakṣuḥ prajñācakṣurjñānacakṣurvijñānacakṣurviśodhaya svāhā ||

tataḥ paraṃ ca tāmeva
                        dhāriṇīmanusmaran sāyamprātaḥ patyahametatparamaṃ
                        pavitramārogyakaramūrjaskaraṃ sarvaviṣaghnamañjanamaśvibhyāmindrasya
                        vṛtravadhābhyudyatasya prākprakalpitam |

tasmodatadrājñāṃ rājamahāmātrāṇāṃ ca mahīṃ vijagīṣamāṇānāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca
                        vedādhyayanamanyadvā mahacchāstramavagāhamānānāṃ prasannamanā
                        bhiṣakprakalpayediti |
yān sevamāno nṛpatiḥ śatrubhyo naiti pajcatām ||

saviṣaṃ prokṣitaṃ tena sadyo
                        bhavati nirvisam |
tataḥ kṛtvā maṇiṃ hemnā baddhaṃ hastena dhārayet ||

saṃspṛṣṭaṃ saviṣaṃ tena sadyo
                        bhavati nirviṣam |
śrutvā dṛṣṭvā samāghrāya sadyo bhavati nirviṣam ||

viṣaṃ bhuktaṃ jarāṃ yāti
                        nirviṣe 'pi na doṣakṛt |

na tatra kīṭāḥ saviṣā nondurā
                        na sarīsṛpāḥ |
na kṛtyā karṣaṇā(kārmaṇā)dyāśca dhūpo 'yaṃ yatra dahyate ||

sarpiḥ kṣaudraṃ dadhi
                        kṣīramantataḥ śītalaṃ jalam |
śuddhe hṛdi tataḥ śāṇaṃ hemacūrṇasya dāpayet ||

vastrādi rājñā sadṛśaṃ
                        rājalīlāṃ ca varjayet |

pāto yathā hi duḥkhāya
                        nocchrāyaḥ sukhakṛttathā |
upahāraṃ ca sandhyāyāṃ bhuktvā cānte niśāsu ca ||

saṅkṣepa eṣa
                        viṣapālanasādhanāya proktastu vistaravidhiḥ punaruttare tu |

ālocya samyagakhilaṃ matipūrvakārī yuñjīta taṃ parivikalpya vikāracihnam
                        ||

nijapararipuvṛndairapradhṛṣyo mahātmā janayati janatāyāḥ kṣemayogau cirāya
                        ||

sa punaḥ śakalī lohitanayanaḥ sarvato lohitarājirlohitaprabhākaraḥ prāyo
                        bhūmau carati so 'tyābhiṣyanditamatvāt sutarāṃ vyādhīnupajanayatyāmaviṣaṃ ca
                        ||
pauṣkaraṃ rauhiṇīkaṃ jātukaṃ vā śākaṃ saha madhupyobhyāṃ nābhyavaharet |

tathā sarṣapatailabhṛṣṭānāṃ matsyabadarāṇāṃ badarāṇi śvāvidvarāhamāṃsaṃ
                        caikadhyaṃ pittenāmamāṃsāni

dadhnā kukkuṭaṃ pṛṣataṃ ca kusumbhaśākenairaurabhraṃ sauvīrakeṇa
                        tilaśaṣkulīḥ
dadhnā māṣasūpena guḍena madhunā ghṛtena vā lakucaphalaṃ

tāmeva matsyapacane śṛṅgiverapacane vā bhājane siddhāmanyatra vā siddhāṃ
                        rātrimuṣitāṃ

madhupuṣkarabījaṃ padmottarikāśākaṃ śārkaro mairayo madhu ca sahopayuktaṃ
                        viruddham |

kṣīraṃ kulatthaiḥ panasena
                        matsyaistaptaṃ dadhi kṣaudraghṛte samāṃśe |
vāryūṣare rātriṣu saktavaśca toyāntarāste yavakāstathā ca ||

kuryādviruddhamaśanaṃ jvaramastrapittamaṣṭau gadāṃśca mahato viṣavacca mṛtyum
                        ||

nidrāyattaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ
                        puṣṭiḥ kārśyaṃ balābalam |
vṛṣatā klībatā jñānamajñānaṃ jīvitaṃ na ca ||

saiva yuktā punaryuṅkte nidrā
                        dehaṃ sukhāyuṣā |

rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ
                        snigdhaṃ prasvapanaṃ divā |
dhātusāmyaṃ tathā hyeṣāṃ śleṣmā cāṅgāni puṣyati ||
viṣārttaḥ kaṇṭharogī ca naiva jātu niśāsvapi ||

eta eva ca vijñeyā nidrānāśasya
                        hetavaḥ |

arddhatrirātrātsā sādhyā na sā
                        sādhyā tataḥ param |

pravāte surabhau deśe sukhāṃ
                        śayyāṃ yathocite |

sarpiḥ kṣīrānupānaṃ ca
                        jīvanīyaiḥ śṛtaṃ pibet |
nidrā bibhartti prathamā śarīraṃ pāpmāntagā vyādhinimittamanyāḥ ||

grāmyadharmapravṛttau tu
                        rajasvalāmaniṣṭāmaniṣṭācārāmaśastāmatisthūlāmatikṛśāṃ garbhiṇīṃ
                        sūtikāmanuttānāṃ vikṛtāṅgāṃ gaṇikāmaprajasaṃ duṣṭayonimanyayonimanyastriyaṃ
                        viśeṣācca vayovarṇavṛddhāṃ sagotrāṃ gurumitrabandhubhṛtyapatnīṃ varṇinīṃ
                        tathā
                        caityacatvaracatuṣpathopavanaśmaśānāghātasalilauṣadhadvijagurusuranṛpālayeṣvahani
                        gosarge madhyandine 'rddharātrau parveṣvanaṅge pipāsurapraṇītasaṅkalpo vā na
                        gacchet |
viśeṣeṇa cātivyāyatāṃ garbhiṇīṃ navaprasūtāmṛtumatīṃ saṃvṛtayoniṃ ca |

dvyahādvasante tasyānte
                        pakṣāttadvat ghanodaye seveta kāmataḥ kāmaṃ hemante śiśire balī |
evaṃ cāpyāyate śīghraṃ teṣāṃ śukraṃ ca dhāma ca ||

naconaḥ ṣoḍaśādvarṣāt saptateḥ
                        parato na ac |

śuṣkaṃ rūkṣaṃ yathā kāṣṭhaṃ
                        jantujagdhaṃ vijarjaram |
spṛṣṭamāśu viśīryeta tathā vṛddhaḥ striyaṃ vrajan ||

kāyasya tejaḥ paramaṃ hi
                        śukramāhārasāradapi sārabhūtam |
jitātmanā tat parirakṣaṇīyaṃ tato vapuḥ santatirapyudārā ||
na hi sarvāṇyapathyāni tulyadoṣāṇi naiva ca ||

sarve tulyabalā doṣā na sarvāṇi
                        vapūṃṣi ca |
ata eva ca caryāyāṃ hemantaśiśire same ||
daive puruṣakāre ca sthitaṃ tasya balābalam ||

madhyā madhyasya miśrasya
                        saṅkīrṇā śruṇu cāparam |

tathā daivena balinā pauruṣaṃ
                        karma durbalam |

śyenādinā ca yāgena
                        bhrātṛvyasya tathā ca taiḥ |
upekṣayā na maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ vā cikitsayā ||

yathā ratho vāhyamāno nyāyena
                        kramaśaḥ kṣayam |

sa evāto yathā ca
                        syādviparīto viparyaye |
parivartuṃ na tat prāpya śocitavyaṃ manīṣiṇā ||

athātmavān
                        svabhāvasaṃyogasaṃskāramātrādeśakālopayogavyavasthāḥ
                        saptāhārakalpanāviśeṣāṇāṃ svāsthyāsvāsthyaphalānāṃ hetubhūtāḥ samīkṣya
                        hitameva anurudhyeta |

tatra saṃyogo nāma
                        dvayorbahūnāṃ vādravyāṇāṃ saṃhatībhāvaḥ |
mātrā punaḥ piṇḍaparimāṇataḥ samudāyena pratidravyāpekṣayā cāhārarāśiḥ |

ajīrṇe 'pi pūrvasyāhārasyāpariṇato rasa uttareṇopasaṃsṛjyamānaḥ sarvān doṣān
                        prakopayatyāśu |

jīrṇe tu svasthānastheṣu doṣeṣu vātānulomyādutsṛṣṭeṣu mūtrapurīṣavegeṣu
                        viśuddheṣūdgārahṛdayasrotomukheṣu viśadakaraṇe laghuni śarīre 'gnāvudīrṇe
                        jātāyā
                        bubhukṣāyāmabhyavahṛtamannamapradūṣayaddoṣānāyurbalavarṇānabhivarddhayati |

atītakālaṃ
                        punastadvātaviṣṭabdhaṃ kṛcchrādvipacyate karśayatyannaruciṃ ca punarupahanti
                        |

upayogavyavasthā tu nāsnāto na digvāsā naikavastradhṛk na malinavasano
                        nāhutvā na japitvā nānirūpya devatābhyo na pitṛbhyo na datvāgramannamagnaye
                        na gurubhyo nātithaye nābhyāgatebhyo na śvavayaḥśvapacebhyaḥ pratyavekṣya
                        cāśritopāśitānapi tiraśco 'pi svaparigṛhītān praśastadeśakālopakaraṇayuktaḥ
                        sragvī vibhūṣitaḥ surandhirārdrapāṇipādaḥ suviśuddhavadano 'bhimatasahāyaḥ
                        keśamakṣikādyanupajuṣṭamanindyamanindannaninditamapunaruṣṇīkṛtaṃ
                        nātyuṣṇamanupadagdhaṃ susiddhamalolo nāsātmyaṃ nāviditaṃ nāviditāgamaṃ
                        nātisāyaṃ nātiprage nākāśe nātape nāndhakāre nādho vṛkṣasya na śyyāstho
                        nonnamya pradeśinīṃ na pātre bhinne nāsaṃvṛte na maline bhāvadūṣite vā na
                        cāsanasthite na hastasthe na haste prāṅmukhaḥ sumanāḥ
                        śucibhaktākṣudhitānukūlajanopahitaṃ hitamannamaśrīyāt |

snigdhalaghūṣṇāni hi
                        vahnimaudaryamudīrayanti koṣṭhaṃ pariśodhayānti dhātūnna vikurvate kṣipraṃ
                        jarayanti anilamanulomayanti |

tathā snigdhaṃ dṛḍhīkarotīndriyāṇyupacinoti śarīramapacinoti jarasaṃ
                        balamabhivarddhayati varṇaprasādamabhinirvarttayati |

vilambitaṃ tu bhuñjāno na tṛptimadhigacchati bahu ca bhuṅkte śītībhavati
                        cānnajātaṃ viṣamapākaṃ ca bhavati |

atidrutaṃ tu bhuñjānasya jalpato hasto 'nyamanaso vā
                        bhavedutsnehanamavasādanaṃ bhojanasyāpratiṣṭhānaṃ guṇadoṣāvibhāvanaṃ ca
                        ||

samīkṣya samyagātmānamiti
                        mamedaṃ sātmyamidamasātmyamiti nityamapramattaḥ pratyavekṣeta |
tatra sātmyaṃ nāma sahātmanā bhavatyabhyastaṃ tadaucityādupaśeta ityeke |
tatra sarvarasaṃ pravaramekarasamavaraṃ madhyaṃ tu madhyamameva |
itareṣāmapi krameṇa sātmyamapi cāhitaṃ pādena vā vivarjayedityuktaṃ prāk |

tatra yadāhārajātaṃ samadhātūnanuvarttayati viṣamāṃśca samīkaroti tatsamāsato
                        hitam |

tat punarmātrāyogādivaicitryādaniyatamapi yathopadeśaṃ yathābhūyiṣṭhaṃ ca
                        śīlayet pariharecca ||

tathā viśeṣataḥ
                        samaśanamadhyaśanamamātraśanaṃ viṣamāśanaṃ ca varjayet |
bhuñjānastu peyāyūṣarasān vyañjanāni rājateṣu pātreṣu nidadhyāt |

ghṛtamāyase payaḥ suśītaṃ tāmramaye pānīya pānakāni ca
                        mṛddhemasphaṭikakācamayeṣu audanaṃ ca vistīrṇe manorame sthāne |
savye peyaṃ lehyaṃ mukhodgharṣaṇapiṇḍīṃ ca madhye bhojyamiti |

tacchītaṃ dadhimadhuyavagodhūmamadyaviśeṣeṣu sarveṣu ca vidāhiṣu śarad
                        grīṣmayośca |
uṣṇaṃ piṣṭamayeṣvanyeṣu ca durjareṣu hemante ca |
madyaṃ māṃseṣu phalāmlamambu vāsavāṃśca vividhān vibhajya prayojayet |
viśeṣatastu madhvāsavān grāmyeṣu tīkṣṇān triphalāsavān vanyeṣu |

nyagrodhādiphalāsavān viṣkireṣu arkaśeluśirīṣakapitthāsavān bileśayeṣu
                        digdhahateṣu ca |

amlaphalāsavān prasaheṣu kāśekṣupadmabījaśṛṅgāṭakakaśerukamṛdvīkākhadirāsavān
                        kṣaudrayuktaṃ vā śītamudakamudaścidvā mahāmṛgeṣvaudakeṣu ca |
surāṃ pratudeṣu tathā śramārtteṣu kṛśeṣu ca |

anupānaṃ khalu tarpayati
                        prīṇayatyūrjayati bṛṃhayati dehasya paryāptimabhinirvartayati
                        bhuktamavasādayatyannasaṅghātaṃ bhinatti mārdavamāpādayati kledayati
                        sukhapariṇāmitāmāśuvyavāyitāṃ cāhārasyopajanayati |

teṣāṃ hi pradūṣyāmāśayamuraḥkaṇṭhasthitamāhārajaṃ snehamāsādya
                        tadabhiṣyandāgnisādacchardyādīnāmayān vidadhyāt |

tataḥ
                        pāṇigatamannamanyenāpanīya dantāntarasthaṃ ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ śodhanena
                        viśodhya lepagandhasnehāpanodamācānto
                        'ṅgulyagragalitāmbupariṣiktanetrastāmbūlādikṛta vadanavaiśadyo
                        dhūmapānādihṛtordhvakaphavegaḥ padaśatamātraṃ gatvā vāmapārśvena saṃviśet |
tadyathā ūṣmā vāyuḥ snehaḥ kledaḥ kālaḥ samayogaśca |

tatroṣmā pacati vāyurapakarṣati sneho mārdavaṃ janayati klaidaḥ
                        śaithilyamāpādayati kālaḥ sarvavapurvyāptimabhinirvarttayati |

samayogasya tu punaḥ kāraṇānyucito hitaśca dehasaṃskāro 'bhyavahāraśceṣṭā
                        śayanaṃ saumanasyaṃ ca |

tanumapi tanujāṃ rujāṃ
                        tvanāpya vrajati naraḥ sa samāśatasya pāram ||

kukṣerapratipīḍanamāhāreṇa hṛdayasyāsaṃrodhaḥ
                        pārśvayoravipāṭanamanatigauravamudarasya prīṇanamindriyāṇāṃ
                        kṣutpipāsoparatiḥ sthānāsanaśayanagamanocchvāsapraśvāsabhāṣyasaṅkathāsu
                        sukhānuvṛttiḥ sāyaṃ prātaśca sukhena pariṇamanaṃ balavarṇopacayakaratvaṃ
                        ceti mātrāyā lakṣaṇam ||

tena hi prapīḍyamānā vātādayo yugapatprakupitāḥ
                        kukṣyaikadeśasthāstadevāparipakvamāviśya viṣṭambhayanto
                        'lasakamabhinirvartayanti |
prayāti nordhvaṃ nādhastādāhāro na ca pacyate |

śleṣmā tu chardyarocakaprasekāṅgasādāvipākaśītajvaragātragauravāṇi
                        viśeṣatastu durbalasyālpavahnerbahuśleṣmaṇovātamūtrapurīṣavegavidhāriṇo
                        'nnapānamanilaprapīḍitaṃ śleṣmaṇāvibaddhamārgamalasatvādabahirmukhībhavat
                        chardyatīsāravarjyāni yathoktāni śūlādīnyupajanayatyatimātrāṇi |

atimātraduṣṭāstu doṣāḥ śarīraṃ daṇḍavat stambhayanti tatastamalasakamasādhyaṃ
                        bruvate ||

na ca kevalaṃ mātrayaiva kṛtsnamāhāraphalamavāptuṃ śakyaṃ svabhāvādīnāṃ
                        bhinnaphalatvāt ||

gururūkṣaśuṣkaśītadviṣṭaviṣṭambhividāahyaśuciviruddhātyambupānadravamakāle
                        kāle vā kāmakrodhalobherṣyādvrīśokodvegabhayakṣudupataptena vā
                        yadannapānamupayujyate tadapyāmameva pradūṣayati ||

tatra sādhyamānaṃ
                        duṣṭamalasībhūtamullikhet pāyayitvā salavaṇamuṣṇaṃ vāri |
udvarttanaṃ khalliviṣūcikāghnaṃ tailaṃ vipakvaṃ ca tadarthakāri ||

āmadoṣeṣu tvannakāle
                        jīrṇāhāraṃ doṣopaliptāmāśayaṃ stimitagurukoṣṭhamanannābhilāṣiṇamabhisamīkṣya
                        pāyayeddoṣaśeṣapācanārthamauṣadhaṃ vahnisandhukṣaṇārthaṃ ca |

tena hyanilānalavṛdhyā vātātapaparīta ivālpaḥ salilāśayo 'lpadoṣaḥ
                        praśoṣamāpadyate |

laṅghanapācanābhyāṃ madhyadoṣe vātātapābhyāṃ pāṃsubhasmāvakiraṇairiva
                        cānatimahān salilāśayaḥ |
sati tvanubandhe nidānaviparītamapāsya vyādhiviparītameva tadarthakāri vā |

vimuktāmadoṣasya punaḥ paripakvāmadoṣaśeṣasya dīpte
                        cāgnāvabhyaṅgāsthāpanānuvāsanaṃ vividhasnehapānaṃ ca yuktyā prayojyam |

vyoṣaṃ karañjasya phalaṃ
                        haridre mūlaṃ samāvāpya ca mātuluṅgyāḥ |

laṅghanaṃ kāryamāme tu
                        viṣṭabdhe svedanaṃ bhṛśam |
vidagdhe vamanaṃ yadvā yathāvasthaṃ hitaṃ bhavet ||
ajīrṇe sāyamāśe tu prātarāśo hi duṣyati ||

rātrau tu hṛdaye mlāne
                        saṃvṛteṣvayaneṣu ca |
jāyeta duṣṭā tu tato budhukṣā yā mandabuddhīn viṣavannihanti ||
teṣu vakṣyamāṇaṃ hemādi lavaṇāntaṃ prāyeṇa bhaumam |
punarapi ca trividhaṃ daivavyapāśrayaṃ yuktivyapāśrayaṃ satvāvajayaśceti |
tatra śastrādisādhye bheṣajamanukramate na tu bheṣajasādhye śastrādi ||

yacca doṣaśamanatve satyapi
                        jvare viśeṣato hitaṃ mustā parpaṭakaṃ yavāgvaśca pramehe rajanī yavānnaṃ
                        cetyādi |

tathā chardyāṃ chardanamatisāre virecanaṃ madātyayemadyapānaṃ tutthadagdhe
                        'gnipratapanaṃ pitte 'ntarnnigūḍhe vimārgage vā svedaḥ
                        kaṭvamlalavaṇatīkṣṇoṣṇābhyavahāraśca bahiḥ pravarttanāya svamārgāpādanāya ca
                        |

śleṣmaṇi cāntarnigūḍhe stabdhe bahiḥ śītopacārastatpīḍitasyoṣmaṇo
                        'ntaḥpraveśena kapho vilayatāmupayāti |

evaṃvidhaṃ hyaviparītameva sat bheṣajaṃ hetuvyādhiviparītamarthaṃ karoti
                        ||

rūpyaṃ snigdhaṃ kaṣāyāmla
                        vipāke madhuraṃ rasam |
lekhanaṃ pittalaṃ kiñcit trapu sīsaṃ ca tadguṇam ||
tutthakaṃ kaṭu sakṣāraṃ kaṣāyaṃ viṣadaṃ laghu ||

viṣyandi lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ
                        sūkṣmaṃ sṛṣṭamalaṃ viduḥ |

saidhanvaṃ tatra sasvādu
                        vṛṣyaṃ hṛdyaṃ tridoṣanut |
romakaṃ laghu pāṃsūtthaṃ sakṣāraṃ śleṣmalaṃ guru ||

kaṣāyā madhurā pāke rūkṣā
                        vilavaṇā laghuḥ |
dīpanī pācanī medhyā vayasaḥ sthāpanī param ||
paraṃ ca kaṇṭhyaṃ cakṣuṣyaṃ hṛdyaṃ dāhajvarāpaham ||

paraṃ keśyastu tanmajjā
                        śukraghnaṃ ca tato 'ñjanam |

rase pāke ca kaṭukaṃ
                        kaphaghnaṃ maricaṃ laghu |
śleṣmalā svādu śītārdrā gurvīṃ snigdhā ca pippalī ||

sā śuṣkā viparītātaḥsnigdhā
                        vṛṣyā rase kaṭuḥ |
nāgaraṃ dīpanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ grāhi hṛdyaṃ vibandhanut ||
vraṇyaḥ svaryaḥ kaṭuḥ pāke rukṣaḥ sūkṣmo 'gnidīpanaḥ ||

laghu raktaṃ tathośīraṃ
                        vālakaṃ pācanaṃ ca tat |
guru svādu himaṃ vṛṣyaṃ cakṣuṣyṃ svaravarṇakṛt ||

balātrayaṃ svādu vṛṣyaṃ
                        snigdhaṃ śītaṃ balapradam |
bhedi sammohakṛt pūgaṃ kaṣāyaṃ svādu rocanam ||
kaphaghnaṃ kaitakaṃ tiktaṃ śairīṣaṃ viṣahāri ca ||

bandhūkaṃ śleṣmalaṃ grāhi
                        tadvadeva ca yūthikā |
paścimaḥ śiśiro hanti mūrcchāṃ dāhaṃ tṛṣaṃ viṣam ||

uttaro mārutaḥ snigdho
                        mṛdurmadhura eva ca |
rasādibhedairiti bheṣajānā diṅmātramuktaṃ na yato 'sti kiñcit |

bastiṣu tu teṣu teṣvavasthāntareṣuyānyupayujyante dravyāṇi
                        tānyasaṅkhyeyatvānnopadiśyante |
rasaskandhebhya eva yathādoṣaṃ yathāvasthaṃ ca vibhajet |

rājādanamajjakṣaudralavaṇāni madyāni gavādiśakṛdrasamūtrapittānyevaṃvidhāni
                        cendriyopaśayānyanyānyapi tathā snehāḥ kṣīraṃ raktaṃ māṃsaraso
                        dhānyarasastoyamiti śirovirecanopayogīni ||

madhukapadmakamañjiṣṭhāśārivāmustāpunnāganāgakesarailavālukasuvarṇatvaktamālapṛthvīkāhareṇulākṣāśatapuṣpāsallakīśarkarāmadanakamarubakanyagrodhodumbarāśvatthaplakṣalodhratvak
                        padmotpalāni sarvagandhadravyāṇi ca kuṣṭhatagaravarjyāni
                        prāyogikadhūmopayogīni
                        agaruguggulusallakīśaileyakanaladahrīberahareṇūśīramustādhyāmakavarāṅgaśrīveṣṭakasthauṇeyakaparipelavailavālukakundurukasarjarasayaṣṭyāhvaphalasārasnehamadhūcchiṣṭabilvaphalamajjayavatilamāṣakuṅkumāni
                        medomajjavasāsarpīṣi ca snaihikadhūmopayogīni |

śirovirecanadravyāṇi gandhadravyāṇi ca tīkṣṇāni manohvā haritālaṃ ceti
                        tīkṣṇadhūmopayogīni ||

bhadradārukuṣṭhatagaravaruṇabalātibalārtagalakacchurāhlādinīkuberākṣīvatsādinyarkālarkakatakabhārṅgīkārpāsīvṛścikālīpattūraprabhṛtīni
                        vidāryādigaṇo vīratarādi stṛṇākhyavarjyāni ṣaṭ pañcamūlāni ceti vātaśamanāni
                        |

dūrvānantāmocarasamañjiṣṭhāparipelavakālākālīyakakadalīkandalīpayasyātmaguptānālikerakharjjūradrākṣāvidārībadarībalānāgabalānāgapuṣpaśatāvarīśīta
                        pākyodanapākītṛṇaśūlyāṃśumatīdvayāriṣṭakāriṣṭāṭarūṣaketkaṭarpriyaṅgudhātakīdhavadhavadhanvanasyandanakhadirakadarapriyālatālasālasarjatiniśāśvakarṇagundrāvānīrapadmāpadmakapadmabījamṛṇālakumudanalinasaugandhikapuṇḍarīkaśatapatraśaivālakalhārotpalakākolyutpalikāśalūkaśṛṅgāṭakakaśerukakrauñcādanaprabhṛtīni
                        anyāni ca śītavīryāṇi sārivādiḥ padmakādiḥ paṭolāadirnyagrodhādirdāhaharo
                        mahākaṣāyastṛṇapañcamūlaṃ ceti pittaśamanāni |

śītaśivaśatapuṣpāsaralasuradārurāsneṅgu
                        dīsātalāsumanaḥkākādanīlāṅgalikāhastikarṇamuñjātalāmajjakaprabhṛtīnyanyāni
                        ca rūkṣoṣṇavīryāṇyāragvadhādirasanādirarkādiḥ
                        surasādirmuṣkakādirvatsakādirmustādiḥ śītaghnaśca mahākaṣāyo
                        vallīkaṇṭakapañcamūle ca śleṣmaśamanānīti ||

athāto
                        mahākaṣāyasaṅgrahamadhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ
                        ||
ye tu sutarāmupayogavantaḥ prakarṣavartino vā te jīvanīyādisaṃjñāḥ |

śakyaṃ hi buddhimadbhiḥ svāduśītasnigdhādīn jīvantyādiṣu sādhāraṇān
                        guṇānālocya kṣīrekṣudrākṣākṣoḍavidārīkandādiṣvapi tadguṇeṣu
                        jīvanīyāditvamavadhārayitum |

yadyapi tāni tānyeva dravyāṇīti dravyasaṅkaraḥ kaṣāyeṣu tathāpi na
                        saṃjñāvirodhaḥ |
tatra lavaṇavarjyā rasāḥ kalpanāyāṃ kaṣāyā ityucayante |

haimavatī ciribilvaṃ mustā
                        kuṣṭhaṃ vacā haridre ca |
iti balyo daśako 'yaṃ hayagandhā rohiṇī ṛṣabhaḥ ||
hidhmāṃ nighnanti śaṭī durālabhā badarabījaṃ ca ||
bhṛṣṭā ca mṛt payasyā saśālmalī viḍvirajanāni ||

kamalanalinakumuda
                        madhukasaugandhikadhātakīlatākusumam mūtraṃ nayati virāgaṃ
                        sotpalaśatapatrapuṇḍarīkaṃ ca ||
kāsaṃ ghnanti saśṛṅgī tāmalakī kaṇṭakārī ca ||
triphalā ceti gaṇo 'yaṃ jvarasya śamanāy nirdiṣṭaḥ ||
saṃsthāpayanti rudhiraṃ rudhiraṃ ca saśarkaraṃ lodhram ||

amṛtā pathyā dhātrī jīvantī
                        śreyasī sthirāyuktā |
kaṇḍūkarī jīvanahrasvasaṃjñe dve pañcake gopasutā tripādī ||

parūṣakaṃ varā drākṣā kaṭphalaṃ
                        katakāt phalam |

arkālarkau nāgadantī viśalyā
                        bhārṅgī rāsnā vṛścikālī prakīryā |
pratyakpuṣpī pītatailodakīryāḥ śvetāyugmaṃ tāpasānāṃ ca vṛkṣaḥ ||
kuṣṭhaṃ truṭī haimavatī ca yonistanyāmayaghnā malapācanāśca ||

bastāntrī vyādhighāto bahalabahurasastīkṣṇavṛkṣāt phalāni śyāmādyo hanti
                        gulmaṃ viṣamarucikaphau hṛdrujaṃ mūtrakṛchram ||

tadāśrayeṣu ca dravyasaṃjñakeṣu pṛthivyādiṣu guṇāḥ
                        prakṛtivikṛtivicāradeśakālavaśādgurvādayo raseṣu sāhacaryādupacaryante
                        ||

itthaṃ ca nānauṣadhabhūtaṃ
                        jagati kiñcid dravyamasti vividhārthaprayogavaśāt ||

tatsaṅkare ca yato bāhulyena kāryakartṛtvaṃ bhavati yadevādhikaṃ tadeva
                        tatkāryakaramiti vyapadeśaḥ |

vīryaṃ dravyasya tadjñeyaṃ
                        yadyogāt kriyate kriyā |
nāvīryaṃ kurute kiñcit sarvā vīryakṛtā hi sā ||

tairapi
                        caivamatiprakṛṣṭaśaktiyuktānāmaśeṣaudhaguṇasārabhūtānāmaṣṭānāmeva gurvādīnāṃ
                        vīryasaṃjñā viśiṣṭāmnāyavihitāpi laukikīti samudbhāvyate |

tathā hi tayā rasavipākaguṇāntaravijayino bhūyāṃsaśca variṣṭhāśca guṇāḥ
                        saṅgṛhītāḥ |

viśeṣavṛtyā ca tatra tatra dravyasvarūpakathane vyavahāraḥ pravṛttito bhavati
                        |
ata eva sarvātiśāyī dravyasvabhāvaḥ prabhāva ityāmnātaḥ |

satyapi ca kriyānirvarttanasāmānye tadviparītā rasādayo vīryākhyayā
                        prabhāvasaṃjñayā vā na parāmṛśyante ||

kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇāṃ kaṭuko
                        yeṣāṃ vipāka iti pakṣaḥ |

tatra yanmadhuraṃ
                        rasavipākayoḥ śītavīryaṃ ca dravyaṃ yaccāmlaṃ tayoruṣṇavīryaṃ ca yadvā
                        kaṭukaṃ teṣāṃ yathāsvaṃ rasebhyaḥ prāyo guṇān doṣakopaśamanatvaṃ ca vidyāt |
yathā madhu madhuraṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ śamayati kaṭuvipākatayā |
tathā tailaṃ kaṭuvipākatayā ca vipākata eva baddhaviṇmūtram |

amlaṃ kāñjikaṃ kaphaṃ jayati rūkṣoṣṇatvāt kapitthaṃ tu raukṣyāt pittaṃ tu
                        śītavīryatvāt |

āmalakaṃ pittaṃ śītavīryatvāt svādupākatayā ca kaphaṃ raukṣyāllāghavācca
                        śaityaraukṣyalāghavaistu na vātam |
lavaṇaṃ saindhavaṃ svādupākatayā pittaṃ jayati lāghavāt kaphaṃ jayati |
kaṭukāpi śuṇṭhī snehauṣṇyasvādupākairvātaṃ kṣapayati pippalī ca |
kaṣāyatiktaṃ mahat pañcamūlaṃ vātaṃ jayati na tu pittaṃ uṣṇavīryatvāt |

guṇā dravyeṣu ye coktāsta eva
                        tanudoṣayoḥ |

saṅkhyābhedo yathā nāsti
                        rasānāmapi sa kramaḥ |

na ca taddāḍimādyeṣu ṣaḍevāto
                        rasāḥ smṛtāḥ |

yāti tailaṃ ca kaṭutāṃ
                        kaṭukāpi na pippalī |

kurute dadhi gurveva vahniṃ
                        pārāvataṃ na tu |

kaṣāyā grāhiṇī śītā dhātakī
                        na harītakī |

prabhāvaśca yato dravye
                        dravyaṃ śreṣṭhamato matam |
rasādisāmye yat karma viśiṣṭaṃ tat prabhāvajam ||
madhukasya ca mṛdvīkā ghṛtaṃ kṣīrasya dīpanam ||

mitho viruddhān vātādīn
                        lohitādyā jayanti yat |

virecayati yad vṛṣyamāśu
                        śukraṃ karoti vā |

mātrādi prāpya tattacca yat
                        prapañcena varṇitam |

rasena vīryeṇa guṇaiśca karma
                        dravyaṃ vipākena ca yadvidadhyāt |
sadyo 'nyathā tat kurute prabhāvāddhetoratastatra na gocaro 'sti ||

sa ṣaḍṛtukatvāt kālasya mahābhūtaguṇairūnātiriktaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭo viṣamaṃ
                        vidagdhaḥ ṣoḍhā pṛthagvipariṇamate madhurādibhedena ||
mukhaṃ srāvayatyakṣibhruvaṃ saṅkocayati daśanān harṣayati romāṇi ca |
lavaṇo mukhaṃ viṣyandayati kaṇṭhakapolaṃ vidahati annaṃ prarocayati |
tikto viśadayati vadanaṃ viśodhayati kaṇṭhaṃ pratihanti rasanām |

kaṭuko bhṛśamudvejayati jihvāgraṃ cimicimāyati kaṇṭhakapolaṃ srāvayati
                        mukhākṣināsikaṃ vidahati deham |
kaṣāyastu jaḍayati jihvāṃ badhnāti kaṇṭhaṃ pīḍayati hṛdayam ||

tatra madhuro raso
                        janmaprabhṛtisātmyāt sarvadhātuvivardhanaḥ āyuṣyo
                        bālavṛddhakṣatakṣīṇabalavarṇendriyatvakkeśakaṇṭhahitaḥ prīṇano bṛṃhaṇo
                        jīvanastarpaṇaḥ sthairyasandhānaḥ stanyakaro
                        vātapittaviṣadāhamūrchātṛṣṇāpraśamanaḥ snigdhaḥ śīto mṛdurguruśca ||

rocanaḥ pācano dīpano bṛṃhaṇastarpaṇaḥ prīṇanaḥ kledano vyavāyī laghuḥ
                        snigdho hṛdyaśca ||

kṣatavihitavisarpaṃ raktapittaṃ pipāsāṃ śvayathumapi kṛśānāṃ taijasatvāt
                        bhramaṃ ca ||

lavaṇaḥ
                        stambhabandhasaṅghātavidhmāpanaḥ sarvarasapratyanīko dīpano rocanaḥ pācanaḥ
                        kledanaḥ śoṣaṇaḥ snehanaḥ svedano bhedanaḥ chedanaḥ saro vyavāyī vikāṣī
                        harati pavanaṃ viṣyandayati kaphaṃ viśodhayati srotāṃsi nātiguruḥ
                        snigdhatīkṣṇoṣṇaśca ||

kṣataviṣamadavṛddhiṃ vātaraktaṃ karoti kṣapayati balabhojaḥ soti vā sevanena
                        ||

tiktaḥ
                        svayamarociṣṇuraruciviṣakṛmimūrcchotkledajvaradāhatṛṭakuṣṭhakaṇḍūharaḥ
                        kledamedovasāmajjaviṇmūtrapittaśleṣmopaśoṣaṇo dīpanaḥ pācano lekhanaḥ
                        stanyakaṇṭhaviśodhano medhyo nātirūkṣaḥ śīto laghuśca ||

kaṭuko
                        'lasakaśvayathūdardasthaulyābhiṣyandakṛmivaktrarogaviṣakuṣṭhakaṇḍūprasādhano
                        vraṇāvasādanaḥ sneha kledaśoṣaṇo rocanaḥ pācano dīpano lekhanaḥ śodhanaḥ
                        śoṣayatyannaṃ sphuṭayatīndriyāṇi bhinatti śoṇitasaṃghātaṃ chinnatti bandhān
                        vivṛṇoti srotāṃsi kṣapayati śleṣmāṇaṃ laghurūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇaśca ||

kaṣāyo balāsaṃ sapittaṃ
                        saraktaṃ nihantyāśu badhnāti varcotirūkṣaḥ |
gurustvaksavarṇatvakṛt kledaśoṣī himaḥ prīṇano ropaṇo lekhanaśca ||
prāyaḥ kaṣāyaṃ śītaṃ stambhanaṃ cānyatra harītakyāḥ ||

atha yaḥ
                        śiśirapavanadharaṇīdharavividhavanagahananadītaṭākapalvalodapānakamalakumudakuvalayāvakīrṇoramyaḥ
                        sthirasnigdhabhūmirbhūriharitatṛṇo
                        'tidūravistṛtapratānapravālopasaṃcchannapādapaḥ sasyasarīsṛpakhagabahulaḥ
                        śleṣmapittaprāyo gurvauṣadhisalilaḥ
                        ślīpadagalarogāpācīṃjvarādyāmayopadrutajanapadaḥ so 'nūpo madhurarasayoniḥ
                        ||

yastu
                        viṣamavipulasikatāsthalabahulo 'tidūrāvagāḍhavirasasalilaḥ
                        kleśasahārogaśarīradīrghāyuḥprāyo janapado 'nūparītaśca sa jāṅgalaḥ
                        kaṭukarasayoniḥ |
dvau tiktaḥ kaṭukaścaikaṃ yāti pañcadaśaiva te ||
lavaṇastrīn bhajatyekaṃ tikta evaṃ tu viṃśatiḥ ||
ekaṃ tiktayuto yāti daśaiva madhuro rasaḥ ||
ekaikasya parityāgāt saṃyogāḥ pañcake ca ṣaṭ ||

ekaśca ṣaḍrasaḥ ṣaṭ ca
                        pṛthagevaṃ triṣaṣṭidhā |

saśabdasya vāyoḥ kukṣau tiryagūrdhvaṃ ca bhramaṇenāntraveṣṭanena
                        pārśvahṛdayapīḍanenālpatayā ca śakṛt |

anye 'pi ca malā yathāyathaṃ
                        malāyanaṃ śoṣaśūnyatvalāghavaiḥ |
tathā hi dehadhātavo ye guravaste gurubhiraikyakāritayopacīyante |

tasmādanyebhyo dravyebhyo 'pi sutarāṃ raktamāpyāyyate raktena māṃsaṃ māṃsena
                        medo medasāsthi taruṇāsthnā majjā majñā śukraṃ śukreṇāmagarmeṇa garbhaḥ |

yatra tvevaṃ lakṣaṇena sāmānyena sāmānyavatāmāhāravihārāṇāmasānnidhyaṃ syāt
                        sannihitānāṃ cābhyavaharaṇamaśakyaṃ viruddhatvād ghṛṇitvādaruceranyasmādvā
                        kāraṇāntarāt |

tadyathā śukrakṣaye
                        kṣīrasarpiṣorupayogo madhurasnigdhaśītānāmapareṣāṃ ca dravyāṇām |

karmāpi yadyasya dhātoḥ samānakriyatayā vṛddhikaraṃ tasya tasya
                        vṛddhimabhilaṣatā tattadāsevyam |
vṛddhiḥ kṣayaśca dhātūnāṃ jāyate śṛṇu cāparam ||

dravyaṃ tulyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ hi
                        svaṃ svaṃ vṛdhdyai kṣayāya ca |

pūrvo dhātuḥ paraṃ kuryāt
                        vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇaśca tadvidham |

adho dve sapta śirasi khāni
                        svedavahāni ca |

rakte visarpaṃ dāhaṃ ca māṃse
                        māṃspākakothanam |

śleṣmā tvaci sthitaḥ kuryāt
                        stambhaṃ śvetāvabhāsatām |
duścchāyo durmanā rūkṣo bhavet kṣāmaśca tatkṣaye ||
tattatyajan samaśnaṃśca tau tau vṛddhikṣayau jayet ||
vṛddhāḥ kṣīṇāśca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ lakṣayantyabudhā na tat ||

yathābalaṃ yathāsvaṃ ca doṣā
                        vṛddhā vitanvate |
rūpāṇi jahati kṣīṇāḥ samāḥ svaṃ karma kurvate ||

ya eva dehasya samā vivṛdhyai
                        ta eva doṣā viṣamā vadhāya |

tatra pakvāśayaḥ kaṭiḥ sakthinī pādāvasthi śrotraṃ sparśanaṃ ca vātasthānāni
                        |
nābhirāmāśayaḥ svedo lasīkā rudhiraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca pittasthānāni |

uraḥ kaṇṭhaḥ śiraḥ kloma parvāṇyāmāśayo raso medo ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ ca
                        śleṣmasthānāni |
ataśca doṣā dehasya sthirīkaraṇāt sthūṇā ityucyante |

vyāno hṛdyavasthitaḥ kṛtsnadehacaraḥ śīghrataragatiḥ
                        gatiprasāraṇākuñcanotkṣepāvakṣepanibheṣonmeṣajṛmbhaṇānnāsvādanasrotoviśodhanasvedāsṛksrāvaṇādikriyo
                        yonau ca śukrapratipādano vibhajya cānnasya kiṭṭāt sāraṃ tena kramaśo
                        dhātūṃstarpayati |

tatra yadāmāśayapakvāśayamadhyasthaṃ pañcamahābhūtātmakatve 'pi
                        tejoguṇotkarṣāt kṣapitasomaguṇaṃ tataśca tyaktadravasvabhāvaṃ
                        sahakārikāraṇairvāyukledādibhiranugrahāddahanapacanādikriyayā
                        labdhāgniśabdaṃ pittamannaṃ pacati sārakiṭṭau vibhajati śeṣāṇi ca
                        pittasthānāni tatrasthamevānugṛhṇāti tat pācakamityucyate |

sa tūrasthaḥ svavīryeṇa trikasyānnavīryeṇa ca saha hṛdayasya ca śeṣāṇāṃ ca
                        śleṣmasthānānāṃ tatrastha evodakakarmaṇāvalambanādavalambaka ityucyate |

evamamīṣu sthāneṣu
                        bhūyiṣṭhamavikṛtāḥ sakalaśarīravyāpino 'pi vātapittaśleṣmāṇo vartante |

śītaguṇopahitāstīkṣṇādayaḥ pittasya cayamuṣṇaguṇopahitāḥ kopaṃ śītaguṇopahitā
                        mandādayaḥ praśamam |

śītaguṇopahitāḥ snigdhādayaḥ kaphasya cayamuṣṇaguṇopahitāḥ kopaṃ tathā tu
                        rūkṣādayaḥ praśamam ||
doṣo vikāraṃ kurute khe varṣamiva toyadaḥ ||

nakhabhedo vipādikā pādaśūlaṃ pādabhraṃśaḥ suptapādatā vātakhuḍatā
                        gulphagrahaḥ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ gṛddhrasī jānubhedo jānuviśleṣaḥ ūrusāda
                        ūrustambhaḥ paṅgutvaṃ gudabhraṃśo gudārtirvṛṣaṇākṣepo meḍhrastambho
                        vaṅkṣaṇānāhaḥ śreṇibhedo viṅbheda udāvartaḥ khañjatvaṃ kubjatvaṃ vāmanatvaṃ
                        trikagrahaḥ pṛṣṭhagrahaḥ pārśvāvamarda udarāveṣṭo hṛnmoho hṛddravo
                        vakṣodgharṣastathā vakṣoparodho vakṣastodo bāhuśoṣastathā grīvāstambho
                        manyāstambhaḥ kaṇṭhoddhvaṃso hanustambhastālvoṣṭhabhedo dantabhedo
                        dantaśaithilyaṃ mūkatvaṃ vāksaṅgaḥ pralāpaḥ kaṣāyāmyatā mukhaśoṣo
                        rasājñatvaṃ ghrāṇanāśaḥ karṇaśūlamaśabdaśrutiruccaiḥśrutirbādhiryaṃ
                        vartmastambho vartmasaṅkocastimiramakṣiśūlamakṣivyudāso bhrūvyudāsaḥ
                        śaṅkhabhedo lalāṭabhedaḥ śirorukkeśabhūmisphuṭanamarditamekāṅgarogaḥ
                        sarvāṅgaroga ākṣepako daṇḍakaḥ śramo bhramo vepathurjṛmbhā glānirviṣādo
                        raukṣyaṃ pāruṣyaṃ śyāvāruṇābhāsatvamasvapno 'navasthitacittatā ca ||

pittavikārāḥ punaroṣaḥ ploṣo
                        davo davathurvidāho 'ntardāhastvagdāho 'ṃsadāho dhūmako 'mlaka
                        ūṣmādhikyamatisvedo 'ṅgagandho 'vayavasadanaṃ śoṇitakledo
                        māṃsakledastvaṅmāṃsāvadaraṇaṃ carmadaraṇaṃ raktakoṭho raktavisphoṭo
                        raktamaṇḍalāni raktapittaṃ haritatvaṃ hāridratvaṃ nīlikā kakṣyā kāmalā
                        tiktāsyatā lohitagandhāsyatā pūtimukhatvaṃ tṛṣṇādhikyamatṛptirāsyapāko
                        galapāko 'kṣipākaḥ pāyupāko meḍhrapāko jīvādānaṃ tamaḥpraveśo
                        haritahāridranetramūtraśakṛttvaṃ ca ||

śleṣmavikārāstu tṛptistandrā
                        nidrādhikyaṃ staimityaṃ gurugātratālasyaṃ mukhamādhuryaṃ prasekaḥ
                        śleṣmodgiraṇaṃ malādhikyaṃ balāso hṛdayopalepaḥ kaṇṭhopalepo
                        dhamanīpraticayo galagaṇḍo 'tisthaulyaṃ śītāgnitvamudardaḥ śvetāvabhāsatā
                        śvetanetramūtraśakṛttvaṃ ca ||
sarāgakaṇḍūḥ śophaḥ syādudardaḥ sa kaphodbhava iti ||

sarveṣu teṣu teṣvanukteṣu
                        cānyeṣvasaṅkhyeyatvādvikāreṣvimānyeva doṣāṇāmātmaliṅgāni
                        sakalaśarīravyāpīnyavyabhivārīṇi ca |

karmāṇi tu vāyoḥ
                        sraṃsavyāsasaṅgasādhedatodaharṣatarṣavarttāṅgamardakampavyathaveṣṭabhaṅgaśūlaśoṣasvāpapāruṣyasauṣiryasaṅkocaspandanāni
                        kaṣāyarasatvaṃ śyāvāruṇavarṇatā ca |
pṛthak trīn viddhi saṃsargastridhā tatra tu tānnava ||
prakṛtisthaṃ yadā pittaṃ vṛddho vāyuḥ kaphakṣaye |

prakutisthaṃ kaphaṃ kṣīṇe
                        pitte vāyuryadā balī |

prakṛtisthaṃ yadā vātaṃ
                        pittaṃ vṛddhaṃ kaphakṣaye |

prakṛtisthaṃ kaphaṃ vṛddhaṃ
                        pittaṃ vāyukṣaye yadā |

prakṛtisthaṃ yadā vāyuṃ
                        vṛddhaḥ pittakṣaye kaphaḥ |

athāto doṣopakramaṇīyamadhyāyaṃ
                        vyākhyāsyāma iti hasmāhurātreyo maharṣayaḥ |

vātasyopakramaḥ snehaḥ svedo mṛdūni snigdhoṣṇamadhurāmlalavaṇāni
                        saṃśodhanānyabhyavahāryāṇi
                        cābhyaṅgapūrvamupanāhanopaveṣṭanonmardanapariṣekāvagāhasaṃvāhana pīḍanāni
                        vitrāsanavidhmāpanavismaraṇāni surāsavavidhānaṃ snehāścānekayonayo
                        dīpanīyapācanīyavātaharavirecanīyadravyopahitāstathā śatapākasahasrapākāḥ
                        sarvaśaḥ prayogārthā bastayo bastiniyamo viśeṣatastailaṃ māṃsaraso
                        'nuvāsanāni sukhaśīlatā strīsamparkavarjyaśca haimanto vidhiḥ ||

pittasya sarpiṣpānaṃ sarpiṣā
                        snehanamadhodoṣaharaṇaṃ madhuratiktakaṣāyāṇāmauṣadhābhyavahāryāṇāmupayogo
                        mṛdusurabhiśītahṛdyānāṃ gandhānāmupasevā paramaśiśirasurabhisalilamajjanam |

viśeṣatastu ghṛtaṃ payo virecanāni saumyāḥ sarve bhāvāḥ divāsvapnavarjyaśca
                        graiṣmo vidhiḥ ||

śleṣmaṇaḥ punarvidhivihitāni
                        tīkṣṇāni saṃśodhanāni rūkṣaprāyāṇyabhyavahāryāṇi kaṭutiktakaṣāyopahitāni
                        tīkṣṇāni dīrghakālasthitāni hṛdyāni madyāni
                        dhāvanalaṅghanaplavanajāgaraṇāniyuddhayuddhavyavāyavyāyāmarūkṣonmardanasnānocchādanāni
                        |

viśeṣataḥ kṣaudraṃ yūṣo vamanāni sarvaśaścopavāsaḥ sadhūmagaṇḍūṣaḥ
                        sukhapratiṣedhaḥ sukhārthameva vāsantiko vidhiriti |
pitte pittastataḥ svāduḥ kaṣāyaśca raso hitaḥ ||
pittaṃ yāti cayaṃ kopaṃ na tu kālasya śaityataḥ ||
tulye 'pi kāle dehe ca skannatvānna prakupyati ||
cayādīn yānti sadyo 'pi doṣāḥ kāle 'pi vā na tu ||

tasmādādau kapho ghātyaḥ
                        kāyadvārārgalo hi saḥ |

suśrutaśca na sarvatra
                        matametat bravīti tu |
nāsau viśuddhaḥ śuddhastu śamayedyo na kopayet ||
dṛṣṭā mithaśca doṣeṣu nātonyonyaṃ jayanti te ||
viparyaye tu pakvatvaṃ tathā tāmraṃ samecakam ||

āmena tena sampṛktā doṣā
                        dūṣyāśca dūṣitāḥ |
utkliṣṭānadha ūrdhvaṃ vā na cāmān vahataḥ svayam ||

athāto rogabhedīyamadhyāyaṃ
                        vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti hasmāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ |

tatra rogotpattiṃ prati pratyutpannaṃ karma yadanenaiva śarīreṇa
                        dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭañcoddiśyāptopadiṣṭānāṃ vihitānāṃ
                        pratiṣiddhānāmananuṣṭhānamanuṣṭhānaṃ vā |
anye punaḥ pratyutpannaṃ karma parakṛtamapi varṇayanti |
evañcāhuḥ yadi svayaṃ kṛtādevakarmaṇaḥ kāryānirvṛttiḥ syāt |

kimiti vidvānapi parācaritayorupakārāpakārayoḥ sukhaduḥkhānurodhāttoṣaroṣau
                        pratikartavyacittaṃ vā pratipadyate |
evamete vyādhayo dvividhāḥ santaḥ trividhā jāyante |

yasmānniyatahetuko 'pyāmayaḥ samyak
                        bhiṣagādeśānuṣṭhānādupāttāyussaṃskārāparikṣaye jātopi vā sahyavedanatāṃ
                        pratipadyate |

svayamapi ca daivānnidānālpatayā vā nivartamānaṣṣoḍaśaguṇasamudita
                        kriyopalambhādāśutaramaparikliṣṭasya cāpagacchati |

aniyataphaladāyini tu daive hitābhyāsaratasyā 'vakāśameva na labhate vyādhiḥ
                        |
subahuśo 'pica bhidyamānā vyādhayo nijāgantutāṃ na vyabhicaranti ||
teṣu pūrvaṃ vātādayo vaiṣamyamāpadyante tato vyathābhinirvartate |

bāhyahetujāstvāgantavaḥ teṣu prāhareṇa vyathā pūrvamupajāyate tato
                        doṣavaiṣamyam |
doṣavaiṣamyeṇaiva ca bahurūpā ruganubadhyate pravarddhate ca |
evañca kṛtvā na doṣavyatirekeṇa rogānubandhaḥ kevalaṃ paurvāparye viśeṣaḥ |
yathaiva śakuniḥ sarvataḥ paripatan divasaṃ svāṃ cchāyāṃ nātivartate |

yathā vā kṛtsnaṃ vikārajātaṃ vaiśvarūpyeṇa vyavashtitaṃ guṇatrayamapyatiricya
                        na vartate |

yathā ca vidyudvarṣādayo nabhasi bhavanti na tvavaśyaṃ nimittatastvavaśyamapi
                        |

trividhantu
                        nimittameṣāmasātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaḥ pajñāparādhāḥ pariṇāmaśca te punaḥ
                        pratyekamatiyogāyogamithyāyogabhedāt tridhā bhidyante |
tatrāpi rasavarjyā viṣayā yathāyathamindriyaṃ bādhante 'nugṛhṇanti ca |

yadā hyete trayo nidānādiviśeṣāt nānyonyamanubadhnantīṣadvānubadhnantyabalā
                        vā na tadāminirvarttante vyādharyāścarā dvābhinirvarttante tanavo vā
                        bhavantyasampūrṇaliṅgā vā |

trayaśca rogāṇāṃ mārgā
                        bāhyamadhyābhyantarāḥ tatra bāhyo raktādidhātavastvak ca |

ābhyantaro mahāsrotaḥ śarīramadhyaṃ mahānimnamāmapakvāśayāśrayaḥ koṣṭho
                        'ntariti paryāyāḥ tadāśrayā
                        jvarātīsārachardyalasakaviṣūcikāśvāsakāsahidhmānāhodaraplīhādayo
                        'ntarbhāgāśca visarpaśophārśovidradhigulmādayaḥ ||

te ca rogāḥ svapradhānā
                        bhavantyanyaparivārā vā kramādanubandhyanubandhākhyāḥ |
itare tu tadviparītāḥ tadvacca doṣā api |
pradhānapraśame ca praśamo bhavati teṣāmanupaśāmyato vā paścāttānupakramet |
sa hi pīḍākarataro bhavati vyādhiparikliṣṭadehatvāt pramehapiṭakādivat |
tathānyaḥ pradhāna eva rogo 'nyasya pradhānasya hetuḥ bhavati |
yathā jvaro raktapittasya raktapittaṃ vā jvarasya |

ekaścāpacāro nimittamekasya vyādheḥ bahūnāṃ ca tathā bahavaḥ tadvadekaṃ
                        liṅgam |
evameva praśame 'bhyupāyaḥ tathā sa evānyasya prakope |

tatrāgamato rogamevamevaṃ
                        prakopaṇamevaṃ yonimevamadhiṣṭhānamevamātmānamevaṃ devanamevaṃ
                        rūpaśabdagandharasasparśamevaṃ pūrvarūpamevamupadravamevaṃ
                        vṛddhisthānakṣayānvitamevamudarkamevaṃ nāmānam |

prakṛtivikṛtiyuktamāsyarasantu praśnena tathā succhardanaducchardanatvaṃ
                        mṛdukrūrakoṣṭhatāṃ svapnadarśanamabhiprāyaṃ
                        janmāmayapravṛttinakṣatradviṣṭeṣṭasukhaduḥkhāni ca |

jñānāṃśena na hi jñānaṃ
                        kṛtsne jñeye pravartate |
na jātu skhalati prājño viṣamepi kriyāpathe ||
tatrānubandhaṃ prakṛtiñca samyak jñātvā tataḥ karma samārabheta ||

kasminnayaṃ deśe jātaḥ saṃvṛddho vyādhito vā kasmiṃśca deśe
                        manuṣyāṇāmidamāhārajātamidaṃ vihārajātametāvat balamevāṃvidhaṃ
                        satvamevaṃvidhaṃ sātmmamiyaṃ bhaktirime vyādhayo hitamidamahitamidamiti |

kimāhāreṇa kupito vāyuḥ kiṃ vihāreṇa tathā rūkṣeṇa laghunā śiśireṇa vā
                        sāhasena vegarodhena vā bhayena śokena veti |

ekarūpasyāpi hi hetoḥ mṛdvādivibhāgena pṛthak samavetānāñca
                        doṣāṇāmaṃśāṃśabalavikalpaviśeṣāt vyādherbalābalaviśeṣaḥ |

tatrānekadoṣātmakeṣu vyādhiṣvanekaraseṣu ca bheṣajeṣu
                        rasadoṣaprabhāvamekaikaśo 'bhisamīkṣya vyādhibheṣajaprabhāvatatvaṃ
                        vyavasyeta |

na hi viṣamavikṛtisamavetānāṃ
                        nānātmakānāṃ paraspareṇopagṛhītānāmupahatānāñcānyaiśca
                        vikalpanairvikalpitānāmavayavaprabhāvānumānena
                        samudāyaprabhāvatatvamadhyavasituṃ śakyam |
tathā kasya dhāmādhiṣṭhāya vyādhirayamavashtita iti nirūpayet |

pravisṛto hi doṣaḥ svameva sthānamātaṅkāyādhitiṣṭhan mūrddhādīn vā dustaro
                        bhavati |

saṃśamanāni tu vyādhibalādadhikāni tamupaśamayya vyādhiṃ vyādhikṣapitadehe
                        śīghramanyamāvahanti |

atisthūlo 'tikṛśo durbalo durbaddhamāṃsaśoṇitāsthyaṃgāvayavo 'lpāgniralpāhāro
                        'sātmyāhāropacitaḥ sārarahito vā vyādhibalameva tāvadasamarthasoḍhum |

tathā balavati vyādhyāture 'lpabalamalpaṃ vā bheṣajamakiñcitkaraṃ bhūya eva
                        doṣamutkleśya vyādhimudīrayet ||

idamevaṃrasavīryavipākamevaṃguṇamevaṃdravyamevaṃkarmaivaṃprabhāvamasmin deśe
                        jātamasminnṛtāvevaṃgṛhītamevaṃnihitamevaṃvihitamevaṃniṣiddhamevamupasaskṛtamevaṃsaṃyuktamevaṃyuktamanayā
                        mātrayaivaṃvidhasya puruṣasyaivaṃvidhe kāla etāvantaṃ
                        doṣamapakarṣatyupaśamayati vā |

anyadapi caivaṃvidhaṃ bheṣajamabhūt tanmānena vā viśeṣeṇa prayuktamidamakarot
                        |
santi vyādhayo ye śāstra utsargāpavādairupakramaṃ prati nirdiṣṭāḥ |
sa kṣaṇalavamuhūrtādibhedenāturāvasthayā ca dvidhoktaḥ prāgapi ca |

sādhāraṇā hi mandaśītoṣṇavarṣatayā sukhatvāt bhavantyavikalpakāḥ
                        śarīrauṣadhānām |

tadanu prāptañca bheṣajaṃ saṃśodhanārthamuṣṇasvabhāvamapi
                        śītopahatatvānmandavīryatāṃ gatamayogāya jāyate |

tadvadvarṣāsvapi samantādatighanena bahalena ghanasampātenāvatate nabhasi
                        uparuddhatejaḥyasareṣu dinakarakareṣu jalapaṭalotplāvanoddāmakardamāyāṃ
                        bhūmāvatyarthopaklinnamavasannānalabalamādānadurbalaṃ śarīraṃ bhavati ||

aparisaṃsthitatayā ca kṣitimalapnāyābhiramlavipākābhiḥ
                        khagamṛgasarīsṛpādiśavadhātumūtrapurīṣasaṃspṛṣṭābhiradbhiḥ
                        salilaśiśiraśīkarānuviddhaśiśirapavanasampṛktena ca dhārādharoṣmaṇā
                        komalatvādapariṇatasyāsya sutarāṃ vidāho janyate |

abhaktaṃ prāgbhaktaṃ madhyabhaktamadhobhaktaṃ sabhaktamantarabhaktaṃ sāmudgaṃ
                        muhurmuhuḥ sagrāsaṃ grāsāntarā niśi ca ||

tadapānānilavikṛtāvadhaḥ kāyasya ca balādhānārthaṃ tadgateṣu ca vyādhiṣu
                        praśamanāya kṛśīkaraṇārthañca yojyam ||

pūrvakāyasya ca balādhānārthaṃ tadgateṣu vyādhiṣu ca ślaiṣmikeṣu ca praśamāya
                        sthūlīkaraṇārthañca ||

sabhaktaṃ yadannena samaṃ
                        sādhitaṃ paścādvā samāloḍitam |
tat bāleṣu sukumāreṣvauṣadhadveṣiṣvarucau sarvāṅgageṣu ca rogeṣu ||

antarābhaktaṃ yat pūrvāhṇe
                        bhakte jīrṇe madhyāhne bheṣajamupayujyate |

tattu laghvalpānnayuktaṃ pācanāvalehacūrṇādi hidhmāyāṃ
                        kampākṣepayorūrdhvādhassaṃśraye ca doṣe ||

tatrādye kāle tṛṣitaḥ
                        pītaśītāmburajīrṇī kṣudhitaḥ kṣāmaśca bheṣajaṃ varjayet |
tataḥ karma bhiṣak paścāt jñānapūrvaṃ samācaret ||
dehe mārgīkṛte doṣaiḥ śeṣaḥ sūkṣma ivānalaḥ ||
prayojayet kriyāṃ prāptāṃ kriyākālaṃ na hāpayet ||

ucito yasya yo deśastajjaṃ
                        tasyauṣadhaṃ hitam |

bṛṃhaṇaṃ yat bṛhatvāya
                        laṅghanaṃ lāghavāya yat |

snehanaṃ rūkṣaṇaṃ karma
                        svedanaṃ stambhanañca yat |

mastu takraṃ ca tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ
                        rūkṣaṃ chedi ca bheṣajam |
mūtrakṛchraṃ kṛmīn mehaṃ sthūlatāṃ ca vyapohati ||

niśe bṛhatyau hapuṣā pāṭhā
                        mūlaṃ ca kembukāt |
eṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ ca sadṛśāṃśakam ||
kārśyameva varaṃ sthaulyānna hi sthūlasya bheṣajam |
ciraṃ krameṇa ca kṣīṇastadabhyāsena tatra ca ||

svāduramlo jalakṛtaḥ sasneho
                        rūkṣa eva vā |

guru cātarpaṇaṃ sthūle
                        viparītaṃ hitaṃ kṛśe |
satataṃ vyādhitatayā sadā yojyo vibhajya ca ||
upakramā na tu dvitvādbhinnā api gadā iva ||

sarpirmajjā vasā tailaṃ sneheṣu
                        pravaraṃ matam |

ghṛtāttailaṃ guru vasā
                        tailānmajjā tato 'pi ca |
apaprasūtā yukte ca nasye bastau virecane ||
tailaṃ prāvṛṣi varṣānte sarpiranyau tu mādhave |
sarvaṃ sarvasya ca snehaṃ yuñjyāt bhāsvati nirmale ||

tvaramāṇe tu śīte 'pi divā
                        tailaṃ ca yojayet |

hrasvā peyā sukhā sā hi
                        parihāre 'nuvartate |
cirācca balyā na ruje vyāpannāpi prakalpate ||

hyastena jīrṇa evānne
                        snehocchaḥ śuddhaye bahuḥ |

bṛṃhaṇo rasamadyādyaiḥ
                        sabhakto 'lpo hitaḥ sa ca |
snehasya pānāt pūrvaṃ ca dātavyaṃ mṛdubheṣajam |

tryahamacchaṃ mṛdau koṣṭhe
                        krūre saptadinaṃ pibet |

vihatya setuṃ mṛtkoṣṭhāt
                        sravati kṣapayan mṛdam |

tato doṣādibalataḥ pūrvoktaṃ
                        ca vidhiṃ śrayet |
na sarpiḥ kevalaṃ pitte peyaṃ sāme viśeṣataḥ |
sarvaṃ hyanuvrajeddehaṃ hatvā saṃjñāṃ ca mārayet ||

tilacūrṇaṃ ca sasnehaṃ
                        phāṇitaṃ kṛsarāṃ tathā |

peyāṃ sukhoṣṇā kṣaireyīṃ
                        pātre vā sasitāghṛte |

snehaṃ vaikaṃ surācchena
                        dadhno vā saguḍaṃ saram |
vasāṃ varāhajāṃ sarpiḥ pippalīṃ lavaṇaṃ tilān ||
taddhi viṣyandyarūkṣaṃ ca sūkṣmamuṣṇaṃ vyavāyi ca ||
dṛḍhendriyo mandajaraḥ śatāyuḥ snehopasevī puruṣaḥ pradiṣṭaḥ ||

tatra tāpasvedaḥ pāṇikāṃsyaphālavālukāvastraghaṭikādibhiḥ sākṣādagninā ca
                        prayoktavyaḥ ||

kṣīraśuktadhānyāmlalavaṇamastupragāḍhaiḥ susnigdhaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ
                        sālvalābhidhānaistairbahuśaḥ pradihyoṣṇavīryāpūtisṛduromacarmabhistadabhāve
                        ghanavātaharapatrāvikakauśeyairupanaddhamaṅgamahasthitaṃ vidāhaparihārārthaṃ
                        niśi muñcet |

tatra
                        śigruvaraṇāmrātakamūlakasarṣapasurasārjakavāsāvaṃśāśmantakāśokaśirīṣārkakarañjairaṇḍamālatīpatrabhaṅgapūtīkadaśamūlādivātaharairdravyairmastusalilasurākṣīraśuktādibhiḥ
                        kvathitaiḥ pūrvoktaiśca yathādoṣaṃ pṛthak sahitairvā kumbhīrvarṣalikāḥ
                        praṇālīrvā pūrayitvā vātaharasiddhasnehābhyaktamanabhyaktaṃ vopaviṣṭaṃ
                        kiliñje vā śayānamekāṅge sarvāṅge vā vastrāvacchanne pariṣecayet |
tairevādbhiḥ pūrṇe mahati kaṭāhe kuṇḍe droṇyāṃvāvagāhayet ||
piṇḍaḥ saṃstaro nāḍī ghanāśma kumbhī kūpaḥ kuṭī jentākaśca |

tatra mṛtkapālapāṣāṇaloṣṭalohapiṇḍānagnivarṇān sandaṃśena gṛhītvāmbhasyamle
                        vā nimajjayet tairārdrāvakivastreṇa veṣṭitaiḥ śleṣmamedobhūyiṣṭhaṃ
                        sarujamaṅgaṃ granthimadvā svedayet |

yathārhasvedadravyāṇi
                        pihitamukhāyāmukhāyāṃ samyagupasvedya nivātaśaraṇaśayanasthe kiliñje
                        prastīryāvikakauśeyavātaharapatrānyatamottarapracchade
                        rauravājinaprāvārādibhiḥ svavacchannaṃ svedayediti saṃstarasvedaḥ ||

nāḍīmūlacchidrapramāṇapārśvacchidrāmupasandhāyāvalipya ca pārśvacchidrasthayā
                        nāḍyā śaroṣikāvaṃśadalakiliñjakarañjapatrānyatamakṛtayā
                        gajāgrahastasaṃsthānayā vyāmadīrghayādhyarddhavyāmadīrghayā vā
                        svāyāmacaturbhāgāṣṭabhāgapariṇāhamūlāgrasrotasā
                        sarvatovātaharapatrasaṃvṛtachidrayā dvistrirvā vinamitayā sukhopaviṣṭasya
                        svabhyaktaprāvṛteṅge bāṣpamupaharet |

bāṣpo hyanṛjugāmī vihatacaṇḍavegastvacamavidahan sukhaṃ svedayatīti
                        nāḍīsvedaḥ ||

puruṣāyāmamātramadhikaṃ vā
                        ghanaṃ samaṃ ca śilātalaṃ bhūpradeśaṃ vā vātaharadārudīptenāgninā
                        sarvatastāpayitvāgnimapohyoṣṇodakāmlādibhirabhyukṣya yathoktapracchade
                        saṃstaravatsvedayediti ghānāśmasvedaḥ ||

bhūmau vā tāṃ nikhāya tadūrdhvamāsanaṃ śayanaṃ vā nātighanapracchadaṃ paritaḥ
                        pralambamānakuthākambalagoṇikaṃ nidhāya tatrasthasyoṣmāṇaṃ gṛhṇataḥ
                        kumbhyāmagnivarṇānayoguḍānupalāṃśca śanairnimajjayediti kumbhīsvedaḥ ||

śayanasyādhovistāradviguṇakhāte kūpe
                        vātaharadārukarīṣānyatarapūrṇadagghe vigatadhūme svāstīrṇaśayanasthaṃ
                        svedayediti kūpasvedaḥ ||

kuṭīṃ nātyuccavistārāṃ
                        vṛttāmacchidrāmupanāhakalkaghanapradigdhakuḍyāṃ
                        sarvatovidhūmapradīptakhadirāṅgārapūrṇahasantikāsamūhaparivṛtāṃ vidhāya
                        tanmadhye ca śayyāṃ tatrasthaṃ svedayediti kuṭīsvedaḥ ||

saptāṣṭau vāratnīrapakramyodakāt prāṅmukhamudaṅmukhaṃ vābhimukhatīrthaṃ
                        kūṭāgāraṃ kārayet |

asya ca kūṭāgārasyāntaḥ samantato bhittimaratnivistārocchrāyāṃ piṇḍikāṃ
                        kārayedākavāṭāt |

madhye cāsya kūṭāgārasya kiṣkumuktaṃ dvipuruṣapramāṇaṃ mṛnmayaṃ
                        kandusaṃsthānaṃbahusūkṣmacchidramaṅgārakoṣṭhakastambhaṃ sāpidhānaṃ kārayet |
taṃ ca khādirāṇāmaśvakarṇānāṃ vā kāṣṭhānāṃ pūrayitvā dīpayet |

sa yadā jānīyātsādhudagdhāni kāṣṭhāni vigatadhūmānyavataptaṃ sarvamagninā
                        tadagnigṛhaṃ svedayogyena coṣmaṇā yuktamiti |
praviśya caināṃ piṇḍikāmāruhya ṣārśvāparapārśvābhyāṃ yathāsukhaṃ śayīthāḥ |

bhraśyamāno hyataḥ piṇḍikāvakāśād dvāramanadhigacchan svedamūrcchā parītatayā
                        sadyaḥ prāṇān jahyāḥ |

tvaṃ yadā jānīyā vigatābhiṣyandamātmānaṃ samyak prasrutasvedapicchaṃ
                        sarvasroto vimuktaṃ laghubhūtamapagatavibandhastambhasuptivedanāga ravamiti
                        |

niṣkramya ca cakṣuṣoḥ paripālanārthamatisvinno 'pi na sahasā
                        śītodakamanupraviśethāḥ |

samyak svinnastvapagatasantāpaklamo muhūrtāt sukhoṣṇena vāriṇā yathānyāyaṃ
                        pariṣikto 'śnīyāditi jentākasvedaḥ ||
alpaṃ vaṅkṣaṇayoḥ svalpaṃ dṛṅbhuṣkahṛdaye na vā ||

muhuḥ karaiśca toyardraiḥ
                        svidyate hṛdayaṃ spṛśet |
prāyastiktaṃ kaṣāyaṃ ca madhuraṃ ca samāsataḥ ||

garbhiṇīṃ puṣpitāṃ sūtāṃ mṛdu
                        vātyayike gade |

agnerdīptiṃ mārdavaṃ
                        tvakprasādaṃ bhaktaśraddhāṃ srotasāṃ nirmalatvam |
kuryāt svedo jāḍyatandrāpahāraṃ stabdhān sandhīṃśceṣṭayatyāśu cāsya ||

snehaklinnāḥ koṣṭhagā dhātugā
                        vā srotolīnā ye ca śākhāsthisaṃsthāḥ |
doṣāḥ svedaiste dravīkṛtya koṣṭhaṃ nītāḥ samyak śuddhibhirnirhriyante ||

tatroṣṇatīkṣṇasūkṣmavyavāyivikāṣīṇyauṣadhāni svavīryeṇa
                        hṛdayamupetya saukṣmyāt vyavāyitvācca dhamanīranusṛtya snehena mṛdūkṛte
                        'ntaśśarīre svedoṣmaṇārdradāruvadviṣyaṇṇe sthūlāṇusrotebhyaḥ sakalamapi
                        doṣasaṅghātamauṣṇyāt punarviṣyandayanti |

sa viṣyaṇṇavicchinno doṣasaṅghātaḥ pāriplavaḥ snehāktabhājanastha
                        ivodakāñjalirasajjannanupnasaraṇabhāvādāmāśayamanugamya udānapraṇunnaḥ
                        agnivāyvātmakatvāt ūrdhvabhāgaprabhāvāccauṣadhasyordhvaṃ pravartate |

tatrotkṛṣṭe śleṣmaṇi
                        pittasaṃsṛṣṭe vā tatsthānagate vā pitte anile vā śleṣmottare ca
                        vamanamācaret |
pitte tu virekaṃ śleṣmasaṃsṛṣṭe vā tatsthānagate vā śleṣmaṇīti ||
ete hi paraṃ vamanena nāśamupayānti salilāpagamanenāniṣpannaśālyādivat ||

atha virecanasādhyā
                        jīrṇajvarordhvaraktapittagulmavidradhiplīhārśobhagandarodarakṛmiṇakoṣṭhamūtrāghātaretoyonidoṣavātaśoṇitahalīmakavyaṅgatimirakācābhiṣyandākṣipākakṣārāgnidagdhakuṣṭavraṇaśiraḥpakvāśayaśūlodāvartavibandhacchardivisphoṭādayo
                        vāmyoktāśca viṣūcikādayo doṣabhedīyoktāśca pittavyādhayaḥ |

kṣatagudasya gude prāṇoparodhakarīṃ rājayakṣmārtasya kṣīṇadhātutayā
                        malabalattvam |

ādhmātasya purīṣāśaye nicito vāyurvisarpan sahasā tīvrataramādhmānaṃ maraṇaṃ
                        vā janayet |

krūrakoṣṭhasyauṣadhoddhatā doṣā hyapravartamānā
                        hṛdayaśūlaparvabhedānāhacchardimūrcchāklamān janayitvā prāṇān hanyuḥ |

atha sādhāraṇe kāle
                        samyaksnigdhasvinnamanupahatamānasaṃśvaḥ cchardayitavyamiti
                        grāmyānūpaudakaśṛtamāṃsarasakṣīradadhimāṣatilapalalaśākādibhirdravaprāyaiḥ
                        samutkleśitaśleṣmāṇaṃ sukhoṣitaṃ jīrṇāhāraṃ pūrvāhṇe snātānuliptaṃ
                        sragviṇamahatavāsasaṃ devatāgnidvijaguruvṛddhavaidyānarcitavantaṃ
                        kṛtahomabalimaṅgalaprāyaścittasvastivacanaṃ
                        jānusamasaṃstṛtasopadhānopāśrayāsanopaviṣṭaṃ nirannabhīṣatsnigdhaṃ vā yavāgū
                        maṇḍena ghṛtamātrāṃ pītavantaṃ bhīrukṛśabālavṛddhasukumārān vā
                        doṣānurodhenākaṇṭhaṃ
                        pītakṣīratakrayūṣekṣumāṃsarasamadyatuṣodakayavāgūmaṇḍānyatamaṃ
                        nakṣatratithikaraṇamuhūrtodaye praśaste
                        yathāvyādhidoṣadūṣyādivihitāmauṣadhamātrāṃ madhusaindhavayuktāṃ sukhoṣṇāṃ
                        brāhmaṇaprayuktābhirāśīrbhirābhimantritāṃ

aum nāmo bhagavate
                        bhaiṣajyagurave vaiḍūryaprabharājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksambuddhāya |
sa yadā jānīyāt svedaprādurbhāvena doṣaṃ pravilayamāpadyamānaṃ

atha samupasthitānekapratigrāhaḥ pārśvalalāṭopagrahaṇe nābhiprapīḍane
                        pṛṣṭhapratilomonmardane ca pravṛttāvyapatrapaṇīyapuruṣo vivṛtoṣṭhatālukaṇṭho
                        nātimahatā vyāyāmena vegānudīrayan nāpravṛttān na pravarttayan
                        pravṛttāṃścānupravartayan
                        suparilikhitanakhābhyāmaṅgulībhyāmutpalakumudairaṇḍanālairvā
                        kaṇṭhamabhimṛśan vamet |

sarveṣu ca vamaneṣu saindhavaṃ madhu ca vidadhyātkaphavilayanavicchedanārtham
                        |

tatrāpravṛttiḥ kevalasya vā
                        bheṣajasya pravṛttirvibandho vā vegānāmayogalakṣaṇam |

yogalakṣaṇaṃ punaḥ kāle
                        kramāt kaphapittānilapravṛttirnātimahatī vyathā svayaṃ cāvasthānaṃ tataśca
                        svasthatā manaḥprasādaḥ svaraviśuddhirarocakādivaiparītyaṃ ca ||

yogena tu khalvenaṃ
                        charditavantaṃ suviśodhitapāṇipādamukhaṃ muhūrtamāśvāsya
                        dhūmatrayasyānyatamaṃ sāmarthyataḥ pāyayitvā punarupaspṛṣṭodakaṃ
                        sammānitasurabhitāmbūlaṃ nivātāgāraśayyāsthitaṃ
                        snehoktenācāravidhinānuśiṣyāt ||

tatognibalamavekṣya kṣudhaṃ
                        ca sāyāhne apare vāhni sukhodakapariṣiktaḥ purāṇānāṃ raktaśālitaṇḍulānāṃ
                        susiddhamannamasnehalavaṇakaṭukamalpasnehalavaṇakaṭukaṃ vā
                        dravaprāyamuṣṇodakānuprāyaṃ sāyaṃ prātarupabhuñjāno vidhimimamavekṣeta
                        peyādīnām ||

peyāṃ vilepīmakṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ ca
                        yūṣaṃ rasaṃ trīnubhayaṃ tathaikam |

jaghanyamadhyapravare tu
                        vegāścatvāra iṣṭā vamane ṣaḍaṣṭau |
daśaiva te dvitriguṇā vireke prasthastathāsyād dvicaturguṇaśca ||

pittāvasānaṃ vamanaṃ
                        virekādarddhaṃ kaphāntaṃ ca virekamāhuḥ |
dvitrān saviṭkānapanīya vegān meyaṃ vireke vamane tu pītam ||

atha vamitavantaṃ punarevaṃ
                        snehasvedābhyāmupapādyaśvo virecayitavya iti sujaramaśleṣmalaṃ snigdhaṃ
                        phalāmlamuṣṇamuṣṇodakānupānaṃ jāṅgalarasaudanaṃ bhojayet |

tataḥ sukhoṣitaṃ pūrvoktena vidhinātīte śleṣmakāle nirannaṃ vibhajya koṣṭhaṃ
                        yathārhauṣadhamātrāṃ pāyayet |

samyagviriktasyāpi cādhaḥsrastaḥ śleṣmā grahaṇīṃ chādayitvā gauravamāpādayati
                        |

śleṣmakāle
                        tvakṛtavamanoktadoṣāḥ śūlādhmānagauravāṇi vā kṛtvā chardikṣīṇe
                        śleṣmaṇyaparāhṇe rātrau vā virecayet |
aviriktasya tu śleṣmakāle ca vamanaṃ nirannaṃ yojyam |
pītamātra eva cauṣadhe chardivighātāya śītāmbunā mukhamasya sahasā siñcet |

yathā ca vamane svedaprasekauṣadhakaphapittānilāḥ krameṇa pravartante tathā
                        virecane vātamūtrapurīṣapittakaphāḥ |
doṣāṇāṃ hi dehe tathā sanniveśānmārgavaiparītyācca śodhanayoriti ||

pravṛtte ca dīptāgneḥ snigdhavapuṣā bahudoṣasyālpadoṣe naiva vā pravṛtte
                        'lpadoṣasyāpi jīrṇabhaiṣajyasyāhaḥśeṣaṃ balaṃ cāpekṣya bhūyo mātrāṃ
                        vidadhyāt |

tadaharvā bhuktavato
                        'nyedyuradṛḍhasnehaṃ vā daśarātrādūrdhvamupaskṛtadehamavahito bhūyaḥ pāyayet
                        ||

hrībhayalobhaiśca
                        vegāghātaśīlāḥ prāyaśaḥ striyo rājasamīpasthā vaṇijaśca bhavanti |

tatrāsamyagvirekāt
                        kukṣihṛdayāviśuddhirādhmānamaruciḥ prasekaḥ kaphapittotkleśachardibhramāḥ
                        kaṇḍū piṭakā vidāho gauravamagnisādastandrā staimityaṃ pratiśyāyo
                        vātaviṇmūtrasaṅgaśca |

ativirekāttu kevalaṃ doṣarahitamudakaṃ raktaṃ vā medomāṃsadhāvanopamaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ
                        vā pravartate |

parikartikā hṛdayodveṣṭanaṃ gudanissaraṇaṃ nayanapraveśaḥ pipīlikāsañcāra
                        ivāṅge vamanātiyogatulyatā ca ||

jīrṇe 'nne vamanaṃ yojyaṃ
                        kaphe jīrṇe virecanam |

tebhyo bastiṃ puro
                        dadyāttataḥ snigdhaṃ virecanam |
pravṛttaṃ hi malaṃ sigdho vireko nirharetsukham ||
nātiglānikaraṃ nāpi hṛdi pāyau ca rukkaram ||
ato viparyaye mandaṃ mandatāṃ ca prapadyate ||
balāpekṣaṃ hitaṃ teṣu tīkṣṇaṃ madhyaṃ mṛdu kramāt ||

apravartya malān dravyaṃ
                        sātmībhūtaṃ hi jīryati |
vamanaṃ vā virekaṃ vā tasmātsātmyaṃ na yojayet ||
kāle 'vaśyaṃ prayojyaṃ ca yasmādyatnena tat pibet ||
cirācca pākaṃ vayasaḥ karoti saṃśodhanaṃ samyagupāsyamānam ||
bastinā dīyate bastiṃ vā pūrvamanvetyato bastiḥ ||

sa ca sarvopakramāṇāṃ
                        pradhānatamaḥ śīghraṃ bṛṃhaṇādikāritvādvikṛtāniloccheditvācca ||

vidhātā vividhabāhyādhyātmikabhāvānāṃ sargasthitipralayānāṃ hetuḥ
                        mārgatrayajānāmapi rogāṇāmiti ||

sukhatvādeva ca
                        bastirbālavṛddhakṛśasthūlakṣīṇadhātvindriyeṣu ca strīṣu
                        cānilopasargādaprajāsu kṛcchraprajāsucopadiśyate |

utkleśanaṃ saṃśodhanaṃ saṃśamanaṃ lekhanaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ vājīkaraṇaṃ
                        picchābastirmādhutailikamityādayaḥ |
mādhutailikasya paryāyāḥ yāpano yuktaratho doṣaharaḥ snigdhabasatiriti |

anuvāsanaṃ
                        yathārhauṣadhasiddhaḥ snehanārthaḥ snehaḥ snehavidhau sa caturdhābhihitaḥ |

bālavṛddhādhvabhārayānavyāyāmacintāstrīnityastrīnṛpeśvarasukumāradurbalānilabhagnālpāgnibhirniṣparihāratayā
                        sukho balyo varṇyaḥ sṛṣṭamalo doṣaghnaśca tathāpi tau nājīrṇe yojyau na ca
                        divāsvapnaḥ sevyaḥ |

yataśca so 'nnamanuvasannapi na duṣyatyanuvāsaramapi vā dīyata ityanuvāsanam
                        ||

uttarabastirapi
                        snehonuvāsanavacchodhanaṃ nirūhavadapi kecidāhuḥ sa nirūhāduttaramuttareṇa
                        vā mārgeṇa dīyata ityuttarabastiḥ ||

tatrāsthāpyā
                        gulmaplīhānāhaśūlaśuddhātīsārajīrṇajvarapratiśyāyāḍhyarogahṛdayakukṣipārśvagrahaparvābhitāpapārśvayoniśūlāṅgasuptiśoṣakampagauravātilāghavāntrakūjanavātavarcomūtraśukrasaṅgāśmarīśarkarāvṛddhiśukrārtavastanyanāśarajaḥkṣayonmādaretodoṣakrimiṇakoṣṭhaviṣamāgnisaśabdālpālpogragandhotthānādayo
                        doṣabhedīyoktāśca vātavyādhayo viśeṣeṇaite hi paraṃ bastinā nāśamupayānti
                        mūlacchedena vṛkṣavat ||
kṛtavamanavirekayostu riktaṃ dehaṃ kṣataṃ kṣāra iva dahet |

ūrdhvaṃ vā śakṛtā sārddhaṃ
                        saṃsthitau koṣṭha eva vā |

tayostu netraṃ
                        suvarṇādidhātumaṇiśaṅkhaśṛṅgadantāsthiveṇunalakhadirakadaratiniśatindukādidārusāramayamṛjvakakaśaṃ
                        gopucchākṛtigulikāmukhamūnavarṣavārṣikasaptadvādaśaṣoḍaśavarṣāṇāṃ
                        viṃśatiprabhṛtiṣu ca kramāt pañcaṣaṭsaptāṣṭanavadvādaśāṅgulapramāṇam |

tatojāvivarāhahariṇagomahiṣānyatamajaṃ snehamudgavimṛditaṃ
                        vigatacchidrasirāgranthiskandhaṃ nātivartulaṃ mṛdu dṛḍhaṃ kaṣāyaraktaṃ
                        sukhasaṃsthāpyauṣadhapramāṇa nyubjaṃ vivṛtānanaṃ niveśya bastiṃ
                        karṇakayordṛḍhena sūtreṇa ghanaṃ samaṃ ca badhvā parivarttya
                        punaścānyadvastimukhabandhanārthaṃ sūtramupadhāyānuguptaṃ nidhāpayet ||
na rātrau praṇayedbastiṃ snehotkleśo hi rātrijaḥ |

tasya vidhirvamanādadhikataraṃ kṛtamaṅgalamanusukhamabhyaktamuṣṇāmbusnātaṃ
                        yuktasnehamucitāt pādahīnaṃ dravapūrvaṃ laghūṣṇaṃ sānupānamaśanamaśitavantaṃ
                        kṛtacaṅkramaṇamutsṛṣṭaviṇmūtramaśanārdrahastamaśaṅkanīyaparicārakaṃ nivāte
                        veśmani pratata śayane nātyucchrite svāstṛte īṣadunnamitapādadeśe
