                        bhūṣaṇavyatyayaṃ tayoḥ |

śiraḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ tato muṣkau
                        tataḥ pādau ca yo rujet |

gṛhṇāti sūtikāgāre na
                        stanaṃ cet spṛśettataḥ |
rudate trasyate vāpi lehaṃ dadyāt sukhāvaham ||
ulbakaṃ sahajaṃ vyādhimambupūrṇaṃ ca taṃ vadet ||
pāṇḍurogaṃ ca vātotthaṃ svasthavṛtte ca puṣṭidam ||
sthito muhūrtaṃ dhauto 'nu pītastaṃ taṃ jayet gadam ||

skande 'tha yauvanaṃ prāpte
                        senāpatyaṃ ca tān grahān |
haradhvaṃ teṣu bālānāmārogyaṃ dhāri śarma ca ||
śuddhena dehaṃ bālānāṃ gandharvā iva yoṣitām ||

teṣāṃ grahiṣyatāṃ rūpaṃ
                        pratataṃ rodanaṃ jvaraḥ ||

ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣya hasanaṃ
                        madhye vinamanaṃ jvaraḥ |

bastagandho jvaraḥ śoṣaḥ
                        purīṣaṃ haritaṃ dravam |

udare granthayo vṛttā yasya
                        nānāvidhaṃ śakṛt |
jihvāyā nimnatāmadhye śyāvaṃ tālu ca taṃ tyajet ||

tatra hiṃsātmake bālo mahān
                        vā srutanāsikaḥ |
kṣāmo mūtrapurīṣaṃ svaṃ mṛdnāti na jugupsate ||

apsu majjet patet kūpe
                        kuryādanyacca tadvidham |
rakaṃ ca sarvamārgebhyo 'riṣṭotpattiṃ ca taṃ tyajet ||

graheṣu sādhyeṣu śiśuṃ vivikte
                        śaraṇe sthitam |
śuklaṃ puṣpaṃ balirdhūpo dūrvā śvetāśca sarṣapāḥ ||
yamo vaivasvato rājā ye ca tasyānucāriṇaḥ ||

dīrghamāyurarogaṃ ca tava
                        dāsyanti svasti te |
svasti te bhagavān brāhmā svasti nāradaparvatau ||

svasti vedāśca yajñāśca
                        agnīṣomau ca svasti te |
svasti rudro viśākhaśca skandaḥ śaktidharaśca te ||

svasti dhātā vidhātā ca
                        suparṇaśca mahābalaḥ |
svasti devāśca yakṣāśca mā ca te pāpamāgamat ||

kṛsaro yāvakaḥ kṣaudraṃ
                        palalaṃ lavaṇaṃ haviḥ |
gandhaṃ mālyaṃ phalaṃ hema dhūpaḥ sapurakunduruḥ ||
vṛtte vā caturasre vā maṇḍale kusumojvale ||
taṃ prati prāṅmukho vidyāṃ paṭhannupaharet balim ||

prajāpatau ca yat satyaṃ yat
                        satyamamareśvare |
dharmarāje ca yat satyaṃ yacca satyaṃ tapasviṣu ||

dhanādhite ca yat satyaṃ
                        yacca satyaṃ jalādhite |

baliṃ copahṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sarve
                        kaumārakā grahāḥ |
aulā nīlā khalā kālā nakulā grahakārikā ||

senā susenā mātā ca mahāsenā
                        yaśasvinī |

śarastambhaśca te mudrā
                        mucyatāṃ mātaraḥ śiśuḥ |
gandhaṃ dhūpaṃ ca mālyaṃ ca kumāraste prayacchati ||

na sthātavyaṃ tadāghrāya svāṃ
                        gatiṃ gaccha mā ciram |

ṣammukho dvādaśākṣo vai
                        tasmin kāle vṛto varam |
sthānāt cyutaḥ sa vai kṣipraṃ bāhyaḥ pariṣado bhavet ||

tvaṃ hi yajñaśca yūpaśca tvaṃ
                        hi dharmavatāṃ gatiḥ |
hiraṇyaretā devastvaṃ tvaṃ hi vedavidāṃ gatiḥ ||

haripradhānagatirāsīdimaṃ nigṛhya guhyakamutsādaya tejasā tvaṃ mama vaśyaṃ ca
                        taṃ kuru duṣṭagrahanivāraṇaṃ sarvopadraveṣu ca ||

tvayā kṛtena homena śīghraṃ
                        śāntiḥ prajāyate |
āyāhi vahne devānāṃ tvaṃ hi vaktraṃ purātanam |
tena satyena deveśa imaṃ sādhaya me graham ||

namo 'stute havyavāhana
                        daṇḍaṃ pradarśaya daha daha darśa darśa teja teja moṭaya moṭaya
                        apasmāramudghāṭaya kumāra piśācarevatīrodanatrāsana vitrāsana kampana
                        utkampana vijṛmbhaṇa devayakṣagandharvabhūtanāgarākṣasasantajana
                        daṇḍanāvidhūsārayabhagavannagnidaṇḍa agnivīrya
                        namastejasāsvenatyaktamutsādaya svāhā |
puṣye mūle ca bālasya snānaṃ parvadineṣu ca ||

śaṅkhaṃ ca dakṣiṇāvartaṃ
                        śrīvatsaṃ mālyadāma ca |

aṣṭau ghaṭāḥ ṣoḍaśa vā
                        dvātriṃśadviguṇā api |
yamo dadātu bhagavān vaijayantaṃ tu nāmataḥ ||
gadā te nāśayatvadya sarvapāpaṃ diśo daśa ||

āpaḥ pavitraṃ lokesminnāpo
                        vai paramaṃ śuciḥ |
bālā dākṣāyaṇī sītā sāvitrī saramā dyutiḥ |
oṃ maṃ oṃ maṃ lmi lmi libhuk libhuk lipibhavanebhyaḥ svāhā ||

puṣkaraṃ puṣkarāraṇyaṃ
                        naimiṣaṃ ca tathā gayā |
api tā nihatāḥ sarvā yāścānyāḥ pāpacintakāḥ ||

satīnāṃ kapilānāṃ ca
                        siddhānāṃ caiva tejasā |
aśubhaṃ yacca te kiñcit sarvaṃ pratihataṃ mayā ||

skandagrahe
                        guggulvelavālukamanaśśilāharitālamañjiṣṭhośīrarāsnāgarudevadāruśrīveṣṭakahareṇūgirikadambakacandanaiḥ
                        ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ pradeho vātaharavṛkṣapatrakvāthena kavoṣṇena
                        pariṣekasteṣāmeva ca mūlakvāthe sarvagandhasurāmaṇḍakaiḍaryāvāpavattailaṃ
                        vipakvamabhyaṅgaḥ ||

kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa kṣīreṇa ca
                        siddhamardhapalikaiśca piṣṭaiḥ
                        sārivādvikākolīdvibalāṃśumatīdvayahastikarṇaparṇairghṛtaprasthaṃ pānam
                        ||

somavallīndravallīśamībilvavṛndākamṛgādinīmūlāni sūtreṇa grathitāni
                        kaṇṭhena śirasā vā dhārayet ||

raktamālyānulepanavastrapatākāmaṇibījairvividhaiśca bhakṣyaiḥ
                        sadadhighṛtamadhulājakulmāṣamāṃsamatsyasurāsavaṃ samayūrakukkuṭaṃ
                        saghaṇṭākaṃ saśūrpavyajanaṃ ca kumāragrahe raktaudanena balimupoṣito
                        nivedayet ||

tatra ca rātrāvagniṃ jvālayitvā
                        mantramimaṃ paṭhan madhusarpiṣā juhuyāt ||

viśeṣataḥ skandagrahe trirātraṃ ca rātrau rātrau gāyatryabhimantritodakena
                        catvare dhātrīkumārayoḥ snapanamācaret ||

trikālaṃ ca mantreṇānena
                        bālamapamārjayet pratisarāṃ ca badhnīyāt ||

tapasāṃ tejasāṃ caiva yaśasāṃ
                        vapuṣāṃ tathā |
vidhātā yo 'vyayo devaḥ sa te skandaḥ prasīdatu ||

devadevasya mahataḥ pāvakasya
                        ca yaḥ sutaḥ |
gaṅgomākṛttikānāṃ ca sa te śarma prayacchutu ||

viśākhe skandagrahokto
                        vacākuṣṭhānvitaḥ pradeho golomībilvaśirīṣamustasurasādikvāthena pariṣekaḥ |

kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa
                        jīvanīyagarbhaṃ sapayaskaṃ sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pānam |

naigameṣe viśākhoktaḥ
                        pradehognimanthavaruṇanalarohiṣapūtīkapāribhadrakaiḥ pariṣeko dhānyāmlena
                        sabījena guggulvaśvagandhāsarṣapośīraśvetākuṣṭhaśatāhvāvipakvaṃ
                        tailamabhyaṅgaḥ ||

bilvakapitthakarañjatarkārīsurasapāṭalīvaraṇapāribhadrakapārijātamātuluṅgapatrakvāthena
                        rātrau pariṣeko bilvādibhireva ca tailaṃ surābastamūtrayuktaṃ
                        sādhitamabhyaṅgaḥ ||

triphalāṃśumatīdvayapayasyāmadhukakalkena daśamūlaniryūhe sakṣīraṃ
                        sarpiḥ pakvaṃ pānam |

gṛddhrolūkavānararomāṇi
                        saghṛtāni tatpurīṣaṃ vā suptajane dhūpo vacādibhirvā pradehoktaiḥ pūrvokto
                        vā |

surāsavaguḍāpūpapiṣṭatilakṛtabhakṣo vṛkṣamūle savṛṣabhaḥ
                        kāñcanākṣiyugayuktaḥ svayaṃ pitrā kumārasya nirvāpaṇīyo baliḥ |

yaḥ pitā sarvabālānāṃ
                        grahāṇāṃ pūjito varaḥ |
vṛkṣamūle kṛtāvāsaḥ sa tvāṃ pātu pitā sadā ||

kṣīritarubhiḥ pariṣeko
                        mārkavamūlakāmalakītvakpatrapriyaṅgumanaśśilālailādvayayaṣṭīkramukalodhradhātakīsārivāñjanotpalapataṅgasamaṅgādviharidrāmāṃsīmañjiṣṭhācandanapadmakasuvarṇagaurikaistailaṃ
                        sapayaskaṃ pakvamabhyaṅgo grahahā vraṇaropaṇaśca ||

kāśmaryapṛśniparṇīlodhramadhukairmadhuravargeṇa ca samakṣīraṃ sarpiḥ śṛtaṃ
                        prāśyamānaṃ śītapūtanāṃ chardihidhmākāsaśvāsāṃśca śamayati ||

syandanasyonākakāśmaryakhadirakuṣṭhairmadhuravargeṇa ca
                        kṣīrivṛkṣakaṣāye sakṣīraṃ śṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhuyuktaṃ cakṣuḥkāmopasṛṣṭānāṃ
                        prāśaḥ |

bilvairaṇḍakapitthāgnimanthavaṃśīkuberākṣīpatrakvāthena pariṣekasteṣāmeva ca
                        svarasena madhukavājigandhāgarbhamaikadhyaṃ tailaṃ vasā ca pakvamabhyaṅgaḥ
                        ||
ebhireva ca vipakvamājaṃ ghṛtaṃ payo vā pibet ||
mātuścāsya śleṣmaharamauṣadhaṃ pāne stanodvartane ca yuñjyāt ||
revatī śuṣkanāmā ca sā te devī prasīdatu iti ||

sarvo 'pi ca prāyeṇāhārakāmā
                        niśārdhavicāriṇo bhayānakā māṃsāsṛgvasāśinaḥ ||

teṣāṃ punaranupraveśe kāraṇaṃ
                        sadyaḥ pūrvakṛto vā viśeṣeṇa prajñāparādhaḥ ||

tena hi
                        kāmakrodhalobhamohādijanitena praluptadhamabhinnavratācāraśauco malīmasaḥ
                        pūjyānatikrāmannātmānamupahanti ||

tatra śīlavantaṃ cokṣācāraṃ
                        śuklāmbaradharaṃ tapaḥsvādhyāyaparaṃ prāyaḥ śuklapratipaditrayodaśyāṃ
                        caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vā devā gṛhṇanti |

krodhanaṃ kadaryamātmasambhāvinaṃ kularūpagarvitaṃ kṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ
                        kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ sandhyayoścāsurāḥ |

priyanṛttagītavāditragandhamālyāmbaraṃ paradārarataṃ cokṣācāraṃ
                        prāyaścaturthyāmaṣṭabhyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca gandharvāḥ |

svapnaśīlaṃ capalamanimitrakrodhanamarthasiddhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prāyaḥ pañcabhyāṃ
                        sandhyayormadhyāhne ca nāgāḥ |

satvabalarūpagandharvadhanaśauryayuktaṃ mālyānulepanahāsyapriyamativyākaraṇaṃ
                        prāyaḥ śuklasaptamyāmekādaśyāṃ ca yakṣāḥ ||

svādhyāyatapovratacaryādevayatigurupūjārataṃ bhraṣṭaśaucaṃ vā
                        brāhmaṇamabrāhmaṇaṃ vā brahmavādinaṃ śūraṃ māninaṃ
                        devāgārasalilakrīḍanapriyaṃ ca skhalitabrahmacaryaṃ prāyaḥ
                        śuklapañcamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ pūrṇacandradarśane sandhyāsu ca |

hīnasatvaṃ piśunaṃ stenaṃ
                        lubdhaṃ śaṭhaṃ prāyo dvitīyātṛtīyāṣṭamīṣu rākṣasapiśācādayaḥ |

kalipānapriyamasūyāvantaṃ paruṣabhāṣiṇaṃ bahvāśinaṃ ca
                        kṛṣṇanavamīdvādaśyorniśi ca rākṣasāḥ ||

ātmaślāghinaṃ
                        kūṭasākṣyapradaṃ paropatāpinaṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ piśācādayaḥ ||
tadvidhameva ca prāyaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ navamyāṃ ca guruvṛddhasiddhāḥ |

devagobrāhmaṇatapasvināṃ hiṃsārucitvaṃ nṛśasābhiprāyatā
                        kopanatvamaratirojovarṇacchāyābalavapuṣāṃ copataptiḥ svapne
                        devādibhirbhatsanaṃ pravartanaṃ ca ||

tatra saumyadṛṣṭiṃ
                        gambhīramapradhṛṣyamakopanaṃ śucimanidraṃ
                        bhojanānabhilāṣiṇamalpasvedamūtrapurīṣavācaṃ saṃskṛtavādinaṃ
                        devadvijagurubhaktaṃ
                        śuklamālyāmbarasaritpulinaśailoccabhavanadadhikṣīrasurabhipriyaṃ cirādakṣiṇī
                        nimīlayantaṃ varapradātāraṃ śubhagandhaṃ varcasvinaṃ phullapadmopamamukhaṃ
                        devagraheṇa gṛhītaṃ vidyāt ||

tatrāpi govṛṣamiva nadantaṃ
                        dīptamukhanayanamādīptena svareṇa sarvamābhāṣamāṇamīśvareṇa |

jihmadṛṣṭiṃ duṣṭātmānaṃ
                        krodhanamatṛptaṃ sasvedagātraṃ devabrāhmaṇagurudveṣiṇaṃ nirbhayamabhimāninaṃ
                        śūraṃ vyavasāyinaṃ rudro 'hamindrohamupendro 'haṃ skando 'haṃ viśākho
                        'hamityādi bhāṣamāṇaṃ vikṛtavācamasakṛddhasantaṃ surāmiṣaruciṃ
                        dantairnakhaiśca parān hiṃsantamasureṇa ||

svācāraṃ hṛṣṭātmānaṃ
                        śubhagandhamalpavyavahāraṃ nṛtyantaṃ gāyantaṃ mukhavādyāni kurvantaṃ
                        priyodyānapulinaraktavastrasnānamālyānulepanadhūpānnapānahāsalīlāśṛṅgārakathāgāndharvaṃ
                        gandharveṇa |

tatrāpi śiro dhunānaṃ kalahaṃ kurvantaṃ saṃrambheṇa jāgarūkaṃ paṭhantaṃ
                        hasantaṃ hasanena ||

krodhanamaniśaṃ viśvasantaṃ
                        bhramantamātapatrāt trasyantaṃ raktākṣaṃ stabdhadṛṣṭiṃ jihvāṃ lolayantaṃ
                        sṛkviṇyau lihānamadhomukhaśāyinaṃ calaṃ vakragāminaṃ bilamavalokya
                        sarpavadūrdhvaṃ prasarantaṃ jalaughaghanadundubhisvanairhṛṣyantaṃ
                        kṣīraghṛtaguḍamadhusnānamālyapriyaṃ gātrāṇi kampayantaṃ dantaiḥ khādantaṃ
                        jale 'vatīrṇamuttaraṇamanicchantamurageṇa ||

asakṛt
                        svapnarodanahāsanṛtyagītapāṭhakathānnapānasnānamālyadhūpagandharaktavastraratiṃ
                        raktatrastaviplutākṣaṃ drutaṃ sagarvaṃ mattamiva gacchantaṃ
                        vastrāntamutkarṣayantaṃ calitāgrahastaṃ bahubhāṣiṇaṃ strīlolupaṃ
                        madyāmiṣapriyaṃ sannahya śastraṃ mṛgayamāṇamatibalamavyathaṃ hṛṣṭaṃ
                        tuṣṭamalparoṣaṃ kiṃ kasmai dadāmīti vādinaṃ śubhagandhaṃ varcasvinaṃ
                        dvijātivaidyaparibhāvinaṃ rahasyabhāṣiṇaṃ yakṣeṇa ||

tatrāpi
                        hṛṣitaromāṇamūrdhvekṣaṇaṃ prahṛṣṭanayanaṃ caṇḍaṃ paruṣaṃ mahāninādaṃ
                        maṇivareṇa |

hāsanṛttapriyamākrośinaṃ
                        pradhāvinaṃ devadvijabhiṣagdveṣiṇaṃ mantravedaśāstrābhidhāyinaṃ
                        kāṣṭhaśastrādibhiścātmānamāghnantaṃ chidraprahāriṇaṃ vaidyarandhrānveṣiṇaṃ
                        bhoḥśabdavādinaṃ paruṣaṃ raudraceṣṭaṃ śīghragāminaṃ brahmarākṣasena |

tatrāpi vikṛtasvaraṃ bhāṣayantamutrāsayantaṃ brahmavādinaṃ saṃskṛtabhāṣiṇaṃ
                        bahuśastoyaṃ yācantaṃ yajñasenena ||

sakrodhadṛṣṭiṃ
                        bhrukuṭimudvahantaṃ bhairavāsyaṃ tvaritamabhidhāvantaṃ ruvantaṃ sasaṃbhramaṃ
                        praharantaṃ naṣṭanidraṃ
                        niśāvicāriṇamannadveṣiṇamanāhāramapyatibalinamannakāle hasantaṃ nirlajjaṃ
                        śūraṃ roṣaṇamapriyavādinamaśuciṃ srīmadyamāṃsaraktamālyapriyaṃ raktamāmiṣaṃ
                        vā dṛṣṭvoṣṭhau parilihantaṃ dīnaṃ śaṅkitaṃ dhāvantamakasmādrudantaṃ hasantaṃ
                        gāyantaṃ nṛtyantaṃ nirarthakaṃ paribhāṣamāṇaṃ rākṣasena |

bhinnagadgadakaṇṭhamaṅgāni bhañjayantaṃ jihvāṃ parilihānamakṣamālayā
                        japamānaṃ śaucamabhīkṣṇaṃ kurvāṇaṃ saṅgamena |

meghavidyududayāyāsate krudhyantaṃ jalavṛṣṭiṃ samantānmanyamānaṃ
                        śakaṭaniṣpīḍinaṃ vidyunmālinā |

asvasthacittaṃ naikatra
                        tiṣṭhantaṃ paridhāvinaṃ dayitanṛtyagītahāsocchiṣṭamadyamāṃsaśūnyanivāsaratiṃ
                        purastādabhighnantaṃ nirbhatsanāddīnaśaṅkitavadanaṃ nakhairātmavapuṣi
                        likhantaṃ naṣṭasmṛtiṃ baddhābaddhabhāṣiṇamakasmādrudantaṃ
                        duḥkhānyāvedayamānamudhvastarūkṣadehasvaraṃ durgandhamaśuciṃ nagnaṃ malinaṃ
                        rathyācailatṛṇābharaṇaṃ saṅkarakūṭakāṣṭhāśvārohiṇaṃ lolaṃ bahvāśinaṃ
                        piśācena |
tatrāpi bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭvā hasantaṃ visvaraṃ krośantaṃ nityabhītaṃ kaśmalena |

vaidyaṃ dṛṣṭvā kupyantaṃ bhramadbhojinaṃ bahvāśinaṃ bhasmaguṇṭhanaśayanaṃ
                        striyo mārge rundhānaṃ mūtrapurīṣavimardinaṃ nistejasā |

nagnaṃ
                        dhāvantamakasmādaśmakāṣṭhādi gṛhītvā bhramantaṃ
                        tṛṇacīramālyanivasanamutrastadṛṣṭiṃ paruṣābhidhāyinaṃ
                        śmaśānaśūnyaikavṛkṣarathyāniṣeviṇaṃ tilānnamadyāmiṣasaktadṛṣṭiṃ kākhordena
                        ||

aprasannadṛṣṭiṃ
                        calannetrapakṣmāṇaṃ śaṅkitekṣaṇaṃ dīnavadanaṃ saṃśuṣkatāluṃ nidrāluṃ
                        pratihatavācamapasavyavastramalpāgnimarocakinaṃ tilaguḍapāyasamāṃsaruciṃ ca
                        pitṛgraheṇa ||
abhyaṅge ca prayoktavyameṣāṃ cūrṇaṃ ca dhūpane ||
mañjiṣṭhāṃ dve niśe kṛṣṇāṃ bastamūtreṇa peṣayet |
vayasthā hiṅgu kaṭukā ṣaḍgranthā saindhavaṃ tathā ||

siddhaṃ siddhārthakaṃ nāma
                        pāne nasye ca yojitam |
bījaṃ karañjāt kusumaṃ śirīṣāt phalaṃ ca valkaṃ ca kapitthavṛkṣāt ||

samāṇimanthaṃ sanataṃ
                        sakuṣṭhaṃ syonākamūlaṃ kiṇihī sitā ca |
bastasya mūtreṇa subhāvitaṃ tat pittena gavyena guḍān vidadhyāt ||

grahā gṛhṇanti ye yeṣu teṣāṃ
                        teṣu viśeṣataḥ |

śvetapatraṃ ca lodhraṃ ca
                        tagaraṃ nāgasarṣapāḥ |

harītakī haridre dve laśuno
                        maricaṃ vacā |
toyasya kumbhaḥ palalaṃ chatraṃ vastraṃ vilepanam ||

ebhireva ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ gavāṃ
                        mūtre caturguṇe |

piśācānāṃ baliḥ sīdhuḥ
                        piṇyākaḥ palalaṃ dadhi |

ṛte piśācāt sarveṣu
                        pratikūlaṃ ca nācaret |

mahāvidyāṃ ca māyūrīṃ
                        śucistaṃ śrāvayet sadā ||
tatronmādo nāma ya unmārgagaiḥ śārīramānasairdoṣairmanaso madaḥ ||

teṣāṃ punarunmārgagatve hetuḥ
                        śamalaṃ
                        vikṛtopahitamahitamanucitamannapānavidhinirapekṣamāhārajātamatyupakṣīṇadehānāṃ
                        vyavāyavyādhivegasamudgame viṣamaśarīraceṣṭopasevā devadvijagurūllaṅghanaṃ
                        vā rāgadveṣajanitābhirādhibhirmanovighāto viṣopaviṣagaropayogo vā ||

ebhirhīnasatvasya manasyupahate
                        buddhau pracalitāyāmatyudīrṇatvāddoṣāḥ prakupitā hṛdayamupasṛtya manovahāni
                        srotāṃsyāvṛtya janayantyunmādam ||

tatra śirasaḥ śūnyatā
                        cakṣuṣorasvasthatvaṃ svanaḥ
                        karṇayorucchvāsādhikyamāsyasaṃsravaṇamannānabhilāṣo 'rocako 'vipāko
                        hṛdayagraho 'sthāne dhyānāyāsasammohodvegāḥ satataṃ romaharṣo jvaro
                        'bhīkṣṇamunmattacittatvamudarditvamarditākṛtikaraṇaṃ vyādheḥ svapne ca
                        darśanamabhīkṣṇaṃ bhrāntacittacalitānavasthitānāmapraśastānāṃ rūpāṇāṃ
                        tilapīḍakavaccakrādhirohaṇaṃ vātakuṇḍalikābhirunmathanaṃ nimajjanaṃ
                        kaluṣāṇāmambhasāmāvarteṣu cakṣuṣoścāpasarpaṇāmiti doṣanimittānāmunmādānāṃ
                        pūrvarūpāṇi |

tataśca deho hatasārathiriva
                        ratho 'karṇadhāra iva cāpsu plavaḥ sukhaduḥkhācāradharmādharmapralupto
                        'kasmād bhramati ||

tatravātādasthānasmitahasitanṛttagītavāditravāgaṅgavikṣepavāgbhedabhrū
                        vikṣeparodanakrośanāsphoṭanāni paryaṭanamajasramāsyāt phenāgamo
                        yānamayānairalaṅkaraṇamanalaṅkārikairdravyairlobho 'bhyavahāryeṣu labdheṣu
                        cāvamānastīvraṃ mātsaryaṃ kārśyaṃ pāruṣyamutpiṇḍitāruṇākṣatā jīrṇe 'nne
                        cātibalavatvam ||

pittāt krodhaḥ
                        santarjanamakasmānmuṣṭiloṣṭakāṣṭhaśastrairabhidravaṇaṃ nagnatā
                        pracchāyaśiśirābhirātirudakābhilāṣaḥ santāpaḥ
                        pītāvasraṃsanamanimittamanalajvalanopaśaṅkāhni tārakādarśanaṃ
                        tāmraharitahāridrasaṃrabdhākṣatvaṃ ca ||

kaphādalpavākceṣṭāhāratvamarocako vamathuruṣṇasevā
                        lālāsiṅghaṇakasravaṇaṃ rahaḥ kāmatā strīpriyatvaṃ nidrābībhatsatvaṃ
                        śaucadveṣaḥ śvayathurāsye śuklastimitamalāvilākṣatā bhukte rātrau ca
                        balavatvamiti |
yuñjyāttāṃni hi śuddhasya nayanti prakṛtiṃ manaḥ ||

dvau prasthau svarasātbrahmyā
                        ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca sādhitam |

pāṇḍukaṇḍūviṣe śoṣe mehe mohe
                        jvare gare |

jaṭilā pūtanā keśī cāraṭī
                        markaṭī vacā |
rāsnāṃ viṣaghnāṃ laśunaṃ viśalyāṃ surasaṃ vacām ||

tiktakaṃ jīvanīyaṃ ca sarpiḥ
                        snehaśca miśrakaḥ ||
vidhyet sirāṃ yathoktāṃ vā tṛptaṃ medyāmiṣasya vā |
tena yāti śamaṃ tasya sarvato viplutaṃ manaḥ |

baliṃ ca dadyāt palalaṃ
                        yāvakaṃ saktupiṇḍikām |
catuṣpathe gavāṃ tīrthe nadīnāṃ saṅgameṣu ca ||
hate sattve hṛdi vyāpte saṃjñāvāhiṣu kheṣu ca ||
pānaṃ tailasya madyasya tayoreva ca mehanam ||

tatra vātāt sphuratsakthiḥ
                        pratataṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ |
apasmarati saṃjñāṃ ca labhate visvaraṃ rudan ||

apasmarati pittena muhuḥ
                        saṃjñāṃ ca vindati |

kapilānāṃ gavāṃ pittaṃ
                        nāvanaṃ paramaṃ hitam |
pitteṣu sādhitaṃ tailaṃ nasye 'bhyaṅge ca śasyate ||
bastamūtre hitaṃ nasyaṃ cūrṇaṃ vādhmāpayet bhiṣak ||

vyoṣaṃ ca bastamūtreṇa
                        piṣṭvā vartīṃ prakalpayet |
tadeva sarpiṣā yuktaṃ dhūpanaṃ paramaṃ hitam ||
srotāṃsi cāsya śudhyanti smṛtiṃ saṃjñāṃ ca vindati ||
vartmasandhiṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vā sarvamakṣi vā ||

rogān kuryuḥ calastatra
                        prāpya vartmāśrayāḥ sirāḥ |
vimardanāt syācca śamaḥ kṛcchronmīlaṃ vadanti tamū ||

vimuktasandhi niśceṣṭaṃ hīnaṃ
                        vātahataṃ hi tat ||

karoti kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca
                        pittaṃ pakṣmāntamāśritam |
pakṣmaṇāṃ śatanaṃ cānu pakṣmaśātaṃ vadanti tam ||

pothakyaḥ piṭakāḥ śvetāḥ
                        sarṣapābhā ghanāḥ kkaphāt |
raktaṃ raktena tatsrāvi cchinnaṃ cchinnaṃ ca vardhate ||

madhye vā vartmano 'nte vā
                        kaṇḍūṣārugvatī sthirā |

kṛchrabodhe purāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ
                        drākṣākalkakvāthasiddhaṃ śarkarāvacūrṇitaṃ rātrau pāyayet |

vātaharadravyakalpitāṃśca bastīn kṣīrasvinnaireraṇḍapallavaiḥ svedaṃ ca
                        vartmanām ||

1AS.Utt.12.4 kumbhīkāpiṭakāsu vartma likhitvā saindhavenānupratisārya
                        paṭolāmalakamadhukakvāthena secayet ghṛtena ca ||
likhite ca vartmani srutarakte yaṣṭyāhvaniryūheṇa prakṣālanam |

kākajaṅghā rohita matsyamāṃsaṃ ca kākaśoṇitabhāvitamantardhūmaṃ dagdhaṃ
                        cūrṇāñjanaṃ kuryāt ||

pothakīrvilikhya
                        śuṇṭhīsaindhavamāgadhikācūrṇaiḥ pratisārya prakṣālya coṣṇāmbhasā
                        khadirasārāḍhakīśigrupatrakaṣāyeṇa secayet |

utsaṅgapiṭakāmañjananāmikāṃ
                        ca bhitvā niṣpīḍya collikhitāṃ tagarailāsaindhavanepālīcūrṇena sakṣaudreṇa
                        pratisārayet |

vedanāyāṃ tu kuṣṭhaguḍūcīkalkodakena saguḍakṣaudreṇa pariṣeko mūrdhānaṃ
                        cāsyakaṭutailenābhyajya pāṭhākalkena
                        pralipyārjunabilvanirguṇḍīmārkavatarkārīsairyakakārpāsīmālatīpatraniryūheṇa
                        secayet ||

pakṣmoparodhe samupacitaṃ
                        vartma lekhanenotkliṣṭaṃ raktaṃ visrāvaṇena saśophaṃ
                        śirovirekakavalavamanairyāpayet ||

pravṛddheṣu tu romasu
                        viśuddhadehasya sahiṣṇorbhruvodhastāddvau bhāgau pakṣmāntāt bhāgamekaṃ
                        samutsṛjya yavamātraṃ tadākṛti tiryak chedayedārdravāsasā ca raktaṃ gṛhṇīyāt
                        ||

tatstanubhūte rakte
                        kṣaumasūtreṇa bālena vā dhanurvakrayā sūcyā mudgamātrāntaraiḥ padaiḥ sīvyet
                        |

tato 'sya lalāṭe paṭṭaṃ badhvā tatsīvanasūtraṃ tatra
                        sūcīpadairnātigāḍhaślathamāsajjet |

vraṇavedanāyāṃ vastrabaddhena yaṣṭīmadhukacūrṇena saṃskṛtaṃ sarpiḥ pariṣeko
                        vaṭādikvaṣāyāśca sakṣīrāḥ |

pañcame ṣaṣṭhe vāhani sthirībhūteṣu śastrapadeṣu
                        sīvanasūtramavalambakācchitvāpanayet |
tatra mṛduḥ svedaḥ snaihikaṃ ca nasyam ||

nirbhujya vā
                        vartmadoṣopahatāṃ valīṃ vilikhya tumburuvakrakuśābhayābījānyatamakalkena
                        pratisārayet kṣāreṇa vā dahettaprayā vā śalākayā ||

upapakṣmāṇi tu lākṣārasena
                        lakṣayitvā sandaṃśenoddhṛtya tanusūcyagreṇāgnivarṇena romakūpān dahet |
na sraṃsate calati vā vartmaivaṃ sarvatastataḥ ||
striyāḥ kṣīre chagalyā vā mṛditaṃ netrasecanam ||

vāyuḥ kruddhaḥ sirāḥ prāpya
                        jalābhaṃ jalavāhinīḥ |

kaphāt kaphāsrave śvetaṃ
                        picchilaṃ bahalaṃ sravet ||
tāmrā mudgopamā bhinnā raktaṃ sravati parvaṇī ||

purāṇaṃ viṣamaṃ madhye
                        vicchinnaṃ yacca śukrakam |

upanāhaṃ bhiṣak svinnaṃ
                        vrīhimukhena bhitvā maṇḍalāgreṇa samantāllekhayet |

kṛmigranthiṃ karīṣeṇa svinnaṃ
                        bhitvā vilikhya ca kāsīsasaindhavatriphalāmākṣikaiḥ pratisārayet ||

viśeṣatastilanālān yavanālān
                        vā haritaśalākānardhamāsamajākṣīreṇa bhāvayitvā śoṣayitvā ca dāhayet |

stanyānvitaṃ vā kāsīsaṃ kṣaudradrutaṃ vā kāsīsasaindhavamarjune
                        mātuluṅgarasena saśarkareṇāścyotanaṃ mastunā vā ||

sphaṭikakuṅkumaśaṅkhanābhimadhuyaṣṭikā vā kṣaudrārdrāstadvadvā rasāñjanaṃ
                        kāsīsaṃ vā ||

arma tu pañcavidhamapi
                        yattanuraktaṃ dhūmāvilaṃ dadhinibhaṃ vā tacchukravat
                        kāyaśirovirekalekhanāñjanairupācaret ||

athetarasmin
                        snigdhasyāturasya peyāvilepijāṅgalarasānyatamāśitasya kṛtasvastyayanasya
                        sukhaśayanagatasyottānadehasya kiñcidavākśirasaḥ
                        sukhoṣṇāmbuplutatāntavasvinnanayanasya saindhavena
                        sabījapūrakarasenāñjayitvāṅguṣṭhakena nimīlitamakṣi
                        vimṛdgīyādābalāsagrathitarūpotpatteḥ |

itthaṃ ca saṃroṣitākṣasya pracalite 'rmādhimāṃsake niścalaṃ paricārakaḥ
                        śirodhārayet ||

anyaśca
                        vāmadakṣiṇānyatarapārśve 'nukūlaṃ sthito dṛḍhavastragarbhābhyāmaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ
                        vartmanī nikṣipet |

atha vaidyaḥ kanīnakāt pravṛddhe 'rmaṇyapāṅgamakṣimāṇasya yatra yatra valī
                        jāyate tatra tatrārma baḍiśena mucuṭyā vā nātyāyataṃ gṛhītvā kiñcidunnamya
                        kṛṣṇaśuklamaṇḍalābhyāṃ sarvataḥ sūcyagreṇa mokṣayitvā kiñcidāñchet |

atha tīkṣṇena maṇḍalāgreṇa vṛddhipatreṇa vā vilikhya kanīnakaṃ copānīya
                        kanīnakasamameva caturbhāgaśeṣaṃ chindyāt |

yattu jālavadarma vyāpi
                        tadeṣiṇyā yāvatkanīnakamanusarannunmocyonnamayya pūrvavat chindyāt |

tadvadapāṅgāt pravṛddhe kanīnakamīkṣamāṇasya yāvadapāṅgaṃ
                        copanīyāpāṅgasamameva tathā yāvadvarjayedapāṅgaṃ sirāścetyādi |

tataḥ plotena raktaṃ viśodhya samyak chinnamavekṣya saindhavacūrṇena punaḥ
                        punaḥ pratisārayedyavanālabhasmanā vā plotaśuddhaṃ ca punarmadhunā |

tataḥ śītāmbu pariṣiktaṃ sarpiṣā sukhoṣṇena pariṣicya madhughṛtāktaṃ pūrvavat
                        badhnīyāt |
mūrdhni pādayoścāsmai śatadhautaghṛtaṃ śītāṃśca pradehān dadyāt ||

dvitīye cāhni sāyaṃ prātarmadhukasarpiṣā koṣṇena śirastathāvabaddhameva cākṣi
                        siñcet |
pañcāhaṃ coṣṇodakānupānaṃ sarpiḥ pītvā jīrṇe pathyamaśnīyāt ||

tṛtīye divase vimucya
                        karañjabījasiddhena kṣīreṇākṣi svedayet |

lodhramadhukakiṃśukapaṭoladviharidrākoraṇḍamukulakvāthena
                        madhumiśreṇāścyotayet saptame 'hani sarvathā muñcet ātapākāśadarśanaṃ ca
                        pariharet ||

saśophe tu netre dhūmaḥ
                        śirovirecanaṃ ca |

tilān sulikhitān
                        madhukakākolīsuniṣaṇṇakapañcamūlaśarkarāśrutaśīte payasi saptāhaṃ
                        bhāvitāṃstenaiva payasā pīḍayet |

tattailamebhirevauṣadhaiḥ payasā cāṣṭaguṇena siddhaṃ nāvanādaśrurāgaghnaṃ
                        dṛṣṭiprasādanaṃ ca kṛṣṇagate tu vraṇe vraṇaśukravat kriyā |

sirājāle sirā yāstu sthūlāḥ
                        kaṭhināścatā baḍiśena gṛhītvā maṇḍalāgreṇollikhet ||

tatra vraṇaśukre
                        trivṛnniryūheṇa trirvipakvaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayet |

madhukakākolīmṛdvīkotpalavidārīkvāthena
                        mañjiṣṭhākṣīrakākolīmadhukakvathitājakṣīreṇa vā saśarkareṇāścyotayet
                        śītaiścāsya śirovaktraṃ dihyāt siñcecca |

vaiḍūryasphaṭikaśaṅkhamuktāvidrumarūpyāyastraputtāmrasīsālamanaśśilākukkuṭāṇḍatvaksamudraphenarasāñjanasaindhavairajāpayaḥpiṣṭairvartayaśchyāyāśuṣkāḥ
                        kṣaudraghṛṣṭāḥ prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca prayuktā vraṇaśukranudaḥ |

tatra tarpaṇaṃ
                        mṛgaviṣkirapiśitaṃ
                        kāśmaryasuniṣaṇṇotpalamṛṇālaśṛṅgāṭakaśerudrākṣākṣīravidārījīvanīyāṃśca
                        kṣīreṇa pācayet tasmānnavanītamuddhṛtya
                        candanamadhuśarkarānantānīlotpalakalkairaṣṭaguṇena ca payasā vipakvaṃ
                        pūrvavadyojayet ||

puṭapākaṃ ca
                        kukkuṭamuddhṛtāntraṃ veśavārīkṛtya
                        candanasārivāmadhukaśarkarānantānīlotpalaprapauṇḍarīka jīvanīyakalkaiḥ
                        samadhughṛtaiḥ saṃsṛjya prāgiva kalpayet |
śirovirecanadravyavipakvaṃ vā tailaṃ marśaḥ pratimarśo vā ||
aśāmyati tu śukre sarvatra punaḥ punaryathoktameva paryāyeṇa yojayet |

śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyena ghṛṣṭaṃ saghṛtairyavaiḥ śamīpatraiśca dhūpayet anena
                        sandhāvāñjanenāñjayet |
tadvat suvarṇaṃ rūpyamayo va ghṛṣṭaṃ saghṛtairbadarīpatrairdhūpitamañjanam |

śaṅkho nistuṣāśca haritamudgāḥ piṣṭā vartiśrūrṇo vā madhuyukto 'ñjanaṃ
                        śukragharṣaṇam |

masūrā nistuṣāḥ
                        stanyapiṣṭāstaruṇadarbhāṅkurā ghṛtamājaṃ gokṣīraṃ śaraścāyase tāmreṇa
                        ghṛṣṭaṃ pratyañjanaṃ vedanāghnam |

yavagodhūmajīvanīyamāṃsīcūrṇena saghṛtaśarkarotkārikā svedopanāhe praṇītā
                        vedanāmapanayati śukraṃ cotsādayati |
utsannaṃ vā saśalyaṃ vā śukraṃ bālādibhirlikhet puṭapākena vā |

añjanaṃ cāsya
                        prapauṇḍarīkamadhukaharidrāloharajoñjanabṛhatīkṣīrakākolīrajāpayaḥpiṣṭā
                        yavairghṛtayuktairāmalakīpatraiśca paryāyeṇa dhūpitā vartiḥ ||

ajakāṃ pārśvato vidhvā
                        sūcyā visrāvya codakam |

vraṇaṃ gomāṃsacūrṇena
                        baddhaṃ baddhaṃ vimucya ca |

snehāñjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ
                        nasyaṃ ca kṣīrasarpiṣā |

nityaṃ ca śukreṣu śṛtaṃ
                        yathāsvaṃ pāne ca marśe ca ghṛtaṃ vidadhyāt |
na hīyate labdhabalā tathāntastīkṣṇāñjanairdṛk pratataṃ prayuktaiḥ ||
bhūtaṃ tu yatnādāsannaṃ dūre sūkṣmañca nekṣate ||
dṛṣṭiḥ pittena drasvākhyā sā drasvā drasvadarśinī |

kaphena timire prāyaḥ
                        snigdhaṃ śvetañca paśyati |
kācena raktā kṛṣṇā vā dṛṣṭistādṛk ca paśyati |
nakulāndhaḥsa tatrāhni citraṃ paśyati no niśi ||
sthagayanti dṛśaṃ doṣā doṣāndhaḥ sa gadoparaḥ ||

rātrāvāndhyaṃ ca jāyeta
                        vidagdhoṣṇena sā smṛtā ||
dhūmāvilāṃ dhūmadṛśaṃ dṛśaṃ kuryuḥ sa dhūmaraḥ ||

gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ loharajo
                        bhājane bādare sthitam |
lohapātre sthitaṃ māsaṃ māṣarāśau ca bhakṣayet ||

prātarbhaktasya vā
                        pūrvamadyāt pathyāṃ pṛthak pṛthak |
nīlotpalaṃ viḍaṅgāni phenaṃ ca saritāṃ pateḥ ||
saptarātre gate bhūyaḥ piṣṭaṃ kṣīreṇa vartayet |

vasāñjane ca vaiyāghrī
                        vārāhī vā praśasyate |
sośīraiḥ sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ sakṣīraṃ tarpaṇaṃ hitam ||
sadārvīkaiḥ payo yuktaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ ca nāvanam ||
dṛgvaimalyāya vimalā vartiḥ syāt kokilā punaḥ ||
piṣṭaiḥ kṣīridrumakvāthe ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ ca tarpaṇam ||
tatsrutaṃ saghṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ pacet kṣaudraṃ kṣipeddhane |
vayombupiṣṭaiḥ saghṛtaiḥ śiro vaktraṃ ca lepayet ||

na tu tatra sirāṃ vidhyet
                        dṛksthitā yantrapīḍanāt |
kuryurāndhyaṃ malā dadyāt sravye tvasre jalaukasaḥ ||
bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kumbhayoneḥ patraiḥ pāne ca pūjitam ||

kaṇā vā kāpile pitte
                        māsārdhaṃ paribhāvitā |
ghṛte siddhāni jīvantyāḥ pallavāni ca bhakṣayet |
paḍetān yaḥ smarennityaṃ tasya cakṣurna hīyate ||
santarpaṇaṃ snigdhahimādi yojyaṃ tathāñjanaṃ hema ghṛtena ghṛṣṭam ||

cakṣūrakṣāyāṃ sarvakālaṃ
                        manuṣyairyatnaḥ kartavyo jīvite yāvadicchā |

vyārtho loko 'yaṃ tulyarātrindivānāṃ puṃsāmandhānāṃ vidyāmāne 'pi vitte
                        ||
śakunāśanatā sapādapūjā ghṛtapānaṃ ca sadaiva netrarakṣā ||
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ ca sthagayet punaḥ ||

atha snigdhasya viriktasya
                        ghṛtaiḥ sambhojitasya niśi rasena prīṇitottamāṅgasyābhuktavataḥ
                        sajjopakaraṇasya vimale 'hani sādhake ca kṛtasvastyayanasya
                        vihitādityavidehādhipatipraṇāmasya pūrvāhṇe nivātaprakāśadeśasthasya
                        pratyādityamāstaraṇena labdhamārdavāyāṃ bhāmau
                        prasāritacaraṇayugmamupaviṣṭasya kṣititalagatasamatalobhayapāṇeḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ
                        sukhopaviṣṭena paricārakeṇa hastābhyāṃ niścalamavalambitaśirasaḥ
                        kiściduttānāsyasya svāṃ nāsāmitaraccekṣaṇamīkṣamāṇasyāturasya
                        jaṅghayorupariṣṭānnātyucchritāsananiviṣṭo bhiṣag dakṣiṇahastānulomamakṣi
                        mukhabāṣpasvinnaṃ nimīlitamīṣadaṅguṣṭhodaravimṛditatārakatayā pariplutadoṣaṃ
                        savyāṅguṣṭhapradeśinībhyāmunmīlya
                        dakṣiṇamadhyamāpradeśinyaṅguṣṭhairniṣkampaṃ gṛhītayā śalākayā
                        kṛṣṇabhāgādbhāgadvayasyāpāṅgādekabhāgasya ca saṅgame dṛṣṭerārjavaṃ
                        nātyūrdhvamadho vā netrasahajanmani sandhau vidhyet ||

evameva dakṣiṇaṃ
                        dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhapradeśinyunmīlitamitareṇa kareṇaiva cāturasya dakṣiṇapārśve
                        sthitvā ||

atha śabdavadavedanaṃ
                        sāmbubindusruti ca samyagviddhaṃ vidyāt |
tataḥ punarāturamāśvāsya bhramayan śalākāmā dṛṣṭimadhyāt praveśayet ||

atha vyapagatadoṣasya yathāvat paśyataḥ sukhoṣṇaghṛtāplutaṃ
                        picumīkṣaṇasyopari datvā badhnīyāt |

tato nivātamāgāramanupraveśya saṃveśya ca sopadhāne mṛduśayane śayānaṃ
                        dakṣiṇe 'kṣiṇi viddhe vāmena pārśvena vāme
                        dakṣiṇenobhayasminnuttānamanukūlābhiḥ kathābhirupācaret |
tṛtīye cāhni muktvākṣi pariṣecayederaṇḍapallavaśṛtena dugdhoṣṇena dugdhena |

bhojayeccainaṃ vyoṣāmalakayuktaṃ dravamīṣatsnehalavaṇaṃ
                        vāṭyamuṣṇodakadvitīyaṃ vilepīṃ vā |

tadanuvṛttau tu
                        yaṣṭīmadhukalodhramṛdvīkāsaindhavaiḥ siddhena sasitenājapayasā
                        nayanamāścyotayet |

tatrādhovyadhādatyarthaśūlāsrasrutirāgāḥ śalākāyāṃścopalepo
                        bahalapicchilaḥ kṛṣṇāṃ valibhirupacīyate nayanaṃ sravati tadvarjayet ||
tatra stanyamadhukavipakvena sarpiṣā pariṣeko 'pāṅge vā dāhaḥ ||
atītya dṛṣṭiṃ śalākāyāḥ preraṇādraktasravaṇaṃ raktābharūpadarśanaṃ ca |

tatra śalākayā spṛṣṭo liṅganāśo yaḥ sphuṭati tameraṇḍapatrasvinnaṃ khaṇḍaśaḥ
                        śodhayet |

avagalati tu śalākāmapanīya stanyasekaṃ dadyādavapīḍanaṃ ca śuṇṭhīguḍaṃ
                        jalaukasaśca |
vistīryamāṇe sukhoṣṇāmbuplutena vāsasā svedo ghṛtamaṇḍaśca pratimarśaḥ |
tadvadutplavamāne vitrāsanaṃ śītāmbhasā pratataṃ cocchiṅkhanaṃ ca ||

tathāpyanapagacchati śalākāpagamane vā punarutplavane
                        snehapānanasyādibhirupapādya punarvidhyet |

yastvapakṛṣyamāṇo
                        dṛṣṭimaṇḍale līyate tatra kṣīreṇa nāḍīsvedaṃ dadyāt |
kaṇṭhā ca viṣamāśrūṇi drasvā dīrghā ca durgrahā ||

ājena tāmramamunā pratanupradigdhaṃ saptāhataḥ punaridaṃ payasaiva piṣṭam
                        ||

piṇḍāñjanaṃ
                        hitamanātapaśuṣkamakṣṇi viddhe prasādajananaṃ balakṛcca dṛṣṭeḥ |

śuṣkālpā dūṣikā śītamalpaṃ
                        cāśru calā rujaḥ |
anekarūpā jāyante vraṇo dṛṣṭau ca dṛṣṭihā ||
raktotpanno hanti tadvattrirātrānmithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva ||

atha khalu sarvagākṣirogāṇāṃ
                        pūrvarūpa eva śirovirekakavaladhūmopavāsānāsevetānyatra mārutodrekāt ||

śvetalodhratvacaṃ
                        bahirvilikhitāṃ nimbapatrakalkena pradigdhāṃ puṭapāke
                        vipakvāmardhapalonmitāṃ maricacatuṣṭayayuktāṃ ślakṣṇarajīkṛtāṃ
                        vastrabaddhāmakṣṇyavakiret |

pūrvavadvā
                        lodhravalkalakalkamupaskṛtaṃ tanmātrameva maricadvayena
                        manaśśilāpādenāṣṭāṃśakaiśca yaṣṭīmadhukaśatapuṣpāñjanairyuktaṃ prakalpayet |
taccūrṇaṃ sakṛcūdavarṇanānniśīthe netrāṇāṃ vidhamati sadya eva kopam ||

evaṃ cānupaśame
                        vātābhiṣyandinamādāveva jāṅgalarasairbhejayitvā
                        daśamūlarāsnātriphalākvāthena jīvanīyakalkena ca payoyutaṃ siddhamitaradvā
                        purāṇasarpiḥ pāyayet ||

punaśca snigdhāya tilvakena saṃyuktaṃ vā tilvakakaṣāyānupānaṃ sarpirvirecanaṃ
                        dadyāt |

atha tilān nistuṣān
                        bilvaphalakvāthena bhāvayenniśi divā śoṣayedevaṃ pañcāham |

tebhyastailaṃ gṛhītvā varāhamedoyuktaṃ bilvamūlamadhuyaṣṭikākalkena payasā ca
                        pacet |

tataḥ snehamuddhṛtya candanośīraśarkarotpalakalkena kṣīravatā pakvaṃ tarpaṇam
                        |

puṭapākaṃ ca
                        chāgorabhravarāhāṇāmanyatamasya yakṛt pippalīsaindhavamadhughṛtopetaṃ kuryāt
                        |

kṛṣṇatilān nistuṣān kṛtvā
                        stanyena saptāhaṃ bhāvayecchoṣayecca |

taccūrṇaṃ sitopalāsamaṃ kṛtvā madhukārdhabhāgena saindhavāṃśena
                        kṛṣṇasarpaśirasaścāntardhūmadagdhasya bhāgena saṃsṛṣṭaṃ divyodakapiṣṭāṃ
                        guṭikāṃ kārayet ||
eṣā māsaṃ sthitā rasakriyā dṛṣṭiprasādanī rujāharā ca ||

nīlībhūtaṃ ca tadviśuṣkaṃ mastunā vartayaḥ kṛtāḥ chāyāviśoṣitā vātākṣirogaṃ
                        jayanti |

sarpiṣānupaśame tailaṃ
                        vasāṃ majjānaṃ pūrvoktavidhivadvyatyāsena kuryāt |
tenaiva ca saśarkarastrīstanye cchāgadugdhe vā dāharāgaghnaḥ ||

śvetalodhraṃ madhukaṃ ca
                        samaṃ ghṛtena bharjayitvā cūrṇayet |

tataḥ poṭṭalikāvabaddhaṃ stanyena toyena vā mṛditamāśu
                        śūladāharāgaśophānapohati |

suvarṇagairikaṃ niśāṃ
                        devyembhāsi sthitamahaḥ śoṣayet saptāha mevameva ca suśītena
                        madhuravargakaṣāyeṇa bhāvayedetaccūrṇāñjanaṃ dāharāgaghnam ||

parisrutaṃ ca punarādarvīlepādavatārya ca sitopalāsamāṃśaṃ madhughṛtadvipalaṃ
                        prakṣipet |

nimbapaṭolajātipatralodhradvayamahauṣadhaiḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ
                        kalpitairvastrabaddhaiḥ sakṣaudrairgauḍe sīdhau vā pariplutaiḥ sekaḥ paraṃ
                        śleṣmaśūladhraḥ ||

tathāpi śophagharṣānubandhe
                        yavamadanabhūrjaśamīpatraiḥ saghṛtairghṛtenaiva vā nāḍyākṣi dhūpayet |

laghvaśitaṃ ca dvitīyehni prātarvyoṣavipakvaṃ yavakṣārāvacūrṇitaṃ sarpiḥ
                        pāyayet |

saptasaptāhe ca gate vartayaḥ kāryāḥ maricaharidrābhayāñjanairvā jalapiṣṭā
                        vartiḥ |

harītakī tutthaṃ ca
                        samabhāgaṃ tutthādaṣṭāṃśena maricameṣā vartiḥ kumārī sarvaśleṣmākṣirogaghnī
                        ||

viḍaṅgacūrṇo vā vāruṇyā
                        bhāvitaḥ śaṅkho bījapūrarasena madhukaṃ triphalārasena pṛthagaikadhyaṃ vā
                        cūrṇāñjanaṃ vā piṇḍo vā pothakībahalakaphotkleśābhiṣyandānapaharati ||

yakṛdājamagarupriyaṅgunaladadevadāruyutaṃ payasi kvāthayettasmin
                        śīte khajamathite yannavanītaṃ tadebhirevauṣadhairvipakvam |

keśairjalārdraiḥ
                        kāṃsyamudgharṣayet tān kāṃsyamaladigdhānantardhūmaṃ dagdhvā tat bhasma
                        triphalākvāthe surasāsvarase kṣīre ca chāge pañcāhaṃ bhāvayet |

kṛṣṇasarpaṃ payasi
                        kvāthayettataḥ pūtaśītamathitāt snehamupoṣitāya kṛkavākave dadyāt |

kṛṣṇasarpamukhamañjanasarpiṣoḥ pūrṇaṃ darbhaveṣṭitaṃ
                        mṛdavaliptamadhomukhaṃ gomayenāgninādagdhvā tatoñjanamādāya
                        patranaladanīlotpalatulyaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ paraṃ dṛkprasādajananamañjanam ||
stanye vā chāgadugdhe vā sadyaḥkope tadañjanam ||

sārivāvidārībalāmadhukotpaladrākṣāṭarūṣakajīvakacandanairjāṅgalarasakṣīropetaṃ
                        tailaṃ sādhitaṃ nāvanāt sarvordhvajatrujān gadān vātapittottarān nihanti
                        ||

ādarśamaṇḍale ghṛtāktakeśān
                        ghṛṣṭvāntardhūmaṃ dahet sā maṣī ghṛtapiṣṭāyasabhājanasthitākṣipākamañjanā
                        dapaharati ||

evamapyaśāntau madhukasiddhaḥ śatāhvācūrṇayukto ghṛtamaṇḍastathā payo vā
                        bastiḥ ||

tataḥ piṇḍasvinnaśirasaḥ
                        sarṣapatailena saindhavayutena vā sarpiṣā phaṇijjakayuktena vā aṇutailena
                        śiṃrovirekaḥ |

śaśaśiraḥkapālaṃ saindhavaṃ
                        kāṃsye stanyaghṛṣṭaṃ sandhāvo vedanāghnaḥ |

śaṅkhaṃ tāmre stanyena ghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtābhyaktayavaśamīpatradhūpitaṃ
                        gharṣavedanāghnam ||

tālīsapatrapippalīloharrajoñjanakāsīsatagarajātīmukulasaindhavairgomūtrapiṣṭaistāmramāliptaṃ
                        saptarātraṃ sthāpayitvā punastadvadevapiṣṭairguṭikāḥ kāryāstāḥ stanyaghṛṣṭāḥ
                        stambhaśvayathuharṣagharṣāśrukaṇḍūghnyaḥ ||

abaddhāsthisahakāramāṃsaṃ
                        vigatatvacaṃ samatāmracūrṇamīṣat saindhavopetaṃ gavyena dadhnā piṣṭvā
                        tāmramālepayet |
śuṣkaṃ śuṣkaṃ tathaiva ca piṣṭvā punarlepayet |

tuvarikāphalatrikarocanākvāthena madhumatā sāyaṃ prātaḥ sadā
                        prakṣālanamañjanānte ca kaṣāyavṛkṣapallavakaṣāyeṇa ||

tutthakapalaṃ viṃśatiśca
                        śvetamaricāni dhānyāmla piṣṭāni tatpalaistriṃśatā tāmrapātre samāloḍitāni
                        bahuvarṇāmapi pillānāṃ paramamāścyotanam ||

añjanaṃ
                        cāsyāmradhātakīpuṣpatilaparṇīkalkena ca varttiḥ
                        harītakyāḍhakīścāṣṭaguṇembhāsyaṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ kvāthayet punaśca
                        parisrāvyādarvīpralepādrasakriyeyaṃ pillākṣiropaṇī |

paripelavakāsīsaharidrādvayasarṣapapriyaṅgutagarapippalīkalkena
                        tāmrabhājanamantarlepayitvā sauvīrakakumbhedhomukhaṃ saptāhaṃ vāsayet tato
                        guṭikāścūrṇaṃ vā kuryāt ||
śākaṃ caivaṃvidhaṃ māṃsaṃ jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ sitām ||

saindhavaṃ triphalāṃ
                        drākṣāṃ vāri pāne ca nābhasam |

dve pādamadhye
                        pṛthusanniveśe sire gate te bahudhā ca netre |

cirācca pākaḥ pakvaṃ tu
                        lasīkāmalpaśaḥ sravet |
uccaiḥ kṛcchrācchrutiṃ kuryāt badhiratvaṃ krameṇa ca ||

votana śoṣitaḥ śleṣmā sroto
                        limpettato bhavet |
rug gauravaṃ pidhānaṃ ca sa pratīnāhasaṃjñitaḥ ||

kapho vidagdhaḥ pittena
                        sarujaṃ nīrujaṃ tathā |

eko nīruganeko vā garbhe
                        māṃsāṅkuraḥ sthiraḥ |

sarvaṇaḥ sarujaḥ stabdhaḥ
                        śvayaghuḥ sa upekṣitaḥ ||
saṅkocayati rūḍhā ca sā dhruvaṃ karṇaśaṣkulīm ||

kṛśā dṛḍhā ca tantrīvat
                        pālī vātena tantrikā ||

vātaje karṇaśūle rātrau
                        rātrau rasabhojanottaraṃ vātaharadravyasiddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibonniranno vā
                        payonupānam ||

tato daśamūlasiddhe chāge
                        payasi gośṛṅganihite 'gnivarṇān pāṣāṇān sandaṃśena gṛhītvāvapet |

ghṛtatailavasābhyaktāni
                        taruṇānyaśvatthapatrāṇi puṭapāksvinnāni prapīḍya tadrasena karṇaṃ pūrayet
                        ||
tato dahyamānādyaḥ snehaḥ patati sa sadyaḥ karṇarujamapaharati ||

madhūcchiṣṭakaiḍaryamadhuśigruphalavacāyavanaladailāguggulubhiḥ
                        ślakṣṇapiṣṭaiḥ kṣaumavastraṃ dhūmavarttipramāṇapariṇāhaṃ lepayettataḥ
                        sūtreṇāveṣṭya ḍuṇḍukanālena dhūmaṃ pātuṃ dadyāt ||

parihāryāṇi ca
                        pariharedviśeṣataḥ pravātaṃ śītāmbupānaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ ca ||

pittaje tu śūle prātaḥ
                        śarkarāyutaṃ sarpiḥ pāyayet |

madhukakuḍavaṃ
                        ṣoḍaśaguṇenāmbhasāṣṭāvaśeṣaṃ sādhayitvā tena tailārddhakuḍavamaṣṭaguṇakṣīraṃ
                        yaṣṭīsadhukośīrasārivākākolījīvakānantāmṛṇālamañjiṣṭhālodhracandanabisagarbhaṃ
                        pacet |

eṣāmeva ca kalkena
                        saghṛtena karṇa parito lepayet |

kaphaje pippalīvipakvaṃ
                        ghṛtamathavā sakṣaudraṃ pāyayitvā taṃ vāmayet |

rasāñjanamārkavavaijayantīśigrulaśunārdrakamūlakadalīnāṃ vā pṛthak samastānāṃ
                        vā rasena madhunā vā rakṣoghnatailena vā |

upadigdhaṃ ca srotaḥ
                        sāyaṃprātaḥ picuvartibhiḥ pramṛjya yavāgarumadanaiḥ saghṛtairguggulunā vā
                        dhūpayitvā madhunā pūrayet ||

palāśadhavatiniśakakubhasarjatvakkvātha rasakriyayā svabhyaktāṃ
                        picuvartiṃ srotasi dadyāt |
eṣāmeva ca kaṣāyeṇa sakṣaudreṇa kapitthasvarasena vā prakṣālanam |

bādhiryaṃ ca
                        bālavṛddhakṣīṇakāsaśoṣiṇāṃ cirotthitaṃ ca varjayet ||

tatra prāgeva purāṇasarpiṣā
                        vā vātaharatailena vā snigdhaṃ snehenaiva virecayet |

karṇāsannaṃ jalaukobhistato bastikarmamūrdhatailanasyadhūmān karṇapūraṇaṃ ca
                        śīlayet ||

taruṇabilvaphalāni
                        gomūtreṇa kvāthayettena kvāthena sitāmadhukabījakabījakalkena ca payoyuktaṃ
                        tailaṃ pācayet |

tattailamuṣṇaṃ śīte bilvakvāthe prakṣipya manthayet yāvat piṇḍībhūtamuddhṛtya
                        caitatpunaranyatra bilvodake manthayet |

tataścoddhṛtyāṣṭaguṇe payasi madhukagandhacandanagarbhaṃ sādhitamāśu
                        karṇapūraṇāt bādhiryaṃ nāśayati ||

tilān navapralūnān
                        vastrabaddhān vahantīṣvapsu rātrimuṣitān divā śoṣayet pañcarātram |

evaṃ gate pañcarātre
                        madhuyaṣṭikākṣīrakākolīmahāpañcamūladevadāruśatāhvājīvakakvathite payasi
                        pañcāhamevaṃ vāsayecchoṣayecca |
tatonenaiva kṣīreṇaiṣāmeva ca dravyāṇāṃ cūrṇamātrayā yuktān prapīḍayet |

etannasye karṇapūraṇe śirasi cābhyañjane praṇītamāśu śūlanādabādhiryāṇi
                        sarvavātavikārāṃśca pittānubandhānapohati bhagnāsthisandhānajananaṃ ca
                        ||

atha karṇau suptāviva
                        bhavatastatsamīpe yathoktāṃ sirāṃ mokṣayet |

pratīnāhe snehasvedaklinnaṃ
                        karṇaṃ karṇaśodhanena viśodhya tailasya pūrayenmātuluṅgarasasya vā
                        saśuktakṣaudrasaindhavasya ||

śodhyamāne vedanā raktāgamo
                        vā yadi bhavettato ghṛtamaṇḍena pūrayennasyaṃ ca śīlayet |

karṇavidradhiṃ vamanapūrvaṃ
                        vidradhivadāmaṃ pakvaṃ ca cikitset |

godhāpratudaviṣkirānūpaudakamāṃsavasāmajjānaṃ sarpissarṣapatailaṃ ca
                        yathālābhaṃ
                        saṅgṛhyārkālarkabalātibalānantāvidārigandhājalaśūkamadhuravargapratīvāpaṃ
                        vipacedayamabhyaṅgaḥ pālyāḥ paraṃ māṃsajananaḥ ||

evamapi tu yā kṣīyate pālī
                        tasyā yadduṣṭaṃ tacchitvā vidhivat sandhāya yathoktena krameṇopacaret ||

ebhireva ca sarvaissamaricanimbapatramadhūcchiṣṭaissarṣapatailaṃ siddhaṃ
                        lehikāvraṇaghno 'bhyaṅgaḥ paridahane jalajābhirasṛk srāvayet |

grathitāyāṃ granthiṃ pāṭayitvā vilikhya ca kṛṣṇāsaindhavamadhubhiḥ
                        pratisārayet |

samāsatastu pañcadaśa
                        karṇasandhayaḥ prāyo nāmānugatasaṃsthānasthānaviśeṣatayā sambhavanti ||

yā tvekaiva pālī sthūlā
                        pṛthvī sthirā ca syāt tāṃ dvidhā pāṭayitvopari chitvā sandadhyāt ||

gaṇḍotkṛttena vā saśoṇitena
                        sānubandhena māṃsena pālīṃ kalpayet |
yasya pālīdvayamapi nāsti tasyāpyeṣa eva vidhiḥ |

athavā samānavayodoṣādeḥ sañcārya karṇapīṭhaṃ samaṃ madhya niveśya varddhayet
                        ||

sandhānavidhiḥ punarāture
                        grathitakeśānte bandhanamupaghārite chedyabhedyalekhyairupapannairupapādya
                        karṇaṃ śoṇitamavekṣeta duṣṭamaduṣṭaṃ veti ||

tato vātaduṣṭe
                        dhānyāmloṣṇodakābhyāṃ pittaduṣṭe kṣīraśītodakābhyāṃ śleṣmaduṣṭe
                        vāruṇīsalilābhyāṃ prakṣālya punaścāvalikhyānunnatamahīnaviṣamaṃ sandhiṃ
                        niveśya tato madhughṛtābhyāmabhyajya picuplotayoranyatareṇāvaguṇṭhya sūtreṇa
                        nātigāḍhamaśithilaṃ ca badhvā sirāvyathoktena kapālasya vā
                        cūrṇenāvakīryācārikamupadiśet ||
tryahāccaturahādvā salilena pariṣicya picuṃ sūtraṃ cāpanayet |
na cāśuddharaktamatipravṛttaraktaṃ kṣīṇaraktaṃ vā karṇaṃ sandadhyāt ||

tasya hi svayamapi
                        sandhirviśliṣyate ādhmāyate śyāvatāmupaiti pacyate śuṣyati cirādrohati
                        rūḍhopyābharaṇaṃ na kṣamate |

sarvatra caivamapi
                        sopadravasandhau sandhiṃ vimucya pūrvāpacāropasthāpitasmṛtiḥ
                        samyaksandadhīteti |
sīvyet gaṇḍaṃ tataḥ sūcyā sīvanyā picuyuktayā ||
kruddhā vātolbaṇā doṣā nāsāyāṃ styānatāṃ gatāḥ |

tatra vātāt pratiśyāye
                        mukhaśoṣo bhṛśaṃ kṣavaḥ |

kīṭakā iva sarpanti manyate
                        parito bhruvau |
śleṣmā sucikkaṇaḥ pīto jñānaṃ ca rasagandhayoḥ ||
ajasraṃ picchilaṃ śītaṃ pakvaṃ siṅghāṇakaṃ ghanam ||
kaphaṃ sa śuṣkaḥ puṭatāṃ prāpnoti puṭakaṃ tu tat ||
ghṛtāktasaktūn mallakasampuṭe kṛtvā dhūmaṃ ca pibet ||

atha vātapratiśyāye pūrvameva
                        vātaharadravyavipakvaṃ sasaindhavaṃ prātaḥ sarpiḥ pibenmahāṣaṭpalaṃ vā
                        ||

daśamūlakulatthakolayavaśuṣkamūlakavyoṣalavaṇapañcakaiḥ sadadhi
                        dhānyāmlaṃ sarpiḥ siddhamāhāre pāne ca praṇītaṃ
                        pratiśyāyayakṣmākāsaśvāsagrahaṇīgulmavibandhaghnam ||

jīrṇasnehaṃ jāṅgalarasena
                        vyoṣadāḍimasaindhavavatā bālamūlakarasena sarvadhānyayūṣeṇa vā bhojayet |

evamaparipacyamāne punaḥ punarnāḍīsvedaṃ vātaharaṃ cāsthāpanamanuvāsanaṃ
                        śirobastiṃ ca ||

pakve tu tailaṃ
                        kṣavakacūrṇayuktaṃ sasaindhavaṃ sarpirvā śirovirecanam ||

pittapratiśyāye
                        padmakośīrapaṭolasārivāvidārīśatāvarīkṣīridrumaśuṅgaśaṭhīkarkaṭākhyādurālabhānāmarddhaḍhakamaṣṭaguṇembhāsi
                        vipācya pādāvaśeṣe
                        madhukamṛdvīkācandanaśṛṅgāṭakakaśerukaśvetapākānyakṣamātrāṇi datvā
                        ghṛtaprasthaṃ payasā saha sādhayet |

tatra ca pakve doṣe
                        śirovirekaṃ purāṇaghṛtena sasaindhavena ghṛtamaṇḍena vā kaṭphalānvitena
                        kuryāt |
viśuddhasrotasaśca jāṅgalarasena kṣīreṇa vā śītena bhojanam ||

tato vāmanīyauṣadhakvāthasiddhayā sasarpiṣkayā saindhavamāṣacūrṇapragāḍhayā
                        peyayoṣṇāmbhasā ca vāmayet ||

tailāpluto nāgaracūrṇānuviddho mudga āhāro yathāsātmyaṃ ca rūkṣatīkṣṇoṣṇam
                        ||

bhṛśakṣavathau puṭake ca
                        nimbakaṭphalakuṣṭhamaricacūrṇaiḥ kledanāya pradhamanam |

vamitavato
                        nirguṇḍīśigrutarkārīphaṇijjakakṣavakasurasārjakapatrasvarasena sārṣapaṃ
                        pīlujaṃ vā tailaṃ vipācya nasyaṃ vidadhyāt ||
sthūlāni tu śastreṇa spṛṣṭvā dāhānantaraṃ śītāṃ kriyāṃ yojayet ||

arbudaṃ baḍiśena gṛhītvā
                        maṇḍalāgreṇa mūle samaṃ chindyāt |
calapramṛṣṭaṃ ca vraṇaṃ śalākayā dahettailena vā |

uparūḍhavraṇasya
                        lodhrāvāpaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇadravyagomūtrayuktaṃ sārṣapaṃ kārañjaṃ vā tailaṃ
                        nāvanam |
gandhājñānaṃ ca vīsarpo mūrcchā chindyādataḥ samam ||
grathitau ca punaḥ syātāṃ kaṇḍūlau daśanacchadau ||
dālyanta iva śūlena śītākhyo dālanaśca saḥ ||

pūtitvāt kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmā
                        jāyante jāyate tataḥ |
calā mandarujo dantāḥ pūtivaktraṃ ca jāyate ||

tāḥ punaḥ pañca vijñeyā
                        lakṣaṇaiḥ svairyathoditaiḥ ||

kṛṣṇāruṇo vā todāḍhyaḥ sa
                        vātāt kṛṣṇarājimān |

sthiraḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān
                        śītasparśo guruḥ kaphāt |
dehaṃ vṛddhasya kurute gale śabdaṃ svare 'lpatā ||
tāmyan prasaktaṃ śvasiti yena sa svarahānilāt ||
vivṛṇoti ca kṛcchreṇa mukhaṃ pāko mukhasya saḥ ||
kuryāttat ghaṭṭitaṃ chinnaṃ mṛditaṃ ca vivardhate ||

auṣṭhe gaṇḍe dvije mūle
                        jihvāyāṃ tāluke gale |

ekādaśaiko daśa ca
                        trayodaśa tathā ca ṣaṭ |

snigdhasvinnasya
                        khaṇḍauṣṭhasyauṣṭhāntau vilikhya suśliṣṭau kṣaumasūtreṇa sīvyet |

kaphaje jalaukobhiḥ śākādipatrairvā raktaṃ visrāvya
                        vyoṣapāṭhāyavakṣārasvarjikākṣāraiḥ sakṣaudraiḥ pratisārayet |

medoje dantacchadaṃ
                        svedayitvā vṛddhipatreṇa vipāṭya śuddhamedasamagninānupacaret |

avagāḍhamativṛddhaṃ vā kṣāreṇāgninā vā dahet
                        haridrālodhramadhukamālatīhareṇutagarairvipakvaṃ tailaṃ ropaṇam ||

gaṇḍālajīmapakvāṃ
                        śophavadvidagdhāmupanāhya pakvāṃ vidārya vraṇavat sādhayet ||

śītadantasyoṣṇāmubusvinnasya vrīhimukhena pālīṃ likhitvā picutailena
                        dahet |

dantaharṣe bhede ca
                        vātaharasiddhaṃ tailamelākuṣṭhapāṭalīsvagvipakvo majjā vā gaṇḍūṣaḥ |
niyataṃ ca snaihikadhūmapāyī snigdhamadhurāhāro visrāvaṇaparaḥ syāt |

candanapadmakamadhukavidārīkaśerukanīlotpalamṛdvīkājīvakarṣabhakaśarkarāṇāṃ
                        pratyekaṃ palena kṣīreṇa ca māṃsarasadviguṇena tailaprasthaṃ vipācayet |

adhidantakaṃ kṣāreṇālipya
                        jarjaraṃ vijñāya kṛmidantakavidhinotpāḍya tadvadevopacaret |

kṛmidantake suṣiraṃ guḍena
                        madhūcchiṣṭena sarpiṣa vāpūrayitvā taptayā kubjaśalākayā dahet |

evamanupaśame
                        sandaṃśayantreṇa dantamāyataṃ gṛhītvā vicālya śasreṇa pārśvebhyo
                        mokṣayitvoddharet |

prakṣālitamukhaśca
                        samadhukacūrṇaṃ tailaṃ madhu vā gaṇḍūṣaṃ dhārayet ||
madhuravargasiddhameva vā sarpiḥ punaḥ punaśca rudhirāvasekaḥ ||

vivṛddhantu baḍiśena macuṭyā vā gṛhītvā maṇḍalāgreṇa chitvā tīkṣṇaiḥ
                        pratisārayet |

vidarbhe dantamūlāni
                        śastreṇa viśodhya kṣāraṃ prayujya ghṛtamaṇḍaṃ gaṇḍūṣe dadyāt |

dantanāḍīmeṣayitvā saṃvṛtāṃ
                        śastreṇa vivṛtayitvā tadāśritaṃ dantamaśeṣamuddhṛtya śalākayā dahet |

upajihvāṃ śākapatreṇāṅguliśastreṇa vā visrāvya yavakṣāreṇa pratisārayet
                        ||

vṛddhāyāṃ tūrvārubījanibhamasirātatamagramuparijivhāyāniviṣṭaṃ baḍiśena
                        mucuṭyā vā vastraveṣṭitābhyāṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhapradeśinībhyāṃ gṛhītvā maṇḍalāgreṇa
                        nātyagre nātimūle chindyāt |

tālusaṅghāte puppuṭe
                        kacchape ca nave vidhirayam |

tāluśoṣe
                        madhukapippalīnāgarasiddhaṃ sarpiruttaraṃ bhaktikaṃ satṛṣṇaḥ pibet |

kaṇṭharogeṣu tu
                        jvarādyanupadruteṣu kaṭunīkṣṇairnasyāvagharṣaṇagaṇḍūṣādayaḥ sirāvyadho
                        rasāñjanendrayavadārvīnimbakvāthaḥ pānam |

atha
                        vātarohiṇīkāmantarbahiḥ svinnāmaṅguliśastrakeṇa madhulavaṇagarbheṇa vā
                        nakhena visrāvya tīkṣṇaiḥ pratisārayet |
pūrvoktāḥ pralepāḥ prātaḥ prātaścāsanādisārarajo gomūtreṇa pibet |
evamapyaśāntau śastreṇa vidārya medo viśodhya sīvyet |

mukhapākeṣu
                        sāmānyatastriphalākvātho madhumānanye ca tiktakaṭukakaṣāyā mukhadhāvanāḥ |

dāruharidrārdhatulāṃ
                        viṃśatiguṇe 'mbhasi śrapayitvā taṃ kvāthaṃ sagairikamādarvīpralepāt sādhitaṃ
                        kṣaudrayuktaṃ ghṛtabhājane nidadhyāt |

yavakṣārabhāgāḥ sapta
                        suvarṇagairikāt bhāgadvayaṃ mūrvākaṭukātiviṣāmalakānāmeko bhāgastat sarvaṃ
                        kutalakṣārodakapiṣṭaṃ guṭikāḥ kṛtvā khādenniṣṭhīvecca ||

khadirasāratulāmarimedatulādvayaṃ ca toyavahe 'ṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ
                        kvāthayedavatāritaṃ parisrutaṃ ca punarāghanībhāvāt |
tā guṭikā vadanasthāḥ sarvān mukharogān jayanti |

eṣāmeva ca
                        kalkakaṣāyaistailaṃ sādhitaṃ kavale niyuñjyāt ||

tatra vātaje mukhapāke
                        daśamūlakākolīrāsnāmadhukasārivākvāthena kuṣṭhakalkena ca siddhaṃ tailaṃ
                        nasyaṃ gaṇḍūṣaśca |
madhuradravyasiddhaṃ payaḥ pānaṃ kavalo nasyaṃ ca |

devadārupāṭhātiviṣādantīndrayavakaṭukāgomūtreṇa kalkatāḥ kvathitā vā pītāḥ
                        sarvakaphāmayān nighnanti ||

rocanākāsīsasaurāṣṭrikārasāñjanāni mocaraso madhu caikato vipakvaṃ
                        lohabhājanasthaṃ kalkaṃ viśuṣkaṃ curṇīkṛtaṃ madhunā vraṇalepaṃ kuryāt ||

atha
                        sarvasaramarbudamacirotthitamavṛddhaṃ maṇḍalāgreṇa chitvā muṣkakabhasmanā
                        madhumiśreṇa pratisārayet svarjikāśuṇṭhīcūrṇena vā |
prāyaḥ śastaṃ teṣāṃ kapharaktaharaṃ tathā karma ||
nistudyete bhṛśaṃ śaṅkhau ghāṭā sambhidyate tathā |
ghūrṇatīva śiraḥ sarvaṃ sandhibhya iva mucyate ||
kopite sannipāte ca jāyante mūrdhni jantavaḥ ||

śirasyeva ca vakṣyante
                        kapāle vyādhayo nava ||

khalaterapi janmaivaṃ
                        śātanaṃ tatra tu kramāt ||
dagdhāgnineva nirlomā sadāhā yā ca jāyate ||

tadvātāt sphuṭitaṃ śyāvaṃ
                        kharaṃ rūkṣaṃ jvalatprabham |
nivātasthaṃ ca naktamabhyaktaśirasaṃ sarpiḥ payonupānaṃ tailaṃ vā pāyayet |
tataḥ pratyūṣe daśamūlasiddhena payasā kavoṣṇena pariṣekaṃ kuryāt |

kūrmamahiṣavarāhakukkuṭaśallakīnāṃ vasā sasaindhavā nasyaṃ
                        śiraḥkarṇapūraṇaṃ ca |

tathaiva ca pañcamūlabalāsārivādvayakvāthe
                        madhukajīvakarṣabhakapunarnavagarbhaṃ sapayaḥ sarpistailaṃ caikato vipakvam
                        ||

evamasiddhau vātaje śleṣmaje
                        ca yathokto dāhaḥ ||

pittaje raktaje ca
                        śirobhitāpe snigdhasya sirāṃ vidhyet |
suśītaiḥ śatadhautaghṛtānvitaiḥ śiro vaktraṃ siñcet pradihyācca ||

jīvanīyavipakvāt payaso navanītamuddhṛtya jīvanīyakvāthakalkābhyāṃ pācitaṃ
                        pānabhojananasyābhyaṅgabastiṣu praṇītaṃ pittaraktajān sarvānvikārān
                        sādhayati |

viḍaṅgatailaṃ nasyaṃ
                        sārṣapaṃ vā tadeva vā vyoṣasiddham madhūkasārakalko vā madhuyutastvagvā
                        meṣaśṛṅgyā iṅgudasya vā |
taireva ca pakvaṃ tailaṃ marśaḥ pratimarśo vā ||

upasnigdhasvinnasya devadārupūtīkakaṭabhīsarṣapaviḍaṅgatilakaṇṭakavipakvena
                        tailena śiraḥ karṇau cābhyajya svedayet ||

tato rudhiragandhamadena prāvisṛtāḥ saptacchadasya tvagrasena puṣparasena
                        vānantaraniṣiktena kṛmayaḥ patanti ||

gomāṃsena chāgamāṃsena vā
                        vasāpiṣṭena yavāgūṃ kṛtvā śiro vilepayet |

evaṃ kṛmiṣvapagateṣu
                        tejovatīpūtīkabimbīsurasanaktamālaviḍaṅgaharītakīsarṣapārkakaravīramūlamālatīdevadārukṣavakamustaphaṇijjakapippalīśatapuṣpāmadhūkaśaṇanimbasārakalkairajāmūtrayutaiḥ
                        sārṣapaṃ tailamaiṅgudaṃ pailukaṃ vā vipakvaṃ yuktyā nāvanam ||
jantubhiḥ pītaśoṇite hi śirasi punarasrāvasekādakāṇḍe mṛtyuḥ syāt |

upaśīrṣake
                        janmottarakālajāte navotthite vātavyādhivihitān snehān pānanāvanābhyañjaneṣu
                        yojayet |
abhyaktaṃ ca svedayitvopanāhayedyathā vidāho na bhavati |
rūḍhaṃ tu vidradhau yadi tvak supteva bhavati tato vāmayet |

arūṃṣikāsu
                        jalaukopahṛtaśoṇitaṃ śiraḥ kṣurāmṛṣṭaṃ vā nimbodakena
                        pariṣicyāśvaśakṛdrasena lavaṇapragāḍhena lepayet |

avagāḍhapadaṃ vā
                        sūcīkūrcakena pracchāya bhūyobhūyaḥ pradihyāt kapotapaṅkāmūlena
                        lāṅgīlakāmūlena vā mahiṣīkṣīrapiṣṭena ||

triphalārjunasairyakatvakpuṣpakṛṣṇapiṇḍītakaphalamūlanīlotpalalohacūrṇakāsīsajamvūmārkavamañjiṣṭhāmeṣaśṛṅgīkhadirarajaḥ
                        sakardamamarditoktāṇutailayuktamasana sārasamudgake nyastaṃ kardame māsaṃ
                        nikhātaṃ sthitamuddhṛtaṃ sūcīkūrcapracchitāyāḥ khalaterlepaḥ paraṃ
                        romasañjananaḥ ||

jambūdvayatvakpatramadhukabhṛṅgarajāstriphalāśleṣmātakamañjiṣṭhāphaṇijjakabalādrākṣājaśṛṅgīcapalātiviṣākaṭphalakalkena
                        kṣīrivṛkṣakkāthena ca tilatailamakṣatailaṃ caikadhyaṃ sādhayet tannasye
                        'bhyaṅge ca niyuñjyāt |

asanapuṣpapatramaye pātre
                        bahirāmalakīkalkapradigdhe nihitamakṣatailaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ vrīhipalle
                        sthitamabhyaṅgānnāvanācca palitaṃ jayati |

kapikacchūphalamūlagarbhamakṣatailaṃ siddhamayaḥpātre pūrvavat
                        sthitaṃ samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

rāmataraṇīmūlapaladvayaṃ
                        yaṣṭīmadhukapalaṃ
                        sārivārdhapalamekatrajarjarīkṛtamakṣatailapalairdaśabhirāplutaṃ lohabhājane
                        daśāhaṃ divasakarakaraprataptaṃ nāvanāt palitaghnaṃ sarvendriyadārḍhyāvahaṃ
                        ca ||

tataḥ pūrvoktarasadrutena padminīkardamapraliptaptadhautān keśān kapālaṃ ca
                        lepayet |

khalatau palite valyāṃ
                        harillomni ca śodhitam |

siddhaśśailāsane bhāṇḍe
                        śṛṅge meṣasya vā sthitaḥ |
ebhireva ca bhaiṣajyaiḥ śiro vaktraṃ ca lepayet ||

tattailaṃ keśakārṣṇyaṃ janayati paramaṃ nāvanābhyañjanābhyāṃ
                        mūrddhaghrāṇākṣidantaśravaṇagalarujaṃ hanti niśśeṣataśca ||

jale paktvā ghṛtaprasthaṃ
                        tasmin kṣīrasamaṃ pacet |

sarvendriyāṇi yenāsmin
                        prāṇā yena ca saṃśritāḥ |

tatra śyāvo 'ruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo
                        bhasmāsthikapotagalānyatamavarṇo vā
                        dadhimastukṣārāmbumāṃsadhāvanapulākodakanibhālpasrāvo
                        rūkṣaścaṭacaṭāyamānaśīlo 'kasmādvividhaśūlasphuraṇāyāmatodabhedasvāpabahulo
                        nirmāṃsaśca vātāt ||

snigdhaḥ sthūlauṣṭhāḥ
                        pāṇḍuścaṇḍakaṇḍūrnavanītavasāmajjapiṣṭatilanārikelāmbusadṛśaśvetaśītabahalapicchilakledaḥ
                        svāpastambhastaimityagauravopadehayuktaḥ sirāsnāyujālāvatato mandavedanaḥ
                        kaṭhinaśca kaphāt ||

yathāsvaliṅgasaṅkare
                        dvābhyāṃ tribhiḥ sarvaiśca duṣṭaṃ vidyāt |

tatra yathoktaduṣṭaliṅgābhāvāt saṃrambharahitatvaṃ jihvāvarṇatā ślakṣṇatvaṃ
                        nīrujatvaṃ nirāsrāvatā śyāvaparyantatvaṃ samauṣṭhamadhyatā
                        kiñcidunnatamadhyatā vā ||

tatra ghṛṣṭāsu vā tvakṣu
                        sphoṭeṣu vā bhinneṣu salilaprakāśo bhavatyāsrāvaḥ |

sandhigataḥ samantāt
                        prapīḍyamāno na pravartate tathākuñcanaprasāraṇonnamananamanapravāhaṇeṣu
                        sravati picchilo 'valambī sa phenarudhironmiśraśca ||

asthi tvabhihataṃ sphuṭitaṃ
                        bhinnaṃ doṣāvadāritaṃ vā doṣabhakṣitatvānnissāraṃ bhavati |
svayaṃ vidīrṇāśca doṣajā na tu vaidyakṛtāḥ ||

vayasthānāṃ dṛḍhānāṃ
                        prāṇavatāṃ satvavatāmātmavatāṃ dīptāgnīnāṃ ca vraṇāḥ sucikitsyāḥ ||

eta eva guṇā
                        vṛddhakṛśālpaprāṇabhīrumandāgniprakledidehadeśakāleṣu viparītāḥ
                        śiṣyopanayanīyaṃ cekṣeta ||
vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyanti yeṣāṃ ca syurvraṇe vraṇāḥ ||

asādhyāḥ
                        punarmāṃsapiṇḍavadudgatāḥ prasekinontaḥpūyā vedanāvantaśca
                        pāyuvadudvṛttauṣṭhāḥ kaṭhinā gośṛṅgavadunnatamāṃsaprarohā
                        duṣṭaśoṇitāsrāviṇastanupicchilāsrāvasrāviṇo vā madhyonnatāḥ
                        samavasannasuṣiraparyantāḥ śaṇatūlavatsnāyujālavanto durdarśanā
                        medomajjavasāmastuluṅgasrāviṇaśca doṣasamutthāḥ
                        pītāsitāmūtrapurīṣavātavāhinaśca koṣṭhasthāḥ raktaśayajāśca
                        kṣārodakasamāsrāvāḥ pakvāśayajāśca pulākodakamiva sravantaḥ kṣīṇamāṃsānāṃ ca
                        sarvatogatayastvaṇumukhamāṃsabudbudavantaḥ saśabdavātavāhinaśca
                        śiraḥkaṭhasthā visarpajvarapipāsārocakāvipākakāsaśvāsātīsāracchardiyuktāḥ
                        bhinno ca śiraḥkapāle yatra mastuluṅgadarśanaṃ tridoṣaliṅgaprādubhāvo vā
                        syāditi |

vraṇasya śophāvasthāyāṃ
                        śastrakarmavidhau śvayathucikitsite ca sādhanamuddiṣṭam |
sadyaḥ śāmyanti śuddhānāṃ vraṇāḥ śophāśca dehinām ||

yastu śītastanurmuhurmuhuśca
                        prayujyate sa pradeho raktapittatvacāṃ prasādakṛt |

pralepastūṣṇaḥ śīto vā bahalaśca tathā vātaśleṣmapraśamanastasyopayogaḥ
                        kṣatākṣateṣu |
yastu kṣateṣūpayujyate sa bhūyaḥ kalka iti saṃjñāṃ labhate ||

snaihiko nirvāpaṇaḥ prasādanaḥ stambhano vilāyanaḥ pācanaḥ pīḍanaḥ śodhano
                        ropaṇaḥ savarṇīkaraṇaśca ||

tatra vāte snigdhadravyaiḥ
                        snehāḍhyaiḥ snehenaiva vā snaihikaḥ |
pitte pittaprāye ca śophe viṣāgnikṣāradagdhe ca śītairnirvāpaṇaḥ |

śleṣmamedobhūyiṣṭhe śītaiścāvidagdhe piṣṭalabdhe grathite vā rūkṣairvilāyanaḥ
                        |

na ca paryuṣitaṃ lepaṃ
                        dadyāt bhūyastameva vā |

śophe vraṇe ca kaṭhine
                        vivarṇe vedanānvite |

sadāhaśūlāṃstu
                        tilānatasīśca bhṛṣṭvā payasi nirvāpya tenaiva kṣīreṇa piṣṭvā pralepayet
                        ||

daśamūlasiddhena
                        sukhoṣṇenāmbhasā payasā vā ghṛtatailābhyāṃ vā pariṣekaḥ śophe vraṇe vā
                        dāhaśūlaghnaḥ ||

abhyajya svedayitvā ca
                        veṇunāḍyā tataḥ śanaiḥ |

śigruśaṇaphalacitrakakiṇvaniṣpāvasarṣapatilātasīsaktukolagṛhadhūmairamlapiṣṭaiḥ
                        sukhoṣṇaiḥ snigdhaiḥ salavaṇairutkārikāṃ kṛtvā tathā
                        pralipyairaṇḍapatreṇāvacchādyabadhnīyāt ||

pākābhimukhe ca śophe
                        yatheṣṭamāturaṃ bhojayet pācanārthaṃ pākavedanāśastrakarmasahanārthaṃ ca
                        ||

tatra gambhīreṣu
                        pittātmakeṣu dāhapākavatsu vraṇeṣvatīkṣṇoṣṇairebhiḥ kārpāsīphalamiśraṃ
                        kalkaṃ ghṛtaṃ ca sādhayitvā yojayet ||

utsannamāṃseṣvalpasrāveṣu
                        rūkṣeṣu tilāpāmārgabṛhatīdvayayuktaiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ pūtīkādibhiḥ sarṣapaṃ
                        tailaṃ ca ||

pracalapradeśajeṣu
                        kledabahuleṣūtsannasthiramāṃseṣu tailena cāsidhyatsu rasakriyāṃ kuryāt |

yathoktānāṃ saṃśodhanauṣadhānāṃ kaṣāye punaḥ parisrāvyādhiśṛte
                        manaśśilātuvarīkāsīsacūrṇapratīvāpasiddhāṃ ca mātuluṅgarasopetāṃ sakṣaudrāṃ
                        yuñjīta ||

saruje kaṭhine stabdhe
                        rūkṣe śuṣyati ca vraṇe ||
chinnāśca sandhayo yeṣāṃ yathoktairye ca sādhanaiḥ |
te vraṇe vātike yojyāḥ kaṣāyādiṣu sapptasu ||
ghanaḥ koṣṇaśca paitte tu payaḥpiṣṭo ghṛtānvitaḥ ||
rūkṣastailena vā snigdho bahalaḥ kaphaje hitaḥ ||
pūrvābhyāṃ sarpiṣā cāsau yuktaḥ syādāśu ropaṇaḥ |
sādhitaṃ tailamājyaṃ vā tadvat kampillakena vā |
kalkairebhirghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ tailaṃ vā ropaṇaṃ param ||
pralepaḥ kurute kārṣṇyaṃ sadya eva navatvaci ||
kāsīsaṃ madhukaṃ lepo vraṇe kṛṣṇe madhudrutaḥ ||

kāsīsaṃ prapunāṭañca māsaṃ
                        nyastaṃ tato bhuvi |

vividhābhighātajanitaistu subahvākṛtibhirapi sadyovraṇairadhiṣṭhitamaṅgaṃ
                        samāsāt trividhaṃ bhavati chinnaṃ viddhaṃ piccitaṃ ca |

etadeva caturvidhaṃ koṣṭhe pṛthumukhairvā praharaṇaiḥ
                        kuntādibhirviddhamanubhinnaṃ bhinnottuṇḍitamatibhinnaṃ nirbhinnamiti ca
                        saṃjñāṃ labhate ||

yat punaḥ prahāreṇa pīḍanena
                        vā gātramasthiyuktamasṛṅmajjaplutaṃ pṛthutāmāpadyate tat piccitam |

prāyaḥ sāmānyakarmedaṃ
                        vakṣyate tu pṛthak pṛthak ||

ghṛṣṭe rujaṃ nigṛhyāśu
                        varṇe cūrṇāni nikṣipet |

asādhyaṃ sphuṭitaṃ
                        netramudīrṇaṃ lambate tu yat |
tato 'sya secane nasye tarpaṇe ca hitaṃ haviḥ ||
samaṃ niveśya badhnīyāt syūtva śīghraṃ nirantaram ||

pādau vilambimuṣkasya
                        prokṣya netre ca vāriṇā |
snehasekaṃ na kurvīta tena klidyati hi vraṇaḥ ||

chinnāṃ niśśeṣataḥ śākhāṃ
                        dagdhvā teilena yuktitaḥ |

kāryaḥ śalyāhṛte viddhe
                        kramo bhaṅgāttu piccite ||
kliṣṭāntraḥ saṃśaye dehī chinnāntro naiva jīvati ||

prakṣālya payasā digdhaṃ
                        tṛṇa śoṇita pāṃsubhiḥ |

dṛḍhaṃ ca badhvā sūtreṇa
                        varddhayet kuśalo bhiṣak |

sakṣaudre ca vraṇe baddhe
                        sujīrṇenne ghṛtaṃ pibet |
haridre padmabījāni sośīraṃ madhukaṃ ca taiḥ |

tatra sandhimuktaṃ ṣaḍvidhamutpiṣṭaṃ viśliṣṭamavakṣiptamatikṣiptaṃ
                        tiryakkṣiptaṃ vivartitamiti ||

tasya sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ
                        prasāraṇākuñcana vivartanākṣepaṇāśaktirugrarujatā sparśāsahiṣṇutvaṃ ca
                        ||

athotpiṣṭe svasthāna eva
                        sandhāvubhayataḥ śopho vedanā viśeṣataśca rātrau bhavati |
tiryak kṣiptetvekasyāsthnaḥ pārśvato gamanamatyarthaṃ vedanā ca |

karkaṭakaṃ vakraṃ sthuṭitaṃ vellitamasthicchallikāśvakarṇaṃ piccitaṃ dāritaṃ
                        cūrṇitamatipātitaṃ śeṣitaṃ majjānugatamiti ||

śvayathubāhulyaṃ spandanaṃ
                        vivartanaṃ sparśāsahiṣṇutā ca pīḍyamāne śabdaḥ srastāṅgatā vedanātipravṛttiḥ
                        sarvāsu cāvasthāsu śarma na labhata iti sādhāraṇamasandhibhagnarūpam ||

vaiśeṣikaṃ tu
                        saṃvyūḍhamubhayatosthimadhyabhagnaṃ granthirivonnataṃ karkaṭakānukāri
                        karkaṭakam ||

eṣāmantyāni pañca
                        kṛcchrasādhyāni kṛśātibālavṛddhāsahānāmatyāśināṃ vātātmakānāṃ
                        kuṣṭhināmupadravavatāṃ ca ||

asādhyaṃ tu bhinnaṃ
                        kaṭīkapālaṃ sandhimuktaṃ vā jaghanamutpiṣṭaṃ kūrparo vivartitastathā lalāṭaṃ
                        cūrṇitamasaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca śiraḥ śaṃkhapṛṣṭhastanāntarabhaṅgaṃ ceti |

śithilena hi hi bandhena
                        sandhisthairyaṃ na jāyate |
prātaḥ prātaḥ pibet bhagnaḥ śītalaṃ lākṣayāyutam ||
māsaiḥ sthairyaṃ bhavet sandheryathoktaṃ bhajatāṃ vidhim ||

maṇibandhe ca jānau ca
                        gulphe caiṣaḥ kriyākramaḥ ||

ubhe tale same kṛtvā
                        talabhagnasya dohinaḥ |
ghṛtaṃ vātaghnamadhuraiḥ siddhaṃ nasyaṃ ca pūjitam ||

nāsāṃ vivṛttāṃ sannaṃ vā
                        ṛjūkṛtya śalākayā |

bhagnaṃ karṇaṃ
                        ghṛtābhyaktaṃ nyasya bandhena yojayet |
yantraṇārthaṃ tataḥ kīlāḥ pañca kāryā nibandhanāḥ |
jaṅgo rupārśvayordvau dvau tala ekaśca kīlakaḥ ||

bhaṅgo naiti yathā pākaṃ
                        prayateta tathā bhiṣak |
vyāyāmaṃ ca na seveta bhagno rūkṣaṃ ca bheṣajam ||
avedanaṃ ca ceṣṭāyāṃ bhagnaṃ vidyāt susādhitam ||

kṛṣṇāstilānvirajaso
                        dṛḍhavastrabaddhān saptakṣapā bahati vāriṇi vāsayet |

saṃśoṣayedanudinaṃ pratisārya cainān kṣīre tathaiva madhukakvathite ca toye
                        ||
vātaṃ mūtraṃ śakṛcchukraṃ khaiḥ sūkṣmairvahati kramāt ||

vraṇatāṃ yānti tāḥ pakvāḥ
                        pramādāt tatra vātajā |
pravāhiṇīṃ balīṃ prāptaṃ sevanīṃ vā samāśritam ||

pakvapiṭakaṃ
                        punarupasnigdhamarkādikvāthaśuddhaṃ svabhyaktamavagāhasvinnaṃ bhuktavantaṃ
                        śayanasthamarśasamiva yantrayitvā parācīnamarvācīnaṃ bahirmukhamantarmukhaṃ
                        vā bhagandaraṃ samyagīkṣeta ||

tato 'ntarmukhe yantraṃ
                        prāṇidhāya pravāhaṇapraviṣṭaṃ bhagandaramabhisamīkṣya samyageṣitvā śastreṇa
                        pāṭayet |

bahirmukhetveṣāṇīṃ praṇidhāya sāśayamuddharecchastreṇānantaraṃ co
                        'bhayamapyagninā kṣāreṇa copatrameta uṣṭhagrīvaṃ tu kṣāreṇaiva ||

tatra snehābhyaktagudasya snigdhān piṇḍanāḍīkumbhīsvedān prayuñjītāvagāhaṃ vā
                        |

svinnaṃ ca vaca hiṃgukuṣṭhavyoṣalavaṇapañcakājamodān
                        sarpirmadyākāñjikakulatthayūṣānyatamena pāyayet |

evameva ca parikṣepiṇyāmapi
                        kramāt gatiṃ nāḍīvihitena kṣārasūtreṇa dviśastriśovāvadārayet |

arśobhagandare
                        pūrvamarśāṃsi cchindyāt tato gatyanusāreṇa bhagandaram ||

ārdrakasya rase siddhaṃ
                        kalke vā pāyayet ghṛtam |

guggulupañcapalaṃ palikāṃśā
                        māgadhikā triphalā ca pṛthak syāt |

bhagandareṣveṣa viśeṣa
                        uktaḥ śeṣāṇi tu vyañjanasādhanāni |
sāhasāni vividhāni ca ruḍhe vatsaraṃ pariharedadhikaṃ vā ||
vṛttonnataṃ yaṃ śvayathuṃ sa granthirgrathanāt smṛtaḥ ||

pittāt sadāhapītābho rakto vā
                        pacyate drutam |
śītaḥ savarṇaḥ kaṇḍūmān pakvaḥ pūyaṃ sravet ghanam ||

pravṛddhaṃ sedurairmedo nītaṃ
                        māṃse 'tha vā tvaci |
vāyunā kurute granthiṃ bhṛśaṃ snigdhaṃ mṛduṃ calam ||
vāyuḥ sampīḍya saṅkocya vakrīkṛtya viśoṣya ca |
nisphuraṃ nīrujaṃ granthiṃ kurute sa sirāhvayaḥ ||

tallakṣaṇaṃ ca medontaiḥ
                        ṣoḍhā doṣādibhistu tat |
śanaiḥ śanairghanaṃ śophaṃ ślīpadaṃ taṃ pracakṣate ||
rūkṣaṃ ca vātāt pittāttu pītaṃ dāhajvarānvitam ||
ślīpadaṃ jāyate tacca deśe 'nūpe bhṛśaṃ bhramāt ||

antaḥsthitaṃ śalyamanāhṛtaṃ
                        tu karoti nāḍīṃ vahate ca sāsya |
phenānuviddhaṃ tanumalpamuṣṇaṃ sāsra ca pūyaṃ sarujaṃ ca nityam ||

sarveṣveva pūrvaṃ granthiṣu
                        bṛhatīdvayapippalīcitrakasādhitena purāṇasapiṃṣā snigdhaṃ vāmayet |

kṛtasaṃsarjanasyacottamāṅgagateṣu granthiṣu
                        lākṣādvirajanīviḍaṅgaśuṇṭhīpūtīdārubhiḥ śiro virecayet
                        dhūmakavalagaṇḍūṣāṃśca sa seveta ||
bahuśaḥ svinnamaṅguṣṭhena veṇuparvaṇā vā śanaiśśanaiḥ punaḥ punarvimardayet |

atha vātaje granthau
                        daśamūlasiddhaṃ mahāsnehaṃ pibet |

pakvaṃ tu vidārya
                        nirastapūyaṃ kṛtvārkādivargāmbhasā prakṣālya tilakalkena
                        sacitrakasaindhavenālepayet |

pittaje raktaje ca jalaukaso
                        nyagrodhādiḥ pradehapariṣekayoḥ padmakādiḥ pāne ca drākṣekṣurasayuktā
                        harītakī virekaḥ |

medojepyayameva vidhiḥ api ca medogranthiṃ tilakalkadigdhaṃ
                        dviguṇapaṭāntaritaṃ taptena phālena darvyā vā jatuliptayā bahuśaḥ pramṛjyāt
                        |

sirāgranthau tvabhinave
                        tailaṃ sāhacaraṃ pibet upanāhañca vātaharairbastikarma ca kuryāt |

śleṣmaje tūrdhvamadhaśca
                        hṛtadoṣasya srutaraktasya ca vamanavirecanadravyaiḥ pralepaḥ |
lepāsvādalobhena ca nilīyamānā makṣikāḥ sa mupekṣeta |
sarvārbudāni ca yadṛcchayā paryāgatāni supariśodhitāni ropayet |

saśeṣadoṣāṇi tu yorbudāni
                        karoti tasyāśu punarbhavanti |
tasmādaśeṣoddharaṇaṃ praśastaṃ kṣāreṇa śastreṇa tathāgninā vā ||

ślīpade tu vātātmake
                        snehasvedopanāhān prayujya gulphasyopariṣṭādvyaṅgule sirāṃ vidhyet |

paittike mṛdurupanāho
                        gulphasyādhaḥ sirāmokṣaḥ pittārbudoktāḥ snehavirekāḥ pittaghnāśca lepāḥ
                        ||

ādārīkākajaṃghākākādanīśukanāsākadambapuṣpabṛhatīdvayamantardhūmaṃ dagdhvā
                        gomūtreṇa bahuśaḥ parisrāvayet tatastat kṣārodakaṃ kṣārakalpena vipacet |

dadyāccātra paratīvāpaṃ phalguśukākhyā madanaphalarasaṃ eṣa kṣāro
                        madhurāhāreṇābhyastaḥ ślīpadāpacīgrahaṇīdoṣārocakān sarvaviṣāṇi ca
                        niyacchati ||

madhūkasāraṃ vā śigruphalāni vā nimbakarañjakaravīrasiddhaṃ vā tailaṃ
                        vairecanikañca dhūmaṃ pibet ||

māṃsīsarjarasakārpāsīphalasaindhavaiḥ stanyapiṣṭaistailaṃ vipakvamabhyaṅgo
                        vraṇakāṭhinyaghnaḥ sarpājagaravase tailaṃ ca samaṃ trayametadapacīghnam |

evamanupaśame
                        vāmapārśvajāyāṃ dakṣiṇajaṅghāpṛṣṭhamadhyādindrabasteradhaḥ ūrdhvaṃ vā
                        śastreṇākṣimātraṃ vraṇaṃ kṛtvā matsyāṇḍajālanibhaṃ medopanīyāgninā dahet |

śalyahetukīṃ pāṭayitvā
                        sarvaśaḥ śalyaṃ viśodhya madhughṛtatilakalkapraticchannāṃ badhnīyāt |

aśastrakṛtyāṃ nāḍyāṃ
                        bhedinyaiṣiṇyānte samudbhidya kṣārāktaṃ sūtraṃ praveśayet |

tadasannidhānetvitarayaiṣiṇyā ca tenānavadīrṇāyāṃ tadanusyūtamanyadanyat
                        kṣārasūtraṃ sañcārayedā gatibhedādayamanapāyo 'bhyupāyaḥ |
sūkṣmānekagatiṣu bhagandareṣu mūleṣu ca chidriteṣu granthyarbudeṣviti |
yā vartyo yāni tailāni tannāḍīṣvapi kalpayet ||
varāhaviṣṭhā ca maṣī sudagdhā tailaplutā sarvagatīrnihanti ||

dhattūrakaṃ
                        madanakodravajañca bījaṃ kośātakī śukanasā mṛgabhojanī ca |

aṅkolajañca kusumaṃ parikalpya cūrṇaṃ lākṣodakāpahṛtadoṣagatau prayojyam
                        ||
sauvaheṣu ca kandeṣu kṛtaṃ vajrāhvayeṣu ca ||
granthayaḥ pañca vā ṣaḍvā kacchapī kacchaponnatāḥ ||
medogarbhā mukhe śūnāṃ tābhyāṃ ca mukhadūṣikā ||

te padmakaṇṭakā jñeyā yaiḥ
                        padmamiva kaṇṭakaiḥ |
sā viddhā vātapittābhyāṃ tābhyāmeva ca gardabhī ||
pittāt bhavanti piṭakāḥ sūkṣmā lājopamā ghanāḥ |
durgandhiṃ rudhiraṃ klinnaṃ nānāvarṇaṃ tato malāḥ |

kṛṣṇaṃ sitaṃ vā sahajaṃ
                        maṇḍalaṃ lāñchanaṃ samam ||

paruṣaṃ paruṣasparśaṃ
                        vyaṅgaṃ śyāvaṃ ca mārutāt |

padmakaṇṭakeṣu nimbāmbuvāntaṃ
                        nimbodakasiddhaṃ sarpiḥ sakṣaudraṃ pāyayet |

agnirohiṇīmapi pratyākhyāya
                        pittavisarpadupācaret pakvāṃ tu madhuravargasiddhena sarpiṣāṃ ropayet ||
pakvāṃ śastreṇa vidārya nimbatilapaṭolakalkena pracchādya badhnīyāt |

balmīkaṃ hastasya pādasya
                        copariṣṭānmarmaṇi vā jātaṃ pravṛddhamatibahucchidrāvṛtaṃ saśophaṃ ca
                        varjayet ||

pakve tu sarvāṃ gatiṃ
                        duṣṭamāṃsāni ca śastreṇa samyakśodhayitvāgninā kṣāreṇa vā dahet ||

tilakālakān maṣāṃśca
                        sūryakāntenāgninā vā dahet kṣāreṇa vā |
tenaiva vā bālāmalakaṃ gomūtreṇa saptāhaṃ sthitam |

tatrāpi vātajeṣu
                        devadārudurālabhābṛhatīmañjiṣṭhāmūrvāpāmārgatrāyantītrāyamāṇāśukanasābalāvidārīyavabadarakulatthabilvotpalaśatāvarīdarbhamūlakvāthe
                        śṛṅgīviḍaṅgagarbhaṃ ghṛtaṃ vipakvamadhobhaktaṃ pānamabhyaṅgaṃ nāvanaṃ ca
                        sāyaṃ yojayet ||

paitteṣu
                        balāmadhukamāgadhikākṣīrakākolīsvaguptāphalakākamācītugāhvābhiḥ sapayaḥ
                        sarpiḥ siddhaṃ pūrvavat prayojayet ||

utkoṭhe pittaśleṣmaharo
                        vidhiḥ sakṣāralavaṇaṃ ca tailamabhyaṅgaḥ |

piṭakā bahavo dīrghā
                        dīryante madhyataśca yāḥ |
nivartate sarugdāhaṃ kvacit pākaṃ ca gacchati ||

vātena dūṣitaṃ carma maṇau
                        saktaṃ ruṇaddhi cet |
bhraṃśaṃ vaṅkṣaṇapārśvādau vyathāṃ gulmaṃ krameṇa ca |
tāṃstāṃśca svān gadān vyāpadvātikī nāma sā smṛtā ||
vamet saruṅnīrujo vā yasyāṃ sā vāminī matā ||

duṣṭo viṣṭabhya yonyāsyaṃ
                        garbhakoṣṭhaṃ ca mārutaḥ |

iti yonigadā nārī yaiḥ
                        śukraṃ na pratīcchati |
tato garbhaṃ na nṛhṇaṇāti rogāṃścāpnoti dāruṇān |

tvacaḥ kṣīridrumāṇāṃ ca
                        triphalāṃ ca pacejjale |
sa kvāthaḥ kṣālanaṃ tena pakvaṃ tailaṃ ca ropaṇam |

na ca yāti yathā pākaṃ
                        prayateta tathā bhṛśam |
pakvaiḥ snāyusirāmāṃsaiḥ prāyo naśyati hi dhvajaḥ ||

tato bhūyaḥ svedayitvā ghṛtenābhyajya śanaiḥ śanaiścarma samānayan
                        maṇimavapīḍayet |

niruddhamaṇau
                        suvarṇādikṛtāṃ dārujāṃ vā jatusṛtāṃ nāḍīmubhayatodvārāṃ snehābhyaktāṃ
                        srotasi praṇidhāya sūkaraśiṃśumārayorvasayāmajjñā vā pariṣecayet |
tṛtīye tṛtīye cāhani nāḍīṃ pīnatarāṃ vidadhyāt |
evamasya srotodvāraṃ vivardhayet snigdhaṃ cāhāraṃ bhojayet |

evamanupaśāntau śastreṇa sevanīṃ parihṛtya dārayitvā sadyaḥkṣatavadupācaret
                        ||

vidāryādisiddhena ca tailena ropayet śarkarārbude raktavidradhivat sādhanam
                        ||

yonivyāpadi tu vātikyāṃ
                        lavaṇatailāktāṃ yoniṃ piṇḍanāḍīkumbhīprabhṛprabhṛtibhiḥ svedayet |

balādroṇadvayaniryūhe
                        payasyāsālaparṇīmāgadhikāśatāvarīkākanāsāśrāvaṇīśarkarājīvanīyagarbhaṃ
                        kṣīracaturguṇaṃ ghṛtatailāḍhakaṃ sādhayet tatpānāt sarvān
                        vātapittavikārānapohati garbhajananaṃ ca ||

śatāvarītriphalāguḍūcīkāśmaryamṛdvīkākāsamardakaparūṣakaharidrādvayasahacaraśukanāsāpunarnavaiḥ
                        kārṣikairghṛtaprasthaḥ siddhaḥ pīto vātajān yonirogānapohati garbhajananaśca
                        ||
tenaivacārjakamūlaṃ bilvayuktaṃ vā pippalī yuktaṃ vā |

rāsnāmālatīcchinnaruhāmadhukabalāvyāghrīdevadārucitrakayūthikāmūlaiḥ
                        karṣāṃśaistailaprasthaḥ samūtro dviguṇapayasā vipakvaḥ picunā praṇīto
                        'nilārtiharaḥ ||

bastikarma cābhīṣṇaṃ svedaṃ
                        ca prayojayedviśeṣato vātaharaiḥ sukumārabalātailaśirīṣatailaiḥ
                        śatapākasahasra pākaiścānuvāsanamuttarabastiṃ ca |

dhārayecca viplutāyāṃ
                        gomatsyānyatarapittenaikaviṃśatikṛtvo bhāvitān kṣaumanaktakān kiṇvaṃ vā
                        mākṣikayuktamevamasyāḥ srotāṃsi viśudhyanti kaṇḍūkledaśophāśca nivartante
                        ||

udāvṛttāyāmānūpamāṃsarasāḥ
                        kṣīraṃ svedo daśamūlatrivṛtākvāthakalkāsiddhaśca snehaḥ
                        pānānuvāsanottarabastiṣu |
sannipāte vimiśraṃ tu saṃsṛṣṭāsu ca kārayet ||

snigdhasvinnāṃ tathā yoniṃ
                        duḥsthitāṃ sthāpayet samām |
pāṇinā namayet jihmāṃ saṃvṛtāṃ prathayet punaḥ ||
śītāḥ pittajitaḥ kāryāḥ snehanārthaṃ ghṛtāni ca ||
garbhadaṃ pittajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ paramaṃ hitam ||

tilacūrṇaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ
