                        phāṇitaṃ saukarī vasā |
satārkṣyaśailaṃ lākṣāṃ vā chāgena payasā pibet |

madhukaṃ triphalāṃ lodhraṃ
                        mustaṃ saurāṣṭrikāṃ madhu |
doṣā jantukṛtā ye ca bālānāṃ tāṃśca nāśayet ||
tailaṃ kvāthena tasyaiva kāryaṃ dhāryaṃ ca pūrvavat ||
dhāryā madhukṛtā vartiḥ kaṣāyāṇāṃ ca bhūriśaḥ ||

durgandhānāṃ kaṣāyaḥ
                        syāttailaṃ vā kalka eva vā |

evaṃ yoniṣu śuddhāsu
                        garbhaṃ vindanti yoṣitaḥ |
dve niśe madhukaṃ medā dīpyakaḥ kaṭurohiṇī ||
āyuṣyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ medhyaṃ dhanyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ param ||

phalasarpiriti khyātaṃ
                        puṣpe pītaṃ phalāya yat |

purā khalvamṛtārthaṃ
                        surāsuraiḥ salilanidhervimathyamānāt krodha iva rūpavān satvaṃ samudvabhūva
                        kṛṣṇamanalanayanamūrdhvapradīptakeśaṃ daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ bhairavārāvarūpam |

tat sahasaiva sarvabhūtāni
                        nirdagdhukāmamupayogaviśeṣairviṣamamṛtatāṃ vinayamāno brahmānunīyauṣadhiṣu
                        nyastavān ||

sarvameva ca sthāvaraṃ
                        jvarahidhmādantaharṣahanustambhagalagrahaphenavamanāruciśvāsamūrcchāḥ karoti
                        viśeṣeṇa kandajam |

tatra taikṣṇyauṣṇyāt pittaṃ
                        raktaṃ ca prakopayati |
ata eva ca prayatnenānnāni viṣato rakṣedityuktam |

viṣaṃ hi dehaṃ samprāpya
                        prāgdūṣayati śoṇitam |

viṣaṃ yaddoṣabhūyiṣṭhaṃ taṃ
                        doṣaṃ prāk prapadyate |
daṃśe tiṣṭhati bhūyiṣṭhaṃ sarvataḥ piṇḍitaṃ viṣam |

yathāsvaṃ bhakṣite pīḍā
                        yathāsvaṃ ca kriyākramaḥ ||

pañcame pāṇḍujihvāsya śoṣaḥ
                        ṣaṣṭhe hṛdi vyathā |
saptame maraṇaṃ vega iti gagnajito matam ||

dhātvantareṣu yāḥ sapta
                        kalāḥ pūrvaṃ prakīrttitāḥ |
svabhāvato vā na guṇaiḥ suyuktaṃ dūṣīviṣākhyāṃ viṣamabhyupaiti ||
bhavennaro dhvasthīśaroruhāṅgo vilūnapakṣaḥ sa yathā vihaṅgaḥ |
jihvāyāḥ śyāvatā stambho mūrcchā trāsaḥ klamo vamiḥ ||

dvitīye vepathuḥ svedo
                        kaṇṭhe ca vedanāḥ |
viṣaṃ cāmāśayaṃ prāptaṃ kurute hṛdi vedanām ||
durbale harite śūne jāyete cāsya locane ||
mūrdhni kākapadaṃ kṛtvā sāsṛgvā piśitaṃ kṣipet ||
sarveṣu sarvāvastheṣu ye viṣeṣu paraṃ hitāḥ ||

candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ
                        kāṅkṣī lākṣā priyaṅgavaḥ |

candanaṃ vālakaṃ mustaṃ
                        dhyāmakaṃ kaṭukā natam |

karkaṭī pūtanā keśī śvetā
                        ca girikarṇikā |
pippalīṃ pāṭalīṃ padmāṃ śvetāṃ ca girikarṇikām |

phalīnīṃ kiṇihīṃ ceti gavāṃ
                        pittena bhāvayet |
sūryodayo hanti viṣaṃ tamaḥ sūryodayo yathā ||

priyaṅgu tagaraṃ lākṣā
                        mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ madhu |
raktā nataṃ vacā dantī śivaḥ śivakṛto 'gadaḥ ||
eṣa māheśvaro yogo na kvacit pratihanyate ||

śūyate pacyate sadyo
                        gatvā māṃsaṃ ca kṛṣṇatām |
viṣāṇāṃ cālpavīryāṇāṃ yogo gara iti smṛtaḥ ||

manyate kṛṣṇamātmānaṃ
                        gauro gauraṃ ca kālakaḥ |

vibhajya yojayet
                        ūrdhvamadhaḥ saṃśodhitaṃ ca tam |

te 'pi ca vratahīnasya
                        hīnā vā svaravarṇataḥ |

āśaye yasya doṣasya viṣaṃ
                        tiṣṭhati taṃ punaḥ |
svedo vātāśaye dadhnā pānaṃ ca natakuṣṭhayoḥ ||
divyā garjanti varṣanti dyotante dyotayanti te ||

dveśate viṃśatī dve ca sā
                        sūte tatra jāyate |
astaṃgate ravau śūdrāḥ daśanti brāhmaṇāḥ puraḥ |
saṃsthitā dakṣiṇe pārśve kṣatriyā vāmato viśaḥ ||
daṃṣṭrāpade sarakte dve vyāluptaṃ trīṇi tāni tu ||
kadācit kurute śophaṃ sarpāṅgābhihataṃ tu tat ||
tudyate grathitaḥ kiñcit kaṇḍūmān dahyate bhṛśam |
rogī kumāryā vāme tu garbhiṇyā kṛṣṇajihvadṛk ||
śyāvatā tena vaktrādau sarpantīva ca kīṭakāḥ ||
dāho hidhmā ca ṣaṣṭhe tu hṛtpīḍā gātragauravam ||
pāṇḍutā tena gātrāṇāṃ dvitīye gurutāti ca ||

kuryāt pañcasu vegeṣu
                        cikitsāṃ na tataḥ param ||
na teṣāṃ kālaniyamo na ca vegeṣvanukramaḥ ||
nairṛtākhye muhūrte ca daṣṭaṃ marmasu ca tyajet ||

hidhmā śvāso vamiḥ kāso
                        daṣṭamātrasya dehinaḥ |
jāyate yugapadyasya sa hṛcchūlī na jīvati ||
raktaṃ khebhyaḥ samastebhyo vartate na tu daṃśataḥ ||
rakṣan kaṇṭhagatān prāṇān viṣamāśu śamaṃ nayet ||

mātrāśataṃ viṣaṃ sthitvā
                        daṃśe daṣṭasya dehinaḥ |
kuryācchīghraṃ yathā dehe viṣavallī na rohati ||
loṣṭaṃ mahīṃ vā daśanaiśchitvā vānu sasambhramam ||
aśaktaḥ śithilo rodhduṃ viṣaṃ deśāntaraṃ vrajat ||
karoti bhasmasāt sadyo vahniḥ ki nāma na kṣaṇāt ||

viṣe pravisṛte vidhyet
                        sirāṃ sā paramā kriyā ||

rakte nirddriyamāṇe hi
                        kṛtsnaṃ nirddriyate viṣam |
aikadhyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ vā dadhi gairikavāri vā ||

sakṣaudro himavān nāma
                        hanti maṇḍalināṃ viṣam |
mañjiṣṭhāṃ madhukaṃ ceti daṣṭo maṇḍalinā pibet ||

raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca godhāyāḥ
                        śuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ hitam |
saindhavaṃ cāñjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gavāṃ pittena kalkitam ||
pippalīṃ ca samaṃ piṣṭvā gavyapittena pāyayet ||
viṣaṃ hi netraṃ rūkṣasya tīkṣṇairhanti samīritam ||

atha darvīkṛtāṃ vege pūrve
                        visrāvya śoṇitam |
māṃsaṃ sarudhiraṃ tasya carma vā tatra nikṣipet ||

tṛtīye vāmitaḥ peyāṃ vege
                        maṇḍalināṃ pibet |

tvaṅmanohvā niśe vakraṃ
                        rasaḥ śārdūlajo nakhaḥ |
jyotiṣmatī nataṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śvetā ca girikarṇikā ||

bilvasya mūlaṃ surasasya
                        puṣpaṃ phalaṃ karañjasya nataṃ surāhvam |
phalatrayaṃ vyoṣaniśādvayaṃ ca bastasya mūtreṇa susūkṣmapiṣṭam ||
maṃjiṣṭhā tryūṣaṇaṃ tadvat kalkayet sa mahāgadaḥ ||
bhūyo vegāya jāyeta śeṣaṃ dūṣīviṣāya vā ||

sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā
                        payasyā madhukaṃ madhu |
śastraṃ dūrvāṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ kuryāddaṣṭasya mūrddhataḥ |
tathā droṇaṃ mahādroṇaṃ mānasīṃ sarpajaṃ maṇim |
daṃśo daṣṭaḥ satṛṇnidro mūrcchāvān haritaṃ vamet ||
kledī ca daṃśo daṣṭasya hṛspīḍā granthisambhavaḥ ||

mandāḥ pītāḥ sitāḥ śyāvā
                        rukṣāḥ karburamecakāḥ |

nṛkeśāḥ sarṣapāḥ pītā guḍo
                        jīrṇaśca dhūpanam |

viṣaghnaṃ ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ
                        kuryāt saṃśodhanāni ca ||
yāti kīṭaviṣaiḥ kampaṃ na kailāsa ivānilaiḥ ||
dhūpo hanti kṛtaḥ śīghraṃ kīṭavṛścikajaṃ viṣam ||
dve bale nākulīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śirīṣaṃ rajanīdvayam ||

rohītakaṃ ca pittena
                        kalkayet sa varo 'gadaḥ |

sitāsite ca lavaṇe maricaṃ
                        ca sanāgaram |
lepaḥ sukhoṣṇaśca hitaḥ piṇyāko gomayopi vā ||

ādaṃśe yasya kaṇḍūḥsyāt
                        kothaḥ koṭhaṃ ca dāruṇam |
vego viṣasya pañcāhānnaiva vā kriyayā vinā ||

indriyārthaṃ na jānāti
                        prasvidyati ca yo muhuḥ |

kuṭajasya phalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ
                        mālatī phalinī natam |
svedaleśāḥ smṛtā lūtā lūne ye patitāstṛṇe ||
ye sphuliṅgā viniśceruste lūtā iti kecana ||

tatra ghoratamā lūtā
                        bhidyante tā api tridhā |
saptāhena daśāhena pakṣeṇa ca paraṃ kramāt ||

tā daśanti site pakṣe 'site
                        sandhau sadaiva ca ||
taddūṣitaṃ ca vastrādi dehe pṛktaṃ vikārakṛt ||
ṣaṣṭhe vyāpnoti marmāṇi saptame hanti jīvita ||
prasṛtaṃ sarvato daṃśaṃ na chindīta dahet vā ||
śastaḥ paryuṣito lepaḥ saghṛtaḥ paittike varṇe ||
āsphoṭagundrā ca hitā pralepaḥ ślaiṣmike viṣe ||

śigrupāṭhā kuśavṛṣaṃ
                        vidulaṃ ca jale pacet |
kanīyaḥ paścamūlaṃ ca tasmin maṇḍaṃ pacet ghṛtāt ||
jīvantī laśunaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ katakaṃ mārkavaṃ natam ||
pāne pralepe seke ca lūtāsu paramaṃ hitaḥ ||
surālā kaṭabhī jātiḥ śvetā ca girikarṇikā ||
lepe pāne ca lūtāsu nānena sadṛśogadaḥ ||
dehe patanti tāvatyo jāyante karṇikāḥ samam ||

ādaṃśe piṭakā tāmrā bhavet
                        kapilayā sthirā |

śūnaḥ pāṇḍūrayā daṃśaḥ
                        śopho vaktrasya gauravam |
jvaro vighūrṇanaṃ jṛmbhā śiroruk tatra bheṣajam |
koṭhaiśca cīyate gātraṃ tatra śastaṃ bhiṣagjitam |

ādaṃśe citrayā raktā piṭakā
                        visṛtā sthirā |
pītā tu gaṇḍayoḥ padmā dakṣiṇāṃsetha kakṣayoḥ ||

vāmapārśve daśet bhṛṅgā
                        vāmāṃse piṅgalā daśet |
trimaṇḍalodare pūtiḥ pṛṣṭhe vīrā tu dakṣiṇe ||
kaṇṭhe raktā lalāṭe tu citrā santānikauṣṭhayoḥ ||
sarvatra saviṣe liṅgaṃ viparītaṃ tu nirviṣe ||

daṣṭo yena tu tacceṣṭārutaṃ
                        kurvan vinaśyati |

tatomlaiḥ kṣālayitvā tu
                        toyairanu ca lepayet |
anyaiśca viṣaśophaghnaiḥ sirāṃ vā mokṣayet drutam ||
madanasya ca sañcūrṇya dadhnā pītvā viṣaṃ vamet ||
purīṣaṃ vā vibadhyeta gude syādvā vikartikā ||

takreṇa śarapuṅkhāyā bījaṃ
                        sañcūrṇya vā pibet |

payaḥ payasyayā yuktaṃ
                        sitayā madhukena ca ||

sthirāṃ mandarujāṃ pracchet
                        karṇikāṃ pātayeta vā |
ropaṇyaḥ kalkitāstailaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā sādhitaṃ tathā |
śirīṣabījaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca madhunā tatra lehayet ||

kapilena vraṇe kotho jvaro
                        granthirbhramaḥ satṛṭ |

raktaṃ kṛṣṇena vamati
                        viśeṣād durdine pibet |
śīdhunā śvaviṣaṃ hanti pītaṃ vā taṇḍulāmbunā ||

aikadhyaṃ palalaṃ tailaṃ
                        rūpikāyāḥ payo guḍaḥ |
sa kvāthaḥ śītalaḥ pītaḥ paraṃ śvaviṣabheṣajam ||
jalatrāse samaste ca viṣe tat garuḍopamam ||
alarkajuṣṭametaṃ me nirviṣaṃ kuru mā cirāt |
sakṣaudraṃ vālakarajaḥ kvāthaṃ vā saguḍaṃ pibet ||

śvayathau śuddhakoṣṭhasya
                        payaḥ pāne hitaṃ śṛtam |
prāyo na sahate tīkṣṇamuṣṇaṃ vā bheṣajaṃ viṣam ||
nāvane hemaṃ śuklā ca tataḥ śāmyati śoṇitam ||
tat lohakumbhe nihitaṃ kāryaṃ sannihitaṃ sadā ||

mātā me vijayānāma jayo
                        nāma pitā mama |
ajayyasya ca putrosau vijaye ca jayāmi vaḥ ||

nidhāpayet gavāṃ śṛṅge
                        manuṣyaṃ punarāharet | (manuṣyaṃ tena jīvayet)
jāṅgalaṃ dāḍimaṃ dhātrī kapitthaṃ saindhavaṃ sitā ||

athāto viṣopayogīyaṃ
                        nāmādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ |

daṣṭasya dvau yavau
                        kīṭaistilamātraṃ tu vṛścikaiḥ |
naiva svasṛksthe pāne tu lūtādaṣṭasya neṣyate ||
vatssnābhaṃ ca karmaṇyaṃ viṣaṃ snigdhaṃ ghanaṃ guru |

grīṣmepyātyayike vyādhau na
                        ca varṣāsu durdine ||

na krodhane na pittārte na
                        klībe rājani dvije |
kṣīreṇa ca viṣaṃ yuktaṃ jīrṇajvaraharaṃ param ||
savedane sapāke ca vraṇe duṣṭe pralepanam ||

samūlā pippalī mūtraṃ viṣaṃ
                        śūlaharaṃ tathā |

śvitrī viṣeṇa saṃsṛṣṭaṃ
                        tataḥ sphoṭān kilāsajān |

dantī viṣaṃ sātiviṣaṃ
                        pippalī maricāni ca |
viṣaṃ māgadhikā dve ca niśe kācaghramañjanam ||
ato yathottaraṃ dadyādayasā ca samaṃ viṣam |

pūrayet sarpiṣā cānu
                        sarpireva ca pāyayet |

śuṇṭhī pathyā viṣaṃ pāṭhā
                        dravantī pūtināsajit ||

pūrve vayasi madhye vā
                        tatprayojyaṃ jitātmanaḥ |

aviśuddhe śarīre hi yukto
                        rāsāyano vidhiḥ |
na bhāti malasaṃsṛṣṭe vastre rāga ivārpitaḥ ||

sarve ca doṣā bhavanti
                        grāmyādāhārādamlalavaṇakaṭukakṣāravirudvāsātmyarūkṣābhiṣyandiklinnagurupūtipuryuṣitanavadhānyaśuṣkaśākāmamāṃsatilakulatthadadhiśuktakāñjikapiṣṭānnavirūḍhakaniṣeviṇāṃ
                        divāsvapnastrīmadyanityānāṃ viṣamātimātravyāyāmāyāmasaṅkṣobhitavapuṣāṃ
                        krodhalobhabhayaśokāyāsabahulānā
                        pāpakarmaṇāmasamañjasāhāravihāranirhāraniratānām ||

ato nimittaṃ hyaviśuddhaḥ
                        sañjāyate raso vidahyate raktaṃ śithilībhavanti māṃsāni viṣyandate medo
                        dūṣyante doṣā vimucyante sandhayo na sandhīyantesthiṣu majjāno nāpyāyate
                        śukraṃ naujo na balaṃ na vīryam ||

tataḥ sa evaṃbhūto glāyati
                        sīdati nidrātandrālasyasamanvitaḥ khidyate nirvidyate nirutsāho 'samarthaḥ
                        śārīramānasānāṃ viśiṣṭānāṃ ceṣṭānāṃ bhraṣṭacchāyo
                        naṣṭasmṛtiralpabuddhirasampādyamānābhilaṣitārtho 'harniśamaniśamaniśaṃ
                        niśvasannadhiṣṭhānabhūto rogāṇāṃ nopāttamapi sarvamāyuravāpnoti ||

tasmāt buddhimānapāsya
                        yathoktānāhārādidoṣān nirvāhya ca pūrvopacitān rasāyanaṃ
                        vidhivihitamupaseveta ||

tasya vidhiḥ
                        kṣemasubhikṣadhārmikaśaddadhānajananṛpavaidyavipre
                        sulabhamahauṣadhighṛtakṣīrapathyabhojanopakaraṇe grame nagare vā
                        pūrvottarasyāṃdiśi prāgudakpravaṇe suvibhaktavihāroddeśe deśe
                        dṛḍhaghanasumṛṣṭabhittimutsedhavistārasampannāṃ sūkṣmalocanāṃ
                        trigarbhāmṛtusukhāṃ nirvātāṃ pravātaikadeśāṃ prāgdvārāmudagdvārāṃ vā
                        śamīvilvakṣīrivṛkṣaparigṛhītāmaniṣṭendriyārthavātātaparajodhūmasvedakledadaṃśamaśakasarīsṛpavyālabālastrīdāsāntāvasāyināmagamyāṃ
                        sannihitasadvaidyaparicārakopakaraṇāṃ kuṭīṃ kārayet ||

tasyāṃ rasāyanārthī śaradi
                        vasante vā śuklapakṣe praśaste ahani pūjayitvā yathārhaṃ devaguruviprān
                        praṇamya brahmadakṣāśviprabhṛtīn parimṛśya
                        suvarṇaghṛtamadhusiddhārthakapriyaṅgurocanāḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gobrāhmaṇānanu
                        praviśet ||

tatra saṃśodhanaiḥ śuddhaḥ
                        sukhī jātabalaḥ punaḥ |
haridrāṃ pippalīṃ vellaṃ guḍaṃ coṣṇāmbunā pibet |
snigdhasvinno naraḥ pūrvaṃ tena sādhu viricyate ||
trirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā saptāhaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam |

navā vṛttā ghanā snigdhā
                        gurvī majjati cāpsu yā |

atha harītakīnāṃ
                        himavacchailasambhavānāṃ kālajātānāmāpūrṇarasavīryāṇāmanāmayānāṃ dviśastriśo
                        vā śakalitānāmanasthnāmāḍhakaṃ caturguṇena payasā saṃsvedya
                        mṛdubhūtamavatārya śītaṃ sarpirmadhvāḍhakābhyāṃ saṃsṛjya suguptaṃ sthāpayet
                        |

tatastrirātrādūrdhvamāhārānuparodhinīṃ mātrāṃ pratyahamupayojayet jīeṇe
                        śāliṣaṣṭikaṃ payasā bhuñjīta |

asya prayogādvarṣaśatamajaro nirvalīkhalatipalitāmayaḥ śrutismṛtisampannaḥ
                        samiddhānalaśca puruṣo bhavati ||
bhavatyapatyaṃ vipulaṃ sthiraṃ ca samaśnato yogamimaṃ prayatnāt ||
dve ca tailāt pacet sarvaṃ tadagnau lehatāṃ gatam ||
vaikhānasā bālakhilyāḥ prāśya prāptā navaṃ vayaḥ |

ghṛtasyakumbhaṃ madhukaṃ
                        madhūkaṃ kākoliyugmaṃ ca balāṃ svaguptām |

tadāmalakasahasrasvarasaparipītaṃ
                        sthirājīvantīpunarnavānāgabalāmaṇḍūkaparṇībrahmasuvarcalābhīruśaṅkhapuṣpīvacāpippalīviḍaṅgasvaguptāmṛtāgarucandanamadhukamadhūkapuṣpapadmotpalanavamālikāyuvatiyūthikācūrṇāṣṭabhāgasampṛktaṃ
                        punarnāgabalāpalasahasrasvarasaparipītaṃ chāyopaśoṣitaṃ dviguṇitasarpiṣā
                        kṣaudreṇa kṣudraguḍākṛti kṛtvā ghṛtabhājanasthaṃ bhasmarāśeradhaḥ
                        sthāpayedantarbhūmeḥ pakṣamatharvavedavitkṛtarakṣaṃ pakṣātyaye coddhṛtya
                        kanakarajatatāmrapravālakālāyaścūrṇāṣṭabhāgasaṃyuktamarddhakarṣābhivṛddhyā
                        yathāgni prātaḥ prayojayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

tāni susvinnaśītānyuddhṛtya niṣkulīkṛtānyāpothya pippalī viḍaṅgataṇḍulānāṃ
                        pṛthagāḍhakenādhyarddhena śarkarāyāḥ ṣaḍbhirmadhughṛtatailānāṃ saṃyojya
                        ghṛtakumbhe sthāpayedviṃśatirātraṃ paraṃ copayojayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa
                        ||

abhayāmalakasahasraṃ
                        pippalīsahasrayuktaṃ taruṇapalāśakṣārodakenāplāvya śucau bhāṇḍe sthāpayet |

tatonugatakṣāramanātapaśuṣkamāsthirahitaṃ cūrṇayitvā sitopalāpādena
                        caturguṇābhyāṃ ca madhughṛtābhyāṃ saṃyojya ghṛtabhājane ṣaṇmāsānantarbhūmeḥ
                        sthāpayitvā parato yathāgnibalamupayuñjīteti samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

āmalakacūrṇāḍhakamekaviṃśatirātramāmalakasvarasabhāvitaṃ
                        madhughṛtāḍhakābhyāṃ pippalīcūrṇāṣṭabhāgena śarkarācaturbhāgena ca saṃsṛṣṭaṃ
                        ghṛtabhājanasthaṃ prāvṛṣi bhasmarāśau nidadhyāt |

viḍaṅgataṇḍulānāmāḍhakamāḍhakaṃ pippalītaṇḍulānāmadhyarddhaṃ
                        sitopalānāṃ madhughṛtatailāḍhakaiḥ ṣaḍbhirekīkṛtaṃ ghṛtabhājanasthaṃ prāvṛṣi
                        bhasmarāśāvitisamānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

abhayāmalakabibhītakānāṃ
                        dviśastriśo vā saṃyojitānāṃ palāśatvagavanaddhānāṃ mṛdāvaliptānāṃ
                        kukūlasvinnānāṃ nirasthīkṛtānāṃ palasahastramulūkhale saṅkṣudya
                        dadhibhadhughṛtatailapalalaśarkarāsampṛktaṃ bhakṣayedanannabhugyathoktena
                        vidhinā prayogānte tato dviguṇaṃ kālaṃ
                        yavāgūyūṣakṣīraghṛtaṣaṣṭikānnamāhārobhyañjanaṃ sarpirudvartanaṃ
                        yavacūrṇamiti samānaṃ pūrveṇābhyadhikaphalaṃ vā ||
parṇinyau pippalī śṛṅgī medā tāmalakī truṭiḥ ||

jīvantī joṅgakaṃ drākṣā
                        pauṣkaraṃ candanaṃ śaṭhī |

ityeṣa cyavanaprāśo yaṃ
                        prāśya cayvano muniḥ |

kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ jvaraṃ śoṣaṃ
                        hṛdrogaṃ vātaśoṇitam |

varṣaṃ khādet prāṇadāṃ
                        prātarekāmaśnannannāt pūrvamakṣadvayaṃ ca |

teṣāṃ tādṛśānāṃ palaśatamāyasyāṃ sthālyāṃ prakṣipyāmalakasvarasottaraṃ kṛtvā
                        supihitaṃ bhasmahitaṃ bhasmarāśau nikhanet |

tataścottarakālaṃ kṛtvā vamanavirecanaṃ snigdhatanureva kevalaṃ
                        samantatoṅguṣṭhaparvamātramukhenāyasena sruveṇāyasa eva bhājane tasmāt
                        kalkīkṛtāt sruvamekaṃ gṛhītvā madhudhṛtābhyāṃ pṛthak sruveṇa saṃyojya
                        prāśnīyāt |

anena vidhinā varṣamupayujya varṣameva cānyadapyuddiṣṭāhāro yantritātmā kuṭīṃ
                        samadhivaset |

tataḥ sarvopatāpān jitvā vyādhijarāmaraṇaśastrāgnitoyaviṣāṇāmagamyaḥ
                        sarvabhāveṣvatīndiryo varṣasahasradvayaṃ jīvati ||
madhumāgadhikāviḍaṅgasāratriphalā hema ghṛtaṃ sitāṃ ca khādan |
jarasānavalīḍhadehakāntiḥ samadhātuśca samāḥ śataṃ ca jīvet ||
lakṣmīkāmaḥ padmakiñjalkayuktaṃ yuktaṃ khādet kāmakāmo vidāryā ||
rasaṃ guḍūcyāḥ sahamūlapuṣpyāḥ kalkaṃ prayuñjīta ca śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ ||
medhyāni caitāni rasāyanāni medhyā viśeṣeṇa tu śaṅkhapuṣpī ||
triphalā kaṭukatrayaṃ haridre sapaṭolaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca taiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ ||

triguṇena rasena
                        śaṅkhapuṣpyāḥ sapayaskaṃ ghṛtanalvaṇaṃ vipakvam |

peṣyairmṛṇālavisakesarapatrabījaiḥ siddhaṃ sahemaśakalaṃ payasā ca
                        sarpiḥ |

sarpiścatuṣkuvalayaṃ sahiraṇyapatraṃ medhyaṃ gavāmapi bhavet kimumānuṣāṇām
                        ||
vaidehikā ca triyavāḥ pṛthaksyuryavau suvarṇasya tilo viṣasya ||

sarpiṣaśca palamekata eta
                        dyojayet pariṇate ca ghṛtāḍhyām |

yathoktaguṇāyāṃ bhūmau
                        jātāmabālāmajīrṇāṃ śīrṇapurāṇaparṇāmasañjātānyaparṇāṃ tape tapasye vā māse
                        yathoktena vidhinā puṣyayukte candramasi sumuhurte nāgabalāṃ samūlāmuddharet
                        |

tasyā mūlānāṃ tvakpiṇḍamāmramātramakṣamātraṃ vā ślakṣṇapiṣṭamavacūrṇitaṃ vā
                        payasā pibenmadhughṛtābhyāṃ vā lihyāt |

tatra sāravṛkṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ
                        svarasārthī kuṣṭhacikitsite khadirakalpamīkṣeta |

ārdravṛkṣāsambhave tu sāraśakalānidvyaṅgulatryaṅgulāni tanūni caturguṇembhsyā
                        plāvyātape trirātraṃ sthāpayet |

trirātrācca punaranyānyevaṃ navarātreṇa triḥprakṣepaṇoddhāreṇa ca svarasaḥ
                        parikalpito bhavati ||

phalānāṃ
                        punarvīrudauṣadhīnāṃ ca yantreṇolūkhalena vā saṅkṣudya niṣpīḍya svarasaṃ
                        gṛhṇīyāt ||
antrdhūmaṃ tasya majjā sudagdhaḥ kṣiptastaile saindhavaṃ cāgnivarṇam |

ekāntaraṃ tauvarakañca
                        tailaṃ pibeddhitāśī niyamena māsam |
kuṣṭhī taddivasāsthito niraśanaḥ sūrye gate 'staṃ pibet ||

tāvadeva ca tathaiva ca
                        bhūyaḥ pāyayettamaruṇodayakāle |
snāyāt sukhāmbhobhiramadyamāṃsa strīsaṅgatiḥ syāttriguṇaṃ ca yogāt ||

atha
                        bhallātakānyanupahatānyanāmayānyāpūrṇarasaprpamāṇavīryāṇi
                        pakrajāmbavaprakāśāni śucau śukre vā māse saṅgṛhya yavapalle māṣapalle vā
                        nidhāpayet |
tāni caturmāsasthitāni sahe sahasye vā māse prayoktumārabheta |

teṣāṃ rasamaṣṭabhāgāvaśiṣṭamanuṣṇaṃ sapayaskaṃ
                        sarpirgaṇḍūṣābhyaktoṣṭhatālujihvaḥ prātaḥ pibet |

vidhinānena sahasraprayogastriguṇaśca kālo ghṛtakṣīrābhyāṃ
                        śāliṣaṣṭikamaśanamevaṃ viśeṣādvigatakuṣṭhadurnāmakṛmipramehamedodoṣo
                        varṣaśatamajara ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa ||

pūrvamekaikabhallātakakvāthaṃ sapayaskaṃ pibedekaikaṃ ca
                        bhallātakamabhivarddhayedyāvat pañca |
prāpya ca saptatimapakarṣayet bhūyaḥ pañca pañca yāvat pañca |

bhallātakānāṃ
                        jarjarīkṛtānāṃ piṣṭasvedanaṃ pūrayitvā bhūmāvākāṇṭhanikhātasya
                        snehabhāvitasya dṛḍhasyoparikumbhasyāropyoḍupenāpidhāyakṛṣṇabhṛdāvaliptaṃ
                        gomayāgninopasvedayet |

teṣāṃ yaḥ svarasaḥ kumbhaṃ prapadyate tamaṣṭabhāgamadhusaṃyuktaṃ
                        dviguṇitaghṛtamadyāt |

anenaiva vidhinā
                        bhallātakasya rasaṃ gṛhītvā kevalameva māsamekaṃ prayuñjīta |

bhallātakatailaṃ
                        kṛṣṇatilatailaṃ sarpirāmalakaraso 'sanādisārakaṣāya ityeṣāṃ droṇaṃ droṇaṃ
                        triphalātrikaṭukaviḍaṅgasāracitrakaharidrādvayatrivṛddantīndrayavayaṣṭīmadhukaviṣātiviṣārasāñjanapriyaṅgūnāṃ
                        pālikābhāgāstadaikadhyaṃ snehapākavidhinā vipācyāvatārya paripūyacānuguptaṃ
                        nidadhyāt |

tata upaskṛtaśarīraḥ prātaḥ prātaḥ pāṇiśuktimātraṃ kṣaudreṇa
                        pratisaṃsṛjyopayuñjīta |

sarpiḥ pakvaṃ tena
                        tulyapramāṇaṃ yuñjyāt svecchaṃ śarkarāyā rajobhiḥ |
ekībhūtaṃ tatkhajakṣobhaṇena sthāpyaṃ dhānye saptarātraṃ suguptam ||

tamamṛtarasapākaṃ yaḥ
                        prage prāśamaśnannanu pibati yatheṣṭaṃ vāri dugdhaṃ rasaṃ vā |
tilena saha mākṣikeṇa palalena sūpena vā |

kaphajo na sa rogāsti na
                        vibandhostikaścana |
ghnanti śophaṃ vamiṃ hidhmāṃ plīhānaṃ vātaśoṇitam ||

viḍaṅgacūrṇaṃ kṣaudrabhallātakakvāthābhyāṃ madhvāmalakarasābhyāṃ
                        guḍūcīkvāthena ca etāṃścaturo yogān māsamupayuñjīteti samānaṃ pūrveṇa |

śvetāvalgujaphalānyātapaśuṣkāṇī cūrṇayitvā tattulyaguḍena saṅkṣudya
                        ghṛtakumbhe dhānyarāśau saptparātraṃ nidadhyāt |

tasya māsaprayogādviśeṣeṇa vigatakuṣṭho grahaṇadhāraṇavān varṣaśatamajara
                        ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa |

pītvā cātape nirvātoṣṇe vā garbhagṛhe tiṣṭhedaparāhṇe tadvadeva srānamaśanaṃ
                        ca |

palāni daśa bākucyā
                        daśaiva ca phalatrayāt |

tato nistuṣīkṛtya chāyāyāṃ viśoṣayitvā susūkṣmaṃ ca sañcūrṇya tryahaṃ tryahaṃ
                        kramaśo bhāvayettriphalākvathena
                        kāravallīvāsābrāhmīguḍūcībhṛṅgarājasvarasaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak
                        khadirāsanarājavṛkṣapicumandakvāthaiḥ ||
uddhṛtya sāraṃ madhunā lihanti takraṃ tadevānu pibanti cānte ||

khadirāmbhasā pibedvā
                        ravisevī tāṃ tayā yavāgūṃ vā |
kuryācchāyāviśuṣkaṃ pṛthagiti ca phalaṃ prāpunāṭaṃ ca śuṣkam ||

aṃśastābhyāṃ tathāṃśaḥ
                        kṛmiripudahana sphoṭakṛdbhyaḥ sa cūrṇo gomūtreṇopayuktaḥ pramitahitabhujaḥ
                        ścitramāśveva hanti ||
upalamaghanaṃ ghanaṃ vā rasāśināṃ hanti bākucikā ||

uṣṇodakena piṣṭā pītā ca
                        ghṛtānvitā jayet gulmam laghupañcamūlasiddhāṃ peyāmupayojayejjīrṇe ||

viṣkirarasena pītā
                        daśamūlarasena vā guḍūcyā vā |
dhāroṣṇena tu payasā yuktaḥ śophajvarau hanti ||

lekhāmindoḥ saghṛtāṃ
                        sukhāmbunā putriṇī bhavati pītvā puṣṣodayeśvagandhāśṛtena payasā ca bhuñjānā
                        ||

vandhyāpi
                        saptāhamimaṃprayogaṃ karoti yā harṣayatī sugandhiḥ |
priyaṃvadā sadvrataśaucayuktā sūte sutān sā niyamāt guṇāḍhyān ||
gehe sthitāpi rekhā cāndramasī kimuta koṣṭhasthā ||
avalgujo mokṣayate mahābhayācchriyaṃ ca medhāṃ ca dadāti pupkalām ||

haimavatyā vacāyāḥ
                        piṇḍamāmalakamātraṃ payasāloḍya pibejjīrṇe payassarpirodana ityāhāraḥ |

saptabhiḥ saptarātraiḥ śrutadharo varṣaśatamajara ityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa
                        ||

itarasyā api vacāyā
                        dvipalakvāthaṃ pibet jīrṇe payaḥ sarpirityādi samānaṃ pūrveṇa |

vacākalkaśatapākaṃ
                        ghṛtadroṇamupayujya viśeṣāt
                        grahonmādāpasmāragalagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāślīpadasvarabhedavimuktaḥ sarvārtheṣu
                        siddhimān varṣaśatāyurbhavati ||
ṣaṇmāsamanyavidhinā na tu śastamāhuḥ pakṣaprayogamapi hīnataraṃ rasone ||
tatkāla eva vā yuktaṃ yuktamālocya mātrayā ||
kvāthena vā yathāvyādhi rasaṃ kevalameva vā ||
śeṣaṃ pibet klamāpāye sthiratāṃ gata ojasi ||
palaṃ piṣṭasya tanmajjñaḥ sabhaktaṃ prākca śīlayet ||

amadyapo yastu
                        phalāmbutukramavantisomaṃ ca sugandhi śītam |
sauvīrakaṃ jāṅgalajaṃ rasaṃ vā tuṣodakvaṃ vā parisikthikāṃ vā ||

sadyaḥ piṣṭaṃ sarpiṣā
                        saṃyutaṃ vā niryāsena svena yuktaṃ ca kāmam |
tailena gulmī khadireṇa kuṣṭhī khādet kṛmighnaiḥ kṛmimān rasonam ||
yathāyathaṃ prayogosya kāryastaṃ taṃ gadaṃ prati ||
śuddhe vā vidyate vāyau na dravyaṃ laśunātparam ||
svapnaṃ divā jāgaraṇaṃ niśāsu piṣṭaṃ vyavāyaṃ dadhi cātra necchet ||
laśunaṃ snehasaṃyogāt garīyān jāyate hi saḥ ||
paitte vikārekṣigadetisāre kṣāme śarīre ca sa varjanīyaḥ ||

śīlita eṣa karoti durāpaṃ
                        vahniśarīrabalaṃ samameva |

amṛtakaṇasamutthaṃ yo
                        rasonaṃ rasonaṃ vidhiyutamitikhādecchītakāle sadaiva |

sa nayati śatajīvī strīsahāyo jarāntaṃ kanakaruciravarṇo nīrujastuṣṭijuṣṭaḥ
                        ||
kapolakāntyā vijitaḥ śaśāṅko rasātalaṃ gacchati nirvideva ||
samprāpyante yantraṇodvegamuktaiḥ ryasyābhyāsāddhāri dīrghaṃ sukhaṃ ca ||

marakatamaṇinīlaṃ
                        nālamasyātibālaṃ pariṇataśaśigauraṃ yacca bījaṃ supiṣṭam |
babūva tebhyaḥ kila kukkuṭī yayā vrajanti devatvamivādya mānuṣāḥ ||

bhuñjītālpataraṃ
                        dinārditamṛṣiḥ pakṣakṣaye bhakṣayan kṣīraṃ bījakavāri takramathavā pītvā
                        sthitiṃ kalpayet |

māṃsaṃ prāśya tathā nakhadvijakacaḥ śīrṇotthitaiḥ kāntimān
                        jīvatyabdaśatatrayaṃ dhṛtimatismṛtyādibhirbhūṣitaḥ ||

kṣīreṇa kandacūrṇaṃ
                        pibanyavāgūṃ ca pariṇate māsam |
kandatrayaṃ ca bhṛṣṭaṃ ghṛteśnato bhakṣitaṃ vātān ||

trīn kandakāṃśca niśi
                        bhakṣayatājyabhṛṣṭān dhātrīphalāmbu sasitaṃ cahgalīpayo vā |

peyaṃ dṛgāmayajayāya niṣevitavyā kāmaṃ ca rogaśamamātraphalārthibhiḥ sā
                        ||
vibhartti yā pallavamabdaśabdāt sā kañcukī śvetavapurvareṇyā ||

āṣāḍhe kārtike vāttaṃ
                        tatkandaṃ śītalaṃ sthitam |
kṣīrameva ca jīrṇepi peyāṃ vā snehabharjitām ||

medhāvinaḥ praṇaśyanti
                        gātraṃ suptaṃ ca budhyate |
aṣṭāṃśaśiṣṭe tu ghṛtāt prasthaṃ kṣīrasamaṃ pacet ||

idamupayujya
                        sarpirativīryamudāraguṇaṃ bhavati suvāksudhīḥ sudṛḍhasubalaḥ subhagaḥ |

adyāpyataḥ suragaṇāḥ kila
                        dhūpamukhyān hitvā varāgaruturuṣkahimendudarpān |

nirdahyamānavapuṣṣo 'pi śikhāṃ pibanto gandhena yasya muditā dadhati prasādam
                        ||

sa yogavāhī sa śivaḥ sa
                        sārvaḥ sarvartusevyaḥ sukhaśīlanīyaḥ |

yaḥ padmarāgarāgo yaḥ
                        kanakacchedapāṭalo yo vā |
kvāthaiḥ pṛthakpathyaparasya hanti māsena ghorān kaphapittarogān ||

pibet palaśataṃ yosya
                        vidhinā niyato yatiḥ |

sarvaṃ ca tiktakaṭukaṃ
                        nātyuṣṇaṃ kaṭu pākataḥ |
chedanaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa lauhaṃ tatra praśasyate ||
snigdhamanamlakaṣāyaṃ mdṛu guru ca śilājatu śreṣṭham ||

tat samarasatāṃ yātaṃ
                        saṃśuṣkaṃ prakṣipedrase bhūyaḥ |
guṇān samagrān kurute sahasā vyāpadaśca na ||

kulatthān kākamācīṃ ca
                        kapotāṃśca sadā tyajet |
śoṣī saraiḥ kravyabhugāmiṣotthairmāyuramāṃsaiḥ payasā ca kārśye ||
kṣīraudanāśī yo jīrṇe yakṣmaṇā na sa bādhyate ||

balāyā madhuyaṣṭyāśca
                        rase gavye ca vāriṇi |
bhaktasyānte prāgvā guṭikā na virudhyate saiṣā ||

vidradhimudaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ
                        śvitraṃ jāḍyaṃ kṣayaṃ madaṃ mūrcchām |
kurute nṛpavallabhatāṃ jayaṃ vivāde ca vaktrasthā ||

na sostirogo bhuvi
                        sādhyarūpo jatvaśmajaṃ yaṃ na jayet prasahya |

daśaguṇamupayuṅkte yaḥ
                        śataṃ śailajātāllaghuhitamitabhojī varjayan varjanīyān |

satatasamanuṣaktān varjitān vaidyavṛndairvidhamati sagadaughān nekṣate
                        cāyuṣontam ||
yo mandarasyātmabhuvā hitāya nyastaḥ sa śaileṣu śilājarūpī ||

kiṃcit kaṣāya ubhayaḥ
                        śītaḥ pāke kaṭurlaghuḥ |

na tanniṣevī
                        jarasābhibhṛyate na pannagairnāpi garairna vṛścikaiḥ |

sodaśvitko mākṣikadhātuḥ
                        saghṛto vā sakṣaudro vā kṣaudraghṛtābhyāṃ sahito vā |
sāmbhasko vā tailayuto vā vinihantā tvagdoṣāṇāṃ sarvaviṣāṇāṃ sagarāṇām ||

datvā tulyaṃ mākṣikadhātuṃ madhumiśraṃ lihyātpāṇḍuvyādhyabhibhūtaḥ
                        śivamicchan ||

aṃśaḥ śuṇṭhyā lohamalāṃśo
                        badarāṃśaḥ pippalyaṃśo mākṣikadhāturdviguṇāṃśaḥ |

kṣaudraṃ kāmaṃ kṛṣṇatilānāmapi cāṃśaḥ śreṣṭhā piṇḍī pāṇḍuvikāraśvayathughnī
                        ||

kṛtyaikasthaṃ
                        mākṣikadhātuṃ triphalāṃ ca bhrāṣṭre paktvā ye sahaviṣkaṃ vilihanti |

pathyādāstān vārdhakadoṣā na bhajante māturdoṣāḥ stanyanivṛttāniva vālān
                        ||
śanaiḥ śanairyāti jarā vināśaṃ pratyantavāsādiva lokayātrā ||

trikoṇakāṇḍā
                        subahupratānā phaleṣu pītā kusumeṣu raktā |

bhuvi paramauṣadhirmahiṣavallarīti prathitā kvacidapi vṛddhadāraka iyatvapi
                        vellarikā ||

jīrṇo pūrvavadaśnīyādyo
                        jīvet sa samāḥ śatam |

svarasena śatāvaryā
                        saptāhaṃ bhāvitaṃ ca tat |
gavyaṃ pibedanu payo māhiṣaṃ vā yatheṣṭabhuk ||
atonyathā tu ye teṣāṃ sauryamārutiko vidhiḥ ||
sukhopacārā bhraṃśe 'pi ye na dehasya bādhakāḥ ||
sarpirmadhubhyāmadataḥ śarīraṃ kālāgradūtī na jarā dunoti ||
madhunā madhurāṃ lihan hinasti sthavimānaṃ jarasaṃ gadāṃśca sarvān ||
niyamena narā niṣevitāro yadi jīvantyajarāḥ kimatra citram ||

harītakīṃ sarpiṣi
                        sampratāpya samaśnatastat pibato ghṛtaṃ ca |
bhaveccirasthāyi balaṃ śarīre sakdtkṛtaṃ sādhu yathā kṛtajñe ||

ārāccitānāṃ kalaśaṃ
                        purāṇaṃ dhātrīphalānāṃ madhunaśca pūrṇam |
saṃvatsarārddhaṃ nihitaṃ yaveṣu niṣevamāṇo jarasaṃ nihanti ||

navāmalakaśuktayo madhu
                        ghṛtaṃ rajaścāyasaṃ catuṣṭayamayoghaṭasthamiti cūrṇitaṃ vatsaram ||

krameṇa lihataḥ
                        payonupibataśca pathyāśinaściraṃ bhavati jīvitaṃ kṣayamupaiti pṛthavījarā
                        ||
arśāṃsi jantūṃśca jayatyudīrṇān vahniṃ ca sandhukṣayati kṣaṇena ||
tailena cūrṇāni niṣevamāṇān śarīriṇo nopatapanti rogāḥ ||

viḍaṅgakalkaṃ svarasena
                        dhātryāḥ kṣaudreṇa yuktaṃ ca pibennaro yaḥ |
drākṣārasakṣaudrapariplutaṃ vā vijitya rogān sa bhavecchatāyuḥ ||

punarnavasyārddhapalaṃ
                        palaṃ vā piṣṭaṃ pibedyaḥ payasārddhāmāsam |
māsadvayaṃ tattriguṇaṃ samāṃ vā jīrṇopi bhūyaḥ sapunarnavaḥ syāt ||

pītāśvagandhā
                        payasārddhamāsaṃ ghṛtena tailena sukhāmbunā vā |
kṛśasya puṣṭiṃ vapuṣo vidhatte bālasya sasyasya yathā suvṛṣṭiḥ ||

gāyatrīśikhiśiṃśapāsanaśivā vellākṣakāruṣkarān piṣṭvāṣṭau
                        daśaṣaṭguṇembhasi dṛtān khaṇḍaiḥ sahāyomayaiḥ |

pātre lohakṛte tryahaṃ ravikarairāloḍayan pācayedagnau cānu mṛdau
                        salohaśakalaṃ pādasthitaṃ tat pacet ||

vimalayā sitayā
                        madhunāthavā yutamayuktamidaṃ yadi vā ghṛtam |

śrīmān nirdhūtapāpmā
                        vanamahiṣabalo vājivegaḥ sthirāṅgo keśairbhṛṅgāṅganīlairmadhusurabhimukho
                        naikayoṣinniṣevī |
samūlakāṣaṃ tu kaṣanti dehaṃ bhraṃśādvidhestena vivarjitāni ||
phalaṃ prayātyūrdhvamadhastrivṛttu pratyakṣataḥ kasya na siddhametat ||
nāśaṃ nayante sahasaiva dehaṃ samyakprayuktāni tathaiva vṛddhim ||

jitvā tasmādindriyādīn
                        suduṣṭān kālopetaḥ śvaddadhāno yathāvat |
sthiraṃ śarīraṃ kriyate śarīriṇāṃ kulaṃ yathā satpuruṣairadhiṣṭhitam ||

sandhukṣyognistairupajāte ca vivarjyā yogāstegnau dhātusamṛddheḥ sa hi mūlam
                        ||

āyuryogāḥ sādhvapi yuktā
                        mṛduvahnau nairarthakyaṃ yānti kṛtaghne 'pyupakārāḥ |

dīpte vahnau te tu guṇaughairapi tucchā vistīryante pātranisṛṣṭā iva bhogāḥ
                        ||
maṭhapraveśena vināpi siddhiṃ vrajanti goṣṭheṣu rasāyanāni ||

na tu tā api śobhante
                        jarasānugatā iva |
puṃyogena vinā strīṇāṃ sa hi saṃvananaṃ param ||
na śarīramavāpnoti na vā ratiratiḥ kṣayam ||

mede dve dve ca kākolyau
                        sūpyaparṇyau śatāvarīm |

vīrāṃ svaguptāṃ kākolyau
                        yaṣṭīṃ phalgu dvipippalīm |

sarvaiḥ kṣīreṇa haviṣo
                        navāt prasthaṃ śṛte 'tra ca |
payonupānaṃ yo lihyānnityavegaḥ sa nā bhavet ||

kṣīriṇī ca śvadaṃṣṭrā ca
                        phāṇitaṃ śarkarā madhu |
pītvā saśarkaraṃ śītaṃ kuliṅga iva hṛṣyati ||
pādaśeṣe ca saṃcūrṇya kuḍavāṃśāḥ pṛthak kṣipet ||
pacedekāṃ tataḥ prāśya śataṃ vrajati yoṣitām ||
pakvāṃ pūpalikāṃ khādan strīṣu hṛṣyati vājivat ||
pīto bhuktaśca sa rasaḥ kurute śukramakṣayam ||
tapte sarpiṣi yaḥ khādet sa gacchet strīṣu na kṣayam ||

ghṛtaṃ māṣān sabastāṇḍān
                        phalāmle māhiṣe rase |
svādau vā sādhayet pūtaṃ tadrasaṃ bharjayet ghṛte ||
pītaḥ sa vṛṣyo balyaśca bṛṃhaṇaśca paraṃ rasaḥ ||
kalpayecchikhino hāṃse haṃsān vā śikhije rase ||

tṛptiṃ caṭakamāṃsānāṃ gatvā
                        yonu payaḥ pibet |

ghṛtāḍhyaṃ kukvuṭaṃ śūlyaṃ
                        śītaṃ khādet samākṣikam |
payaḥ pibati jāgarti kṛtsnāṃ rātriṃ sa vegavān ||
sitayā ca yutaṃ pītvā vṛddhopi taruṇāyate ||
pādalepaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā niśi vegairna hīyate ||
siddhaścaraṇalepoyaṃ bhuvaṃ padbhyāṃ tu na spṛśet ||

ebhirbhakṣyāṇi peyāni
                        lehyāni ca ghṛtāni ca |
yuñjīta bastīn putrārthī putrakāmoditaṃ ca yat ||
kiṃ punaḥ strīśarīre ye saṅghaghātena pratiṣṭhitāḥ ||
taṃ taṃ prāpya vivarddhante naraṃ rūpādayo guṇāḥ ||

pibantīva ca paśyantī
                        spṛśantī limpatīva yā |

pragalbhā rītasaṅgrāme
                        svasthā lajjāmayī ca yā |
bahuśopi ca yāṃ gatvā tatpūrvamiva gacchati ||

prājñāḥ kalājñā vaśagā
                        vinītāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ prītikarā vayasyāḥ |

kāntā vanāntāḥ
                        parapuṣṭaghuṣṭā ramyāḥ sravantyaḥ satataṃ sravantyaḥ |
madyaṃ madāmodakaraṃ viśeṣādhdṛdyā prasannā surabhiḥ prasannā ||
saudhaṃ sudhāśubhratarāḥ karāśca candrasya kurvanti paraṃ vṛṣatvam ||

bandhena pūrvopahitena
                        puṃsaḥ khinnasya vṛttiḥ karaṇāntareṇa |

tasmānnityaṃ strīṣu
                        vāñchan priyatvaṃ vṛṣyairyogairjātakāmo 'pi kāmī |
satvṃa sātmyaṃ deśakālau ca budhvā cātuṣṣaṣṭe ceṣṭite vyāpriyeta ||
sītkāragarbhaṃ hasitaṃ sahāvaṃ chinnākṣaraṃ vibhramavacca gītam ||

srotassu śudveṣvamale
                        śarīre vṛṣyaṃ yadādyaṃ mitamatti kāle |
vṛṣāyate tena paraṃ manuṣyastadbṛṃhaṇaṃ dehabalapradaṃ ca ||

tasmāt purā śodhanameva
                        kāryaṃ balānurūpaṃ na ca vṛṣyayogāḥ |
sidhyanti dehe kaluṣe prayuktāḥ kliṣṭe yathā vāsasi rāgayogāḥ ||
śāstratatvaṃ na vijñāya sa durātmā cikitsati ||

arājakā yathā deśā
                        bhartṛhīnā yathā gṛhāḥ |
pātitā daśanāḥ pūṣṇo bhagasya ca vilocane ||

bhārgavaścavanaḥ kāmī
                        vṛddhaḥ san vikṛtiṃ gataḥ |

aśvibhyāṃ sahitaḥ somaṃ
                        prātaḥ pibati vāsavaḥ |
prāṇibhiḥ pitṛvatpūjyaḥ prāṇācāryaḥ sa hi smṛtaḥ ||
na vaidyo vaidyaśabdaṃ hi labhate pūrvajanmanā ||

vidyāsamāptāvāṣa vā
                        brahmaṃ vā bhiṣajaṃ dhruvam |

sarvatra maitrī
                        karuṇātureṣu nirāmadeheṣu nṛṣu pramodaḥ |

kimuta nirāmiṣeṇa manasā
                        karuṇāmṛdunā kṛpaṇaviśiṣṭayoḥ sadṛśamādaramudvahatā |

atiguru bodhisatvacaritaṃ satataṃ vidadhacchamayati rogajālamapi yotivirodhi
                        mithaḥ ||

prāṇācārthaṃ vedapāraṃ
                        prayātaṃ budhyā yuktaṃ pūjayennityamasmāt |
yasminyasya prāṇayātrā nibaddhā tasmai yacchan ko dhanānāṃ dhanāyet ||

bhiṣagvaro vāgbhaṭa
                        ityabhūnme pitāmaho nāmadharo 'smi yasya |

samadhigamya
                        guroravalokitāt gurutarācca pituḥ pratibhā mayā |

pūrvoktameva vadatā
                        kimivoditaṃ syācchraddhālutuṣṭijananaṃ na bhavatyapūrvam |

saṅkṣiptasaṃśayitavistṛtaviprakīrṇaḥ kṛtsnortharāśiriti sādhu sa eva dṛṣṭaḥ
                        ||
smarttuḥ śrotuśca sutarāṃ śraddhātuṃ kasya yujyate ||

ūrdhvameti madanaṃ
                        trivṛtādho vastumātraka iti pratipādye |
madvidho yadi vadedathavātriḥ kathyatāṃ ka iva karmaṇi bhedaḥ ||
bāliśo bhavati no khalu vidvān sūkta eva ramate matirasya ||

yaduditamiha puṇyaṃ kurvato menuvādaṃ bhavatu vigatarogo nirvṛtastena lokaḥ
                        ||
